item.g:title: Oase Watercourse Spring / Spillway Box 15000
item.g:description: The Oase Watercourse Spring / Spillway Box 15000 is a simple solution to the problem of installing a waterfall without a header pool. These one piece waterfall boxes are simply placed on the liner at the top of the stream with the rear flange sealing to the liner at the back of the box. These ultra strong boxes are designed to be covered in rocks and cobbles and have a raised lip on the top of the water chute to prevent stones, cobbles or even soil falling into the water. In addition to adding strength, the internal support cones also diffuse the water flow to ensure an even coverage across the outflow lip. Unlike other spillways these one piece watercourse springs are completely sealed, so no matter how much water is pumped in, the only place it can come out is through the opening at the front, ensuring water is never lost. Oase Watercourse Spring / Spillway Box 15000 Dimensions Oase Watercourse Spring 15000 - 521mm long x 474mm wide x 260mm high (480mm Waterfall width) Oase Watercourse Spring / Spillway Box 15000 Features One piece boxes to ensure leak free installation Maximum flowrate 15000 litres per hour Extra strong to allow them to be camouflaged with rocks and cobbles 2" (50mm) BSP female connection on 15000 2" (50mm) BSP male to male adaptor supplied with 15000
item.g:product_type: Water Features > Water Feature Reservoirs and Bases > Oase Watercourse Spring / Spillway Box

item.g:title: Oase Eco-Rise 50 Water Feature Stand
item.g:description: The Oase Eco-Rise 50 Water Feature Stand is a simple product that can make the installation of heavy water features much easier. With a maximum load of 1300kg (1.3 metric tons) once a feature is placed on top of the stand it can be moved (slid) across smooth surfaces to ensure the feature is correctly positioned. This stand also has arches to allow pipework and power cables to be passed to the water feature without crushing or crimping. Manufactured from UV stable HDPE and covered by a 2 year guarantee Oase Eco-Rise 50 Water Feature Stand Dimensions 508mm diameter - 76mm high

item.g:title: Oase Stainless Steel Waterfall 30 - 30cm wide
item.g:description: The Oase Stainless Steel Waterfall 30 is a simple solution to creating 300mm wide waterfall or water chute in your garden. Made from high quality stainless steel (Grade 1.4401 V4A) they allow a single hose to supply water which is then internally baffled to create an even sheet of water 300mm wide over the 63mm deep lip. To increase the ease of installation these waterfalls have a connection at the back and the bottom, so one can be fitted with a connection hosetail and the other with a plug (both supplied). The supplied hosetail will accept 19mm, 25mm, 32mm or 38mm (¾", 1", 1¼" or 1½") flexible pipework, however we suggest the largest size hose that your pump can accept should be used. As with all waterfalls the flowrate required to ensure that the sheet is still wide enough when it hits the surface of the pond / reservoir is determined by both the width of waterfall and the installation height. See our sizing chart below to determine the correct pump size. Oase Stainless Steel Waterfall 30 Features High quality marine grade stainless steel (1.4401 V4A / 316) Single hose connection. Back or bottom connection position 63mm deep lip Can be wall mounted Dimensions: 300mm Wide x 100mm High x 140mm Total Depth Recommended Flowrate: 2500 - 4000 LPH (550 - 880 GPH) 2 year guarantee Important Installation Note The needs to be fed with water which is under pressure, for example from a pump or the outflow of a pressurised filter. Gravity feeds from a box type filter would not be suitable.

item.g:title: Smart Solar - Pagoda Solar Birdbath Water Feature
item.g:description: The Pagoda Solar Birdbath Water Feature takes inspiration from traditional Oriental pagoda architecture and would look attractive in most gardens, but particularly in a more formal area or within a Japanese styled water garden. Water is pumped up from a hidden reservoir to the top, where it bubbles over the integrated solar panel and gently pours out of each corner back to the bottom reservoir. This solar birdbath is made from highly detailed polyresin. Solar powered features are easy to install, can be moved around and have no running costs. Supplied with a 1 year guarantee. This upgraded version of the Chatsworth solar birdbath features a built-in water level sensor, which automatically shuts off the pump if the water level drops too low, helping to prevent damage. Dimensions: Height 720mm x Width 470mm x Depth 470mm. Pagoda Solar Birdbath Fountain Features: Traditional oriental design Operates in direct sunlight Integrated solar panel & pump system Built-in water level sensor for automatic shut-off protection 1 year guarantee Easy to install No running costs Please note that as frost can cause damage to this product, it should be stored indoors during cold weather. Please note that this product does not include a battery and requires direct sunlight to function.
item.g:product_type: Water Features > Self Contained Water Features > Solar Powered Water Features

item.g:title: Smart Solar - Chatsworth Tiered Solar Birdbath
item.g:description: An elegant two tiered solar bird bath which would look fantastic as a centrepiece to a lawn or patio. The pump, which is concealed in the base of the unit, pushes water up to the top of the feature, it then gently cascades down between the channels. With the solar panel built in to the design, you have no cable to worry about, but it does mean the whole feature must be positioned to receive direct sunlight to work. This solar birdbath is made from highly detailed polyresin. Solar water features are easy to install, can be moved around and have no running costs. Supplied with a 1 year guarantee. item.g:title: Smart Solar - Buddha Hybrid Solar Power Water Feature
item.g:description: The Buddha Hybrid Solar Power Water Feature depicts Buddha peacefully meditates to the sound of trickling water coming from the curtain of water falling down behind. Made from highly detailed resin and powered by a separate solar panel which connects via a 3m cable and includes integrated hybrid battery technology. The On / Off switch on the back of the panel allows the panel to run the pump and charge the battery when the sun is shining and when it is overcast the battery can power the pump on its own. Prior to special occasions the switch can be set to the Off position, this allows the panel to fully charge the battery, storing 5 hours of power for when the feature is switched back on. Supplied with a 1 year guarantee. Solar water features are easy to install, can be moved around and have no running costs. Buddha Hybrid Solar Water Feature Dimensions Height 590mm x Dia 400mm. item.g:description: The Wychwood Falls Hybrid Solar Water Feature is a highly detailed artificial log cascade water feature. Watch as the water cascades through different levels which creates a gentle trickling noise as it runs. Water is pumped from the base of the feature to the top pool and then it drops down through the feature. Made from highly detailed resin and powered by a separate solar panel which connects via a 3m cable and includes integrated hybrid battery technology. The On / Off switch on the back of the panel allows the panel to run the pump and charge the battery when the sun is shining and when it is overcast the battery can power the pump on its own. Prior to special occasions the switch can be set to the Off position, this allows the panel to fully charge the battery, storing 5 hours of power for when the feature is switched back on. Supplied with a 1 year guarantee. Solar water features are easy to install, can be moved around and have no running costs. Wychwood Falls Hybrid Solar Water Feature Dimensions Height 450mm x Width 570mm x Depth 380mm. Wychwood Falls Hybrid Solar Water Feature Features Operates in direct sunlight Integrated solar panel & pump system 1 year guarantee Easy to install No running costs Please note that as frost can cause damage to this product it should be stored indoors during cold weather.

item.g:title: Oase PondoVac 5 - Pond Vacuum
item.g:description: With the PondoVac 5 Oase have yet again made another major leap forward in pond vacuum technology. The PondoVac 5 design includes many of the features expected with their vacuums but most have been upgraded, however the biggest difference is the ability to pump the water away to waste. This feature overcomes one of the greatest draw backs of other pond vacuums, which is that the waste water escapes under gravity and as such can not go up hill or very far away. Inside the water chamber is a silt pump which will pump the dirty water through the 10m discharge hose and up to 2m above the pond vacuum, although the higher you lift it the slower the flow rate and suction will be. As the name suggest the silt pump will only handle small particles and so inside the water chamber is a pre-filter bag which will catch large particles such as pebbles or leaves, if your pond is full of large waste you may need to net these out first. As the water is being pumped away under pressure from the vacuum the discharge hose needs to be securely connected and Oase have solved this with a C-connection locking system. The PondoVac 5 has new wheels and tyres specifically designed for rough terrain, low-noise whilst in operation and a higher ground clearance . The PondoVac 5 has the same robust aluminium suction tubes and the 5 varied suction nozzles provided with the PondoVac 4. It is supplied with a 2 year guarantee which can be extended to 3 years by registering your purchase with Oase. You can extend the discharge hose of the Pondovac 5 with a 10m extension drain hose which has the same C-connection. Oase PondoVac 5 Pond Vacuum Features: Vacuum non-stop thanks to the patented two-chamber system - simultaneous vacuuming and emptying of the tank. Maximum suction depth of 2.5 m thanks to high-performance 1700 W motor with optimised blade geometry. 900w discharge pump allowing waste to be pumped up to 2m above vacuum Can be used for cleaning garden ponds, pools and swim ponds as well as a wet vacuum in the household. 4 robust, bend-resistant aluminium tubes. Transparent suction tube for flow-through visibility. Easy to move with large wheels for rough terrain and adjustable handle. Includes special universal nozzle, string algae nozzle, area nozzle, wet suction nozzle, brush nozzle Debris collection bag for retention of coarse particles 5m suction hose and 10m discharge hose. 2 year guarantee which can be extended to 3 years by registering your purchase with Oase. Oase PondoVac 5 Pond Vacuum Optional Accessories: 10m discharge extension
item.g:product_type: Pond Products > Looking After Your Pond and Fish > Pond Vacuums

item.g:title: Oase PondoVac Classic Pond Vacuum
item.g:description: The Oase PondoVac Classic Pond Vacuum is a purpose designed pond sludge vacuum cleaner, which can remove loose particles of dirt up to 10mm in size, algae, string algae, sludge, dead vegetation and bits of leaves from the pond by way of suction. The Oase PondoVac Classic Pond Vacuum has a 27 litre tank is made of impact resistant plastic and features a unique sludge draining system. The sludge is drawn through an adjustable suction nozzle (2-10mm) into the container via a 4m connecting hose. Once the container is full of sludge, the motor switches off automatically (Reed Switch). As soon as this happens a special valve at the end of the 2m long discharge hose opens automatically allowing the sludge to drain out of the tank. This takes approximately 25 seconds. The Oase PondoVac Classic Pond Vacuum then starts up again. Included are 3 extra vacuum style nozzles and a net for the discharge hose to catch large particles, such as leaves and blanket weed. Oase PondoVac Classic Pond Vacuum Features: 27 Litre Vacuum Tank 1400 Watt Motor 4m Vacuum Suction Hose 2m Discharge Hose 2 Year Guarantee
item.g:product_type: Pond Products > Looking After Your Pond and Fish > Pond Vacuums

item.g:title: Hozelock EasyClear 6000 Pond Filter
item.g:description: The EasyClear 6000 is a fully integrated "all-in-One" pond filtration unit which combines a pump, filter and UVC and can be completely hidden in the pond. The EasyClear 6000 provides clear and healthy water, easy installation and an attractive fountain and / or waterfall and is supplied with 10m of mains cable and a 3 year guarantee. The Easyclear 6000 in-pond filters offer the following benefits: Clear Healthy Water • The UVC eliminates green water. • Filter foam sieves out solid particles in the water. • Kaldness biomedia ensures that the water is healthy for fish and plants. • The Kaldness biomedia is stored under the foams in gauze bags for quick and easy cleaning. Fountain & Waterfall • Reliable and attractive fountain and waterfall display. • EasyClear 6000 can run a fountain and waterfall simultaneously. • 3 fountainhead options for different display choices. Easy Installation • One power cable for simple and cost effective installation. • Ball joint for easily levelling of the fountainhead. • Feet for stability. • Fountain stem extension for varying pond depths. • Independent flow controls to adjust the size of the fountain and or waterfall. Easy Maintenance • Latch for tool free access for cleaning foams and Kaldness biomedia. • Anti-clog fountain strainer for low maintenance. • Bayonet fitting for easy access to the UVC cleaning and changing. • Water bypass allows continued UVC and fountain operation if foam is blocked.
item.g:product_type: Pond Products > Pumping and Filtering your Pond > All In One - Pond Filters > Hozelock EasyClear Pond Filters

item.g:title: 6m x 6m (19ft 8 Inch x 19ft 8 Inch) 0.50mm (30 Year) PVC Pond Liner
item.g:description: This 6m x 6m (19ft 8 Inch x 19ft 8 Inch) PVC pond liner from Gordon Low is a tradition 0.5mm thick plastic pond liner which offers a budget alternative to rubber liners. Using only virgin PVC these liner have a very good resistance to UV damage come with a 30 year guarantee against material breakdown. Unfortunately as PVC liners are thinner and have very little flexibility they do not offer the same resistance to punctures as rubber liners, but when the budget is tight and you need an alternative to rubber these high quality PVC liners from Gordon Low can be a great option for both ponds and water features. This 6m x 6m liner is a total of 36 square metres and could be used to create a rectangular nature or fish pond of up to 4.2m long x 4.2m wide x 0.6m deep or a circular nature or fish pond of up to 4.2m diameter x 0.6m deep (assuming a 0.3m wide top overlap).

item.g:title: 250 gram - 2m (6ft 6 Inch) wide Underlay per linear metre
item.g:description: Our top-quality 250gm/m² pond liner underlay is designed to provide exceptional protection against roots and punctures. Made from a densely woven fibre, this high-density material is engineered for durability and long-lasting performance. Key Features: Superior Durability: Our 250gm/m² pond liner underlay is constructed from a high-quality, densely woven fibre that is both root resistant and puncture resistant, ensuring maximum protection for your liner. Exceptional Strength: So robust that even our in-house cutting process is challenged by its density, this underlay is recommended for those seeking the best protection for their pond liners. Easy Application: Supplied in a 2m (6ft 6in) wide roll, the underlay is designed for straightforward installation, providing a reliable barrier for your pond. Cost-Effective Solution: An affordable choice for high-quality pond liner protection. Invest in our premium 250gm/m² pond liner underlay for unbeatable durability and effective liner protection. Perfect for DIY pond projects and professional installations, this underlay is the ideal solution to safeguard your pond liner and extend its lifespan. Where Should This Pond Liner Underlay Be Used? This standard 250g/m² pond liner underlay is mainly intended for use beneath the pond liner as a protective layer between the liner and the prepared ground. It helps reduce the risk of punctures caused by stones, roots, rough soil and other sharp points below the liner. We recommend laying underlay across the pond base, shelves and sides before fitting the pond liner. If more than one strip of underlay is needed, overlap the edges so there are no gaps where the liner could press directly against the ground. This underlay is suitable for use beneath Greenseal EPDM pond liner , Elevate PondGard / Firestone EPDM pond liner , Butyl rubber pond liner and PVC pond liner . Should this underlay go under or over the pond liner? This standard underlay is mainly intended to go under the pond liner, between the prepared ground and the liner. This helps protect the liner from stones, roots and rough ground beneath the pond. Underlay can also be used above the liner in areas where rocks or stonework may rub against the liner surface, but if the material may remain visible, our black pond liner underlay / overlay is usually the more discreet choice.

item.g:title: Oase BioPress 10000 Pond Filters
item.g:description: The Oase BioPress 10000 Pond Filter offer easy and convenient cleaning of the internal filters via the cleaning mechanism. Quick release lid clips also provide easy filter opening and closing for maintenance purposes when required. With different grades of filtration foam for optimal waste removal, the 10000 also has 20 bio-surface balls to allow high levels of friendly bacteria to colonise the filter. The Oase BioPress 10000 includes an integral Ultra Violet Light with an indicator window which makes it simple to see at night if the UV bulb is working. The Oase BioPress filter can be hidden at the side of a pond or buried in the ground up to the level of hose inlets and the pressurised design of the filter allows the water to be pumped to a higher exit point to feed waterfalls and streams and unlike other filter units the outflow water pipe can rise up to 2m from the filter location (provided the pump is powerful enough). Supplied with a 2 year product guarantee and has Oases' a clear water guarantee. Oase BioPress - Main Features • Integrated Cleaning System • Includes Bio-Surface Bio balls • Single ended PLS UV lamp • UVC Viewing window • Can be buried up to lid level • True "Dry Hand" cleaning • 3m Main Cable • 2 Year Guarantee

item.g:title: Oase FiltoClear 5000 - Pond Filter
item.g:description: The Oase FiltoClear 5000 pressurised pond filters are a highly developed range of pressurised filters which have outstanding filtration properties, are easy to maintain and have been redesigned and updated. The Oase FiltoClears' now have an improved and unique, easy to operate built-in cleaning system. Simply remove the discharge cap, connect your waste hose (not supplied), pump the cleaning handle up and down removing all the waste and turn the valve to discharge. The benefit of a pressurised filter is the ability for it to be lower than the discharge point, which in many cases makes it easier to conceal. The Oase FiltoClear pond includes an integral ultra violet light with an indicator window which makes it simple to see at night if the UV bulb is working. The new design release in 2022 offers several improvements on the previous range - Easier to Clean mechanism, higher wattage lamps, no need to remove the quartz sleeve when changing the lamp, metal clamping ring and a hood over the UV electrical unit. All FiltoClears' are supplied with 5m of mains cable and a 2 year guarantee, which can be increased to 3 years by sending off the guarantee card to Oase. item.g:title: Oase BioSmart 7000 Set - Easy Clean Pond Filter Kit
item.g:description: The OASE BioSmart 7000 filter sets are an introductory package from Oase, combining the Ultra Violet Light and Filter in one simple system. The OASE BioSmart Filter sets ensure clear and healthy pond water thanks to the combination of a large filter foam surface and integrated UVC technology. The BioSmart's 7000 built in Ultra Violet, utilises a highly efficient PLS Ultra Violet bulb. The filter consists of foam cartridges suspended from a plate. To clean them simply pull the handles which compress the foam against the plate, squeezing out the waste. This waste and the remaining water is then run to waste via the integrated sludge outlet. The filter outlet is half way up the tank allowing partial burial if required, although the sludge drain is at the bottom of the tank and must be accessible for cleaning. The filters are supplied with a thermometer and 3m of cable for the integrated UVC. The 7000 and 14000 filters kits are combined with Oases' own range of pumps with 2 year guarantee to offer fantastic value. BioSmart 7000 Filter Set Features • Complete Kits for Goldfish and Koi ponds • Kit includes Filter, UV, Pump and Hose • In Filter cleaning with de-sludge • Mid outlet height for easy concealment • Oase "Clear Water Guarantee"

item.g:title: Oase - PVC Pond Liner Repair Kit
item.g:description: The PVC Pond Liner Repair Kit made by Oase, has everything you need to fix a small puncture in a PVC Pond Liner. A pond puncture can be a major financial and practical problem, especially in larger ponds. If the puncture can be located, the Oase PVC Pond Liner Repair Kit offers an alternative to replacing the whole liner. This kit includes a 75g tube of high-performance underwater adhesive which is perfectly safe to use with fish and plants. The adhesive is free from solvents and will bond and seal underwater. This kit also includes a 20cm wide x 40cm long strip of 0.5mm PVC liner which can be stuck with the adhesive to form a single patch or cut up to make multiple smaller patches. The area to which the adhesive is to be applied should be free from algae and limescale. Once applied a good bond will be achieved in 1 hour, however we would recommend that the liner is left to cure for 24 hours before refilling your pond. Please note that the minimum temperature required for the 24 hours curing time is 5 ° C

item.g:title: Pontec PondoFall - Watercourse Header
item.g:description: The Pontec PondoFall - Watercourse Header / Spillway Box is an easy to install compact stream or waterfall header pool, which can create a calm flat sheet of water at the start of your watercourse. Made of durable, weatherproof and UV resistant plastic the chute will take flow rates of between 1000 and 4000 litres (220 - 880 gallons) per hour. Supplied with a stepped hosetail which will take 20 and 25mm hose (¾", 1"), washer and an internal deflector which points the water down as it enters the main body ensuring a smooth surface of water travelling over the chute. The chute of the Pontec PondoFall - Watercourse Header measures 200mm wide (195mm lip) and is 150mm long. The reservoir measures max 265mm wide x 150mm deep x 165mm long giving a length from the lip to the back wall of the reservoir of 315mm. Pontec PondoFall - Dimensions Chute: 200mm wide (195mm lip) and is 150mm front to back. Reservoir: 265mm wide x 150mm deep x 165mm front to back Total unit size: 265mm wide x 150mm deep, with a length from the edge of lip to the back wall of the reservoir of 315mm. Pontec PondoFall - Watercourse Header Features • Simple solution to stream / waterfall header construction • Durable UV stable construction • 195mm (8") waterfall lip • 20 and 25mm (¾ and 1") pipe connection • 1000 - 4000 litres (220 - 880 gallons) per hour flowrate Important Installation Note The Pontec PondoFall - Watercourse Header needs to be fed with water which is under pressure, for example from a pump or the outflow of a pressurised filter. Gravity feeds from a box type filter would not be suitable.
item.g:product_type: Pond Products > Building Your Pond Or Water Feature > Stream or Waterfall Headers / Spillway
item.g:google_product_category: Lawn & Garden > Outdoor Decor > Water Fountains & Ponds

item.g:title: Pontec PondoFall LED - Watercourse Header / Water Blade
item.g:description: The Pontec PondoFall LED is an ideal way to create a water blade or sheet of water coming down your waterfall which will illuminated at night. Designed to be mostly hidden in the wall or rocks of the waterfall, the water can be fed into the unit from underneath or behind using either 19 or 25mm hose (¾", 1"). The maximum and recommended flowrate for the PondoFall LED is 6000 litres per hour. The LED lights are built into the chamber at the back with the power supply cable exiting at the rear. This unit has 8m of low voltage cable which connects to an IP65 weatherproof transformer which has 2m of mains cable. The water blade measures 300mm wide and protrudes out of the water chamber by 215mm. The water chamber measures 395mm wide x 70mm deep x 75mm high (excluding the inlet). item.g:title: Natural Stone Faced Liner 400mm Wide - Per Metre
item.g:description: This 400mm wide Natural Stone edging is ideal for disguising your liner at the edge of the pond, on a watercourse or beach areas. The 0.2 mm thick geotextile fabric which is treated with a coating of fine pebbles via a special technical process. As the backing material is water permeable this material is not suitable as a pond liner by itself and must be used in conjunction with either Greenseal, Firestone, Butyl or PVC liner. This product is perfect as a decorative covering in shallow streams and can also offer additional protection when placed over liners in the transition between the water surface and bank area. Due to its geotextile fabric backing material, this edging can be bonded to both rubber and PVC liners to keep it in place. The Natural Stone edging liner is sold by the metre and cut off a 400mm wide roll. Width: 400mm (sold per metre length) Please note the maximum single length is the full roll length, which is 16m

item.g:title: 290ml Gold Label Underwater Pond Sealant - Clear
item.g:description: 290ml Gold Label Underwater Pond Sealant bonds all materials even under water: Butyl Rubber, Vinyl, Glass, Plastic, Ceramic, Stone, Concrete and even wood - Solvent free so fine to use in ponds with fish still in place provided they do not ingest it. This 290ml tube of Gold Label Underwater Pond Sealant is designed to fit in to a mastic gun and has the familiar screw on nozzle which you cut the top off to alter the thickness of the bead. Size: 290ml Colour:- Clear Gold Label Underwater Sealant - Instructions for Use For best results clean all surfaces to be free from algae and grease etc. Place sealer directly onto the surface you wish to bond or seal. For bonding where there is movement (expansion or contraction) or different substrate, leave a minimum 5mm bead between surfaces. For joining liner, use two beads 15mm apart and leave to cure for 36 hours at ambient temperature and for a patch, run a continuous bead around the edge of the patch and gently press into place. DO NOT PRESS FLAT . Use A 5mm bead for optimum cure and bond strength. Initial cure 24 hours, continuing to harden up to 7 days. For use on concrete, first use a suitable primer. Store in dry conditions between 10 - 25°C Do not use below +10°C Not suitable for HDPE plastics and Polyex liners

item.g:title: Gold Label Pond Paint - Black - 1L
item.g:description: Gold Label Pond Paint - Colour: Black - Size: 1L Gold Label Black Pond Paint is a water based pond paint from the makers of the very popular Gold Label Underwater Sealant. There is no need for a primer and unlike other paints Gold Label Pond Paint only requires 2 coats (on a smooth surface). The 2 supplied components need to be combined and thoroughly mixed for 2 minutes. The paint can then be applied using a brush, roller or spray. The surface of your pond need not be completely dry as it can be applied over ‘damp’ surfaces. Gold Label Pond Paint has a coverage of 6-8 m² per litre per coat on non-porous smooth surfaces. Because the paint is water based it is much easier to clean up after yourself than resin based paints. The second coat of Gold Label Pond Paint can be applied when the first is touch dry (approx 6-8 hours at 20°C) so it is possible, given the correct conditions to get both layers on in one day. Gold Label Clear Pond cures in 12 hours and is fully cured in 3-7 days depending on atmospheric conditions. Gold Label Pond Paint Application Note Please remember to prepare you surface to be painted and fill any cracks before painting. If you are building a new concrete pond, a waterproofing additive should be added to the concrete during construction and add 10% more water to the first coat for surface penetration. For optimum results Gold Label Pond Paint should be applied with a paint roller. IMPORTANT To ensure correct drying this pond paint should be applied when it is dry and the air and surface temperature is at least 10 Deg C and less than 25 Deg C and will remain within that range for a FULL 24 hours. This product will take 3 - 7 days to fully cure before rinsing and filling with water. Paint Preparation The paint is a 2 part mixture with the hardener contained in a separate section of the paint tin (or separate container) and has a mixing ratio of 4 - 1. Surface Applications Gold Label Pond Paint is a universal water based epoxy resin coating which is suitable for concrete, tiles, blocks, fibreglass, brick and plastic (not steel). Gold Label Pond Paint Sizing and Coverage Options (on non-porous smooth surfaces) 1L - 6 - 8 m² per coat 2.5L - 15 - 20 m² per coat 5L - 30 - 40 m² per coat To ensure correct coverage a roller will help to apply a thin and consistent layer and on freshly rendered or porous surfaces add 10% more water to the first coat.

item.g:description: The OASE BioSmart 16000 filters are an introductory combined filter unit from Oase that include and integrated 11w Ultra Violet Light. The OASE BioSmart Filters ensure clear and healthy pond water thanks to the combination of a large filter foam surface and integrated UVC technology. The BioSmart's 16000 built in Ultra Violet, utilises a highly efficient PLS Ultra Violet bulb. The filter consists of foam cartridges suspended from a plate. To clean them simply pull the handles which compress the foam against the plate, squeezing out the waste. This waste and the remaining water is then run to waste via the integrated sludge outlet. The filter outlet is half way up the tank allowing partial burial if required, although the sludge drain is at the bottom of the tank and must be accessible for cleaning. The filters are supplied with a thermometer and 3m of cable for the integrated UVC. The 16000 BioSmart filters come with a 2 year guarantee to offer fantastic value. The outlet for this filter takes 75mm rigid of flexible hose pipe (not included) which can be purchased from the following pages: 76mm Outflow Rigid Pipe https://www.watergardeningdirect.com/acatalog/75mm-Oase-Rigid-Pipework.html 76mm Flexible Hosepipe https://www.watergardeningdirect.com/acatalog/Corrugated-Flexible-Hose-Pipe-76mm-3-Inch-ID-Per-Metre.html BioSmart 16000 Filter Set Features • Combined Filter for Goldfish and Koi ponds • Filter includes integrated 11w UVC • In Filter cleaning with de-sludge • Mid outlet height for easy concealment • Oase "Clear Water Guarantee" • 2 year guarantee

item.g:description: The Oase Midi 2 - 1.1kW (230v) Floating Lake Fountain is a simply stunning fountain which also helps to ensure high levels of oxygen within a lake or other large bodies of fresh water, The use of a pump with an integrated axial propeller produces an impressive 22,000 l/h flowrate to one of 4 optional nozzles. item.g:title: Oase BioSmart 18000 Pond Filters
item.g:description: Oase BioSmart 18000 Pond Filters use a combination of three grades of foams to produce a high level of mechanical and biological filtration. The unique design of the Oase BioSmart 18000 Pond Filters allows a Bitron or Vitronic 24/36 (purchased separately) to be attach to the side of the tank, not on the lid like many other systems, allowing the whole package to be hidden more effectively. The filter consists of foam cartridges suspended from a plate. To clean them simply pull the handles which compress the foam against the plate, squeezing out the waste. This waste and the remaining water is then run to waste via the integrated sludge outlet, which in the BioSmart 18000 is controlled through an internal valve lever. The filter outlet is half way up the tank allowing partial burial if required, although the sludge drain is at the bottom of the tank and must be accessible for cleaning. The BioSmart 18000 filters are supplied with a thermometer. In addition the BioSmart 18000 pond filters are supplied with an integrated pollutant level indicator, which signals the right time for cleaning. Supplied with a 3 year guarantee. The outlet for this filter takes 75mm rigid or flexible hose pipe (not included) which can be purchased from the following pages: 76mm Outflow Rigid Pipe https://www.watergardeningdirect.com/acatalog/75mm-Oase-Rigid-Pipework.html 76mm Flexible Hosepipe https://www.watergardeningdirect.com/acatalog/Corrugated-Flexible-Hose-Pipe-76mm-3-Inch-ID-Per-Metre.html Waste Sludge Outlet hosetails take 50mm hose. BioSmart 18000 Filter Features • In filter cleaning with de-sludge • Mid outlet height for easy concealment • Oase "Clear Water Guarantee" • Integrated thermometer and cleaning indicator • Multi foam grade for brilliant clarity • 3 year guarantee

item.g:title: Oase ProfiClear Premium Compact - M - Pond Filter - Pump Fed - ECG
item.g:description: The Oase ProfiClear Premium Compact - M - Pump Fed Pond are state of the art filters which produce fantastic clarity and water quality and even self-clean. The advanced filter system combines the self-cleaning technology and moving bed filtration principles of Oase Premium Modular Kits. Pond water enters the tank (normally via a Bitron UV which is sold separately) straight into the centre of the drum and flows out through the fine mesh sieves 80µm (micrometres) into the tank. Thanks to the drum technology, the debris which is trapped on the inside surface of the sieves is easily and automatically cleaned. An integrated water sensor measures when the drum needs cleaning and triggers the rotation of the drum and activates the water jets, which blasts the mesh clean. The debris and water are collected and drains out of the tank to waste. This cleaning process is achieved using a powerful, high-quality pressure pump which is mounted in the base of the tank. The mesh sieves are very easy to remove (no tools required) and the free-wheeling function makes for easy access to the drum interior. Rakes on the inside of the drum help prevent the sieves from being choked by algae. Not only does the filter have a maximum flowrate (12500 litres per hour) but to ensure it works correctly it also has a minimum flow (7500 litres per hour). The second stage in the filtration process is biological filtration. In this area the water is released from the perforated tube into the moving bed part of the filter, which contains 40 Litres of specially designed "Hel-X 13" biomedia. The water in this area is continually "moving" due to the release of air at a rate of 2500 LPH from the integrated aerator (air pump not included). This design of moving media in water, which is highly enriched with oxygen, is the ideal environment to ensure the highly efficient removal of toxins, ensuring perfect water conditions. The Oase ProfiClear Premium Compact - M - Pond Filter has a drain slide valve at the bottom of the tank which connects to Oase 75mm pipework. The filter is supplied with 2 year guarantee which can be upgraded to 3 years by registering with OASE. The filter controller is supplied with 5m of mains cable. The Oase ProfiClear Premium Compact - M - Pump Fed Pond Filter has a single 110mm (4") outlet pipe and 2 x 50mm inlet connections which are compatible with the Oase Bitron 72C - 110C and Oase Bitron Eco 120 -240 Ultra Violet Lights . OC (Oase Control) System The OASE ProfiClear Premium Compact - M has been upgraded to include Oases' OC (Oase Control) System, which give you the ability to connect this filter to the InScenio FM Master Cloud (OAE020) wireless control system. Once connected the InScenio FM Master Cloud will allow you to control all settings via the Oase APP on a smart phone or tablet. Oase ProfiClear Premium Compact - M - Pump Fed Pond Filter Features Intelligent filter system for 80000 litre natural ponds, 40000 litre +Goldfish or Swimponds or Koi Ponds 20000 litres The automatic fine debris extraction using drum filter technology Highly efficient "Moving Bed" for biological filtration using "Hel-X 13" biomedia Intelligent control functions Micro controller system monitors and controls the main functions Simple plug & play operation Powerful, high-quality integrated pressure pump for drum cleaning Incomparably quiet through extensive noise damping 80 µm debris cleaning sieves Pollutant rakes on the sieves for reliable removal of string algae Pollutant discharge including slide valve Pump Fed ( Gravity Fed version also available) Recommended Optional Extras: Oase AquaOxy 2500 Air Pump Oase Bitron Ultra Violet Light - 72C - 110C Oase Bitron Eco 120 -240 Ultra Violet Lights Oase 110mm Push Fit Pipe Oase 75mm Push Fit Rigid Pipe for waste 75mm Flexihose for waste Technical Specifications: Dimensions: Length 885m x Width 685mm x Height 820mm Power Consumption: 5 watts Power Consumption Cleaning: 670 watts Cable Length: 5m Net Weight: 80.5kg Biological Surface: 38.2m³ Temperture Display: Digital Scavenging Pump: 4 bar Number of sieve elements: 6 Filter intake surface: 1135cm³

item.g:title: Blagdon Liberty Solar Pond Oxygenator - Pulse Air Pump
item.g:description: With its unique design the Blagdon Liberty Solar Pond Oxygenator Pulse Air Pump runs from solar power and pulses air into the water. With 5 seconds of pumping and 12 seconds of rest, this air pump extends the life of the internal rechargeable battery which will ensure it keeps adding oxygen over a longer period than other solar air pumps. Sunlight hitting the solar panel produces more power than the air pump requires, and the excess is stored in the 3.7v Lithium Battery (1500mAH). When the panel is not receiving sunlight the stored back up power in the battery is released to run the air pump. In this way and with the pulsing effect the air pump will run for much longer periods than other models. This pump is limited in its output and should not be used as the only source of oxygen for the fish. Supplied with 2 air stones, 2 x 1.8m airlines, 2 x air stones floats, 5m of cable, pump (max flow 60 LPH), panel (0.8 watts), ground spike, wall bracket and a 3 year guarantee. Please note the solar panel needs to be in direct sunlight
item.g:product_type: Pond Products > Pumping and Filtering your Pond > Pond Air Pumps
item.g:google_product_category: Animals & Pet Supplies > Pet Supplies > Fish Supplies > Aquarium & Fish Tank Accessories

item.g:title: Pontec PondoSolar Air 150 Plus Air Pump
item.g:description: If you want to add oxygen to a wildlife pond or simply boost the oxygen in your fish pond, the Pontec PondoSolar 150 Plus Air Pump is an ideal solution - solar powered so no need for a mains connection and with a panel which is located out of the pond. The air pump is built on to the back of the solar panel and can generate up to 80 litres per hour through the single air stone. Alongside the air pump is a battery and a switch with 3 settings. The Pontec PondoSolar 150 Plus Air Pump has 3 modes of operation: Direct Daylight Mode: The aerator pump only operates when there is sufficient sunlight. Any surplus power is stored in the rechargeable battery. Charge Only Mode: The aerator pump is switched off' the rechargeable battery is charged. Night Running Mode: The aerator pump switches on automatically when it is sufficiently dark and is powered by the rechargeable battery. When there is sufficient sunlight, the pump is switched off and the rechargeable battery is charged. The Pontec PondoSolar 150 Plus Air Pump is supplied with 1 air stone, 2m of air pipe, a pump/panel, a ground spike, a wall bracket and a 2 year guarantee. Please note that the panel needs to be in direct sunlight and as the pump is limited in its output, it should not be used as the only source of oxygen for the fish. Pontec PondoSolar 150 Plus Air Pump Features Simple Installation, air pump built in to solar panel Can be used in daylight or at night Simple operation 3.7 V 2000 mAh LI-ion rechargeable battery 1w solar panel 80 LPH 6V air pump 2 year guarantee

item.g:title: Oase AquaAir ECO 250 - Lake Aerator
item.g:description: The Oase AquaAir ECO 250 - Lake Aerator is part of the Lake Management range and is a high performance floating Aerator with an integrated pump, which will greatly enhance the Oxygenation of ponds and lakes with a surface area of up to 250 metres square. The Aqua Air 250 LM enriches the water with vital oxygen to aid the development of helpful bacteria, which can decompose contaminants such as ammonia and nitrite as well as preventing odours and silt through stagnation. Unlike fixed air systems the Oase Aqua Air 250 is free floating and can be positioned in quieter parts of a lake that can be particularly prone to low oxygenation due to poor water movement. This high quality Aerator can operate in as little as 500mm of water and its powerful integrated motor can generate up to 26000 litres per hour through the Venturi injector nozzle, which can be rotated to penetrate in to shallow or deep water zones of up to 4m below the surface. Re-designed in 2022 the ECO version of the Oase AquaAir 250 can now be used with the Oase Control (OC) system to adjust the flowrate which reduces the power consumption to between 60w - 440w per hour ( InScenio FM Master or Oase Cloud Controller required, but not included). In addition it also features the Oase Environmental Function Control system which adds Pump blockage and dry run protection. Supplied with a 30m cable, fixing kit and 3 year guarantee. item.g:title: Oase AirFlo 1500 Floating Lake Aerator
item.g:description: The Oase AirFlo LM 1.5kW Floating Lake Aerator is a high-performance floating aeration system designed to improve oxygen levels in lakes and large ponds. Using an integrated axial propeller pump, the unit produces an impressive 165,000 l/h flow rate and includes three interchangeable nozzles to create a choice of decorative water displays. Part of the Oase Lake Management range, the AirFlo LM is suitable for ponds and lakes with surface areas of up to 5,000m². The system helps improve water circulation and oxygenation, supporting beneficial bacteria which break down contaminants such as ammonia and nitrite. Increased oxygen levels and improved circulation can also help reduce stagnant areas, odours and sludge build-up. As well as improving water quality, the AirFlo LM creates an attractive floating fountain display suitable for ornamental lakes, fisheries, golf courses and commercial water features. Unlike fixed fountain systems, the floating design can be installed in deeper water and repositioned if required. The unit is supplied with an anchor kit for secure installation. Installation is quick and straightforward: Place the floating unit into the water and secure using the included anchor kit Select and attach the required nozzle using the bayonet fitting Connect the unit to a suitable power supply The unit is supplied with an earthing pin plug, control box and 50m power cable for installation. You can also enhance the appearance of the AirFlo LM 1.5kW with compatible Oase lighting sets to create an impressive night-time display. Both the Oase LunAqua LED Floating Fountain Illumination White and RGB light sets are compatible with the AirFlo range, although they are limited to a 20m cable length. Oase AirFlo LM Floating Lake Aerator Features Bayonet Technology Quick-fit connection system for fast installation and changing of the three included fountain nozzles. Anchor Kit Included Supplied with 3 x 30m ashore lines and stakes for secure anchoring of the floating aerator. Earthing Pin and Control Box Included Supplied with control box, earthing pin and 50m power cable for straightforward installation. item.g:title: Hozelock Bioforce Revolution 6000 Pond Filter
item.g:description: The Hozelock Bioforce Revolution 6000 is the next generation of pressurised pond filtration from the company that first introduced pressurised pond filters over 25 years ago. As a result of a 5 year development and design program, the Hozelock Bioforce Revolution 6000 pond filter features a revolutionary patented easy clean system. Small in size but large in features it's 3 step filter process produces Clear and Healthy Water with simple dry hand cleaning. 1. The integrated high power UV Clarifier will eliminate green water and is contained in a quick access chamber for trouble free bulb replacement. For enhanced performance it also features a viewing window that glows when operating and an integrated turbulator to improve circulation. 2. Mechanical Filtration - The Hozelock Bioforce Revolution 6000 features a unique filtration process which uses foam cubes (CypriCube) with upward foam compression to catch dirt particles. The dirtier the filter gets, the finer the particles it can catch. 3. Biological Filtration - The use of large surface area K1™ K3 biological media in the Hozelock Bioforce Revolution 6000 accommodates huge quantities of beneficial bacteria to maintain healthy water. Simple, Dry Hand Cleaning Turn the top dial to the "Flush" position to direct the water down the cleaning pipe (to waste) Wind the handle to activate the internal cleaning blades that separate solids from the Cypricube foams. Wait for the water which is flowing out of the cleaning pipe to run clear Turn the top dial to the "Run" position The Hozelock Bioforce Revolution 6000 can be hidden at the side of a pond or buried in the ground up to the level of hose inlets and the pressurised design of the filter allows the water to be pumped to a higher exit point to feed waterfalls and streams Hozelock Bioforce Revolution 6000 - Main Features Unique Foam Cubes (CypriCube) Filtration K1 K3™ Biomedia included UV Water Turbulator Single ended UV 18w lamp UVC Viewing Point Can be buried up to lid level True "Dry Hand" cleaning 5m Main Cable 2 Year Guarantee

item.g:title: Oase FiltoClear 19000 - Pond Filter
item.g:description: The Oase FiltoClear 19000 pressurised pond filters are a highly developed range of pressurised filters which have outstanding filtration properties, are easy to maintain and have been redesigned and updated. The Oase FiltoClears' now have an improved and unique, easy to operate built-in cleaning system. Simply remove the discharge cap, connect your waste hose (not supplied), pump the cleaning handle up and down removing all the waste and turn the valve to discharge. The benefit of a pressurised filter is the ability for it to be lower than the discharge point, which in many cases makes it easier to conceal. The Oase FiltoClear pond includes an integral ultra violet light with an indicator window which makes it simple to see at night if the UV bulb is working. The new design release in 2022 offers several improvements on the previous range - Easier to Clean mechanism, higher wattage lamps, no need to remove the quartz sleeve when changing the lamp, metal clamping ring and a hood over the UV electrical unit. The FiltoClear 19000 also include the patented UV cleaning rotor to help keep the quartz sleeve clean to maximise their efficiency . All FiltoClears' are supplied with 5m of mains cable and a 2 year guarantee, which can be increased to 3 years by sending off the guarantee card to Oase. Also included are 4 hosetails, one each for the in, out and discharge hoses and one for the other end of the discharge hose Oase FiltoClear 19000 Pressurised Pond Filter Features • Combination of mechanical biological cleaning and effective UVC technology • Including OASE Clear Water Guarantee*C • Ideal for supplying higher elevated watercourses or waterfalls • Setup below the surface level of the water is also possible • Patented Easy-Clean-Technology for easy and convenient cleaning without opening the filter • Easy-to-operate waste outlet function • UVC indicator light for monitoring of the UVC clarifier • Pollutant level indicator and flow-through indicator • All function-regulating parts are arranged so that they are easily accessible in the cover • Through burying or covering with a decorative rock cover it can be perfectly integrated in the water garden • Perfectly suited for architectural pools thanks to virtually invisible technology • High-quality, impact-resistant material • Patented UV Quartz Sleeve Cleaning Rotor

item.g:title: Hozelock EcoPower Plus 4000 Pond Filter
item.g:description: The Hozelock EcoPower Plus 4000 pond filters are simple and effective combined filter units which have a high outflow position, making them easy to hide. These "box type" filters are made with high quality modern materials and incorporate both mechanical and biological filtration materials (Kaldness K3 and foam) and an integrated high wattage (8w) UVC. Water is pumped from your pond (pump sold separately) into the UVC which is mounted in the filter lid via a 25, 32, or 40 mm (1", 1¼", 1½") hose. The UVC chamber features a “turbulator” to ensure that the water is exposed correctly to the UV light produced by the UV bulb. This clumps the algae that causes green water together. Next, the water passes through a Venturi to aeration before passing into the bottom of the filter, through the biological media, and then rises up through the foam filters , before exiting the filter through the 40mm outflow connection. To aid cleaning, this filter also has a desludge connection near the bottom. Supplied with a 2 year guarantee and a 5m power cable Hozelock EcoPower Plus 4000 Combined Filter Features Combined filtration using sheet foam and Kaldness K3 plastic media Built in 8w UV Clarifier Inlet control valve on smaller models Simple effective mechanical and biological filtration Integrated Venturi aerator Clear Water Guarantee Maximum Flowrate : 2000 LPH (440 GPH) Maximum Goldfish Pond Size: 5500 litres (1210 gallons) Maximum Koi Pond Size: 3000 litres (660 gallons)

item.g:title: Oase LunAqua LED - Floating Fountain Illumination - White (3 Light Set) for PondJet / AirFlo / MIDI / MAXI Fountains
item.g:description: This is the Oase LunAqua LED - Floating Fountain Illumination - White (3 Light Set) for the Oase Pond PondJet / AirFlo / MIDI / MAXI floating fountain pump for large pond displays. An illuminated fountain has a particularly beautiful effect in the evening and hours of darkness. The Oase LunAqua Power LED Light Set uses a 5.8 watt LED in each light which produces 580 lumens of light (equivalent to a 50w halogen bulb) to ensure an outstanding illumination of the water pattern. The Oase LunAqua LED - Floating Fountain Illumination - White set includes: 3 x Pond Jet LED OC - White Lights (Profi Lux) 1 x Controller with a 20 mains cable 1 x OC Connecting Cable (20m) 3 x Pond Jet LED OC - Light mounting brackets. If you wish to remotely control the lights a FM-Master Cloud OC Switch Box (sold separately) is required, it can be used to provide power to the Floating Fountain Light Controller, but most important it allows you to connect the OC cable from the FM-Master Cloud to the light controller. Once connected the FM-Master Cloud can be accessed from a smart phone or tablet using the Oase App and with the introduction of the "Oase Cloud" you can control your OC compatible products from anywhere in the in world. This allows you to switch the lights on/off remotely but also gives access to on/off timer function. Oase LunAqua LED - Floating Fountain Illumination - White (3 Light Set) is covered by a 2 year guarantee, which can be extended to 3 years by registering the guarantee with Oase. Please note that this is the Power LED light set for the Pond Jet Eco Fountain which is not included. For the complete Fountain and Power LED light kit, click here
item.g:product_type: Pond Products > Pumping and Filtering your Pond > Pond Fountain Pumps and Accessories > Oase Pond Jet Eco Fountain and Light Sets

item.g:title: Oase LunAqua LED - Floating Fountain Illumination - RGB - EGC (3 Light Set) for PondJet / AirFlo / MIDI / MAXI Fountains
item.g:description: The Oase LunAqua LED - Floating Fountain Illumination - RGB - Oase Control (OC) (3 Light Set) is a magical addition to the PondJet / AirFlo / MIDI / MAXI Fountains pump. An illuminated fountain has a particularly beautiful effect in the evening and hours of darkness. The Oase LunAqua LED - Floating Fountain Illumination - RGB - OC uses high powered RGB LED's in each light to produce a wide range of static or changing colours ensuring an outstanding illumination of the water pattern. Straight out of the box the light sequence is preset but by connecting them to a FM-Master Cloud Switch Box (see below) you have access to over 10 preset colour changing displays. The Oase LunAqua LED - Floating Fountain Illumination - RGB - OC includes: 3 x Pond Jet LED OC - RGB Lights (Profi Lux) 1 x Controller with a 20 mains cable 1 x OC Connecting Cable (20m) 3 x Pond Jet LED OC - RGB Light mounting brackets. Please note that a FM-Master Cloud OC Switch Box (sold separately) is required to control this light set. The FM-Master Cloud has 2 functions, it can be used to provide power to the Floating Fountain Light Controller, but most important it allows you to connect the OC cable from the FM-Master Cloud to the light controller. Once connected the FM-Master Cloud can be accessed from a smart phone or tablet using the Oase App and with the introduction of the "Oase Cloud" you can control your OC compatible products from anywhere in the in world. This allows the colour sequences to be changed or fixed on the same colour and gives access to on/off timer function. Oase LunAqua LED - Floating Fountain Illumination - RGB - OC (3 Light Set) is covered by a 2 year guarantee, which can be extended to 3 years by registering the guarantee with Oase.

item.g:title: Oase Aquarius Eco Expert 22000 Fountain Pump
item.g:description: The Oase Aquarius Eco Expert 22000 is the latest version of the Oase high performance Aquarius range of large fountain pumps. The Oase Aquarius Eco Expert is even more energy efficient than its predecessors and requires up to 30% less energy, making a major reduction of the running costs. The Oase Aquarius Eco Expert 22000 features Oase's unique EFC Function (Environmental Function Control), which automatically switches the pump off to prevent damage when it senses dry running. In addition, these pump include frost protection to temperatures as low as -20°C. The high quality stainless steel inlet grill allows particles of up to 4mm to pass through These pumps include an adapter set which allows the connection of both 1" and 1½" Oase fountain attachments as well as 38mm / 50mm (1½" / 2") hose connections. All Oase Aquarius Eco Expert pumps are covered by a 3 year guarantee, which can be extended to 5 years free of charge, simply by sending the warranty card off to Oase. Oase Aquarius Eco Expert 22000 Fountain Pump Features • Brilliant power balance: Reliable flowrates at lower power consumption • Unique, patented frost protection: to -20°C • Delivery rate is controllable mechanically and electronically • Quiet running • Will pump particles of up to 4mm in size • "Environmental Function Control" (EFC by OASE) protects against dry-run or blocking • Very high flowrate 22000 litres per hour • Can be dry mounted or submerged • Large stable base and handle • Top outlet position • Up to 5 years warranty • OASE Control compatible • Oase Eco Control Compatible This pump is part of the Oase Control (OC) range. With the addition of an FM Master Cloud or Oase Cloud Controller, you can monitor and control your pump via the Oase App. See the "Other OC Products Tab" below for other OC compatible products. If you only need local control of this pump, then the Oase Eco Pump Control can be used instead of the full OC system. Optional Extras – Oase Fountain Heads Oase Vulkan Fountain Jet 43-3 Fountain Head Oase Extra Large Foam Jet Fountain Heads

item.g:description: If you find your fountain nozzle or fittings keep getting blocked up with small pieces of waste or are concerned for the safety of Newts, tadpoles or fish fry then the Oase Pump Shield could be the solution. The bag measures 500mm x 500mm and has an opening along one side in to which you place your pump, you then seal this opening with a drawstring and toggle. The bag is made from strong wildlife friendly plastic and has a 1.5mm mesh size so will stop very small particles or creatures. • Suitable for most Filter and Fountain Pumps • Easily fitted and removed • Protects Newts, Tadpoles and Fish Fry

item.g:title: Oase BioTec 40000 - ScreenMatic 2 Pond Filters
item.g:description: With the introduction of the BioTec 40000 ScreenMatic 2 Filters Oase have shown that they are always innovating and improving their pond filters. The New and upgraded BioTec ScreenMatic 2 range now features an improved coarse debris system and electronic control system. Simple operation, fast, clean maintenance and outstanding filtration are the results. A specially designed sieve catches all debris particles above 300 microns that arrive in the filter. The sieve has been designed as a belt which rotates when dirty via a built-in 12v motor and is scraped clean as it turns. The dirt build up on the screen is monitored by a new sensor system which only operates the 12v motor when needed, thus saving running costs and wear and tear. The waste falls in to an increased capacity tray for disposal. The water which is enriched with oxygen, then falls into the chamber below, flows through the filter zones and then reaches the next filter chamber. The friendly filter bacteria present in the pond water settle and multiply in the oxygen rich sponges. The individual chamber situated just in front of the outlet holds a number of Zeolite filled cartridges which are ideal when starting up the filter. Once established the material inside can be changed to PhosLess (not supplied) which will help prevent algae growth in the pond. Each filter is also supplied with a plunger to allow for easy cleaning of the foam cartridges and a brush to aid cleaning of the belt. Once the foams have been squeezed out a valve is pulled and the dirty water drains from the tank. The drain is at the bottom of the BioTec 40000 ScreenMatic 2 Filter is 50mm. The Oase BioTec 40000 - ScreenMatic 2 Pond Filters are supplied with a 2 year guarantee which can be upgraded to 3 years by registering your purchase with Oase. The outlet for this filter takes 75mm rigid pushfit pipework or 75mm flexible pipework (not included). Oase BioTec 40000 ScreenMatic 2 Pond Filter Features • Intelligent filter system for fish ponds up to 20m³ (20000 litres) • The automatic coarse debris extraction using "conveyer belt" sieve technology • High quality filter sponges for biological filtration • Intelligent control functions • Simple plug & play operation • 300 µm first stage cleaning sieves • Pollutant discharge using included slide valve

item.g:title: Evolution Aqua Nexus Eazy 220+ Filter
item.g:description: The Nexus 220+Pond Filters from Evolution Aqua incorporate the industry proven moving bed media coupled with the innovative Eazy mechanical filter which combine to provide outstanding water clarity and quality. The Nexus 220+can be pump or gravity fed and cleverly combine mechanical and biological pond filtration to create an effective, high performance filtration system. The Nexus 220+ revolutionise the way ponds are filtered and are also extremely easy to clean and maintain, with minimal running costs. Building on the fantastic reputation of the previous models the 220+have an Eazy filter which now utilises K1 Micro Filter Media in a static bed to deliver improved levels of mechanical filtration. The Nexus Eazy 220+ now also use the acclaimed K+ media in the moving bed to deliver outstanding levels of biological filtration. K+Media has revolutionised pond filtration since its launch in 2019. With the ability to filter particles down to just one micron, its advanced profile enhances water flow while providing a vast protected surface area of 1,025m² per m³ – equivalent to five tennis courts. The unique manufacturing process, enriched with minerals and enzymes, accelerates media maturation, outperforming conventional filter media. Independently tested by IFTS and Cranfield University, K+Media ensures unmatched filtration efficiency. Together this combination of filter media works to deliver crystal clear and healthy water. Nexus 220+ Pond Filter Features Fantastic water quality and clarity Low running costs Works pump or gravity fed K+ media for faster maturation Mechanical and biological stage in one unit Biological capacity that can grow with your fish, just add more media Internal Overflow Easy to Clean and Maintain

item.g:title: Blagdon Affinity View Corner Freestanding Pond
item.g:description: The Blagdon Affinity View Corner Pool is a compact corner pond which can bring the relaxing sound of moving water and the enjoyment of watching wildlife to a corner in almost any garden. Supplied as a kit which includes the waterfall, super strong fibre reinforced liner, framework, decorative panels, 3 shatterproof circular windows (17cm diameter), one planting basket and the Inpond 5 in 1 2000 pump with built in LED light (optional UVC light available separately). The liner is made to fit and so avoids too many creases and folds and has eyelets for easy connection to the frame. The windows are part of the liner, so you do not have to worry about ensuring watertight seals. The Inpond 5 in 1 2000 pump and filter comes with a built in automatic night time LED spotlight which is mounted on top of the pump body, both are powered by a single 10m mains cable. This pump will circulate, oxygenate and filter the fishes solid and liquid waste. The Affinity View pools are the smallest of the Affinity range and Affinity View Half Moon Pool has a volume of 140 litres,, the perfect size to enjoy fish and plants. Supplied with a 3 year guarantee. Pond Dimensions: Pond Height 46cm (with waterfall 58cm) x Width 60cm x Depth 60cm. item.g:title: Blagdon Affinity 5w UVC Upgrade Kit
item.g:description: The Blagdon Affinity 5w UVC Upgrade Kit is an upgrade for the Blagdon inpond 5 in 1 filter 2000 or a replacement for the 3000 (previously 1400 all in one). The filter bodies of the Blagdon 5 in1 pond filter have been designed so that this upgrade kit can simply be slid horizontally into the side of the unit making it a very easy fit. As the water passes through the filter it will be treated by the UV light and the green water algae will be flocculated (clumped) together so that they can be removed by the filter foam, leading to clear water. Supplied with 13 meters of cable which is made up of 3m between the UVC and the weatherproof (IP68 rated) starter and 10m from the starter to your mains connection. The 3m of cable between the UVC and the starter should be enough to get you to the edge of any suitable ponds. 2 year guarantee.

item.g:title: Oase BioPress 4000 Pond Filter Set
item.g:description: The Oase BioPress filtration sets consist of a BioPress pressure filter with integrated UVC, suitable Oase filter pump, hose and all the hose connections for fast installation. The BioPress pressurised filters offer easy and convenient cleaning of the filter via the external cleaning mechanism and quick-release clips, which provide easy filter opening and closing for maintenance purposes. The BioPress Filters include different filter materials for optimal settlement of filter biology and can be almost completely buried for almost invisible integration in the water garden. The BioPress filtration sets come with a clear water guarantee and create a healthy climate for pond inhabitants and the included Oase filter pump has a 2 year guarantee.

item.g:title: Hozelock Bioforce Revolution 6000 Pond Filter Kit
item.g:description: The Hozelock Bioforce Revolution 6000 Pond Filter Kit is the next generation of pressurised pond filtration, from the company who first introduced pressurised pond filters over 25 years ago. As a result of a 5 year development and design program the Hozelock Bioforce Revolution Pond filter features a revolutionary patented easy clean system. Small in size, but large in features its 3 step filter process produces Clear and Healthy Water with simple dry hand cleaning. 1. The integrated high power UV Clarifier will eliminate green water and is contained in a quick access chamber for trouble free bulb replacement. For enhanced performance it also features a viewing window that glows when operating and integrated turbulator to improve circulation. 2. Mechanical Filtration - The Hozelock Bioforce Revolution features a unique filtration process which uses foam cubes (CypriCube) with upward foam compression to catch dirt particles. The dirtier the filter gets, the finer the particles it can catch. 3. Biological Filtration - The use of large surface area K1™ K3 biological media in the Hozelock Bioforce Revolution accommodates huge quantities of beneficial bacteria to maintain healthy water. Simple, Dry Hand Cleaning • Turn the top dial to the "Flush" position to direct the water down the cleaning pipe (to waste) • Wind the handle to activate the internal cleaning blades that separate solids from the Cypricube foams. • Wait for the water which is flowing out of the cleaning pipe to run clear • Turn the top dial to the "Run" position The Hozelock Bioforce Revolution 6000 Pond Filter can be hidden at the side of a pond or buried in the ground up to the level of hose inlets and the pressurised design of the filter allows the water to be pumped to a higher exit point to feed waterfalls and streams Hozelock Bioforce Revolution 6000 Pond Filter - Main Features • Unique Foam Cubes (CypriCube) Filtration • K1 K3™ Biomedia included • UV Water Turbulator • Single ended UV lamp • UVC Viewing Point • Can be buried up to lid level • True "Dry Hand" cleaning • 5m Main Cable • 2 Year Guarantee Hozelock Aquaforce - Filter Pumps The Hozelock Aquaforce range of pumps offer improved efficiency, performance and reliability. The range has been specifically designed for filtration, waterfalls or watercourses and offers a cost effective flowrate in terms of initial purchase and running costs. The new robust all-in-one cage design is quick and simple to open, but offers a considerably increased cage surface area, allowing the maximum amount of waste to be collected and pumped to the filter system. It also means that the cage is far less likely to clog reducing the need for cleaning. Included with the pump is the new wildlife protection insert, which allows you to reduce the inlet solids diameter from 6-10mm (depending on model) down to 2mm. This prevents wildlife such as Tadpoles, Newts and small fish getting into the cage. The motors feature a water cooling system, which ensures that the pumps are kept at a constant temperature and reduces the risk of overheating. Ceramic bearings along with thrust washers ensure the motors are ultra reliable. The larger models (6, 8, 12 and 15000) are able to operate either in or out of the pond, they also feature a second inlet, which allows an optional skimmer or satellite filter Additionally the included flow control allows the flow of water to be adjusted to suit your installation. Supplied with 10m of cable and hosetail for 20, 25, 32, and 40mm connection sizes. Due to their proven reliability Hozelock have now increased the guarantee on the Aquaforce pumps to 5 years.

item.g:title: Oase FiltoClear 5000 Filtration Set
item.g:description: The Oase FiltoClear 5000 pressurised pond filters sets are a highly developed range of pressurised filters and top quality pumps which have outstanding filtration properties and are easy to maintain. Oase FiltoClear 5000 Pressurised Pond Filter Sets Features Combination of mechanical biological cleaning and effective UVC technology Including OASE Clear Water Guarantee Ideal for supplying higher elevated watercourses or waterfalls Setup below the surface level of the water is also possible Patented Easy-Clean-Technology for easy and convenient cleaning without opening the filter Easy-to-operate waste outlet function UVC indicator light for monitoring of the UVC clarifier Pollutant level indicator and flow-through indicator All function-regulating parts are arranged so that they are easily accessible in the cover Through burying or covering with a decorative rock cover it can be perfectly integrated in the water garden Perfectly suited for architectural pools thanks to virtually invisible technology High-quality, impact-resistant material Industry leading Oase Aquamax Eco Premium Filter Pumps Highly Developed FiltoClear 5000 Pressurised Pond Filter The Oase FiltoClears now have an improved and unique, easy to operate built-in cleaning system. Simply remove the discharge cap, connect your waste hose (not supplied), pump the cleaning handle up and down removing all the waste and turn the valve to discharge. The benefit of a pressurised filter is the ability for it to be lower than the discharge point, which in many cases makes it easier to conceal. The Oase FiltoClear includes an integral ultra violet light with an indicator window which makes it simple to see at night if the UV bulb is working. The newest design release in 2022 offers several improvements on the previous range - Easier to Clean mechanism, higher wattage lamps, no need to remove the quartz sleeve when changing the lamp, metal clamping ring and a hood over the UV electrical unit. All FiltoClears are supplied with 5m of mains cable and a 2 year guarantee, which can be increased to 3 years by sending off the guarantee card to Oase. Also included are 4 hosetails, one each for the in, out and discharge hoses and one for the other end of the discharge hose. New Top Quality Oase Aquamax Eco Premium 5000 Filter Pumps In 2024 Oase have redesigned the motor for the Aquamax Eco Premium resulting in a quieter, more energy efficient pump (14 - 24% depending on model) which should last longer than their older models (that is saying something). The new motor incorporates Oase's Core 6 Technology with six windings instead of the traditional 4, these windings have also been curved giving smoother running enhancing efficiency and making them quieter. The impellors have been improved and are now effectively handmade glass-fibre reinforced plastic making them much stronger, they can also take solids up to 11mm. These new motors can also be controlled electronically via the Oase App using the DMX technology available in the Oase Control (OC was EGC) range. Individual pumps can be controlled by connecting an Oase AquaMax Eco Pump Control to them or if the pump is part of an installation using other Oase Control products which can be remotely controlled then an Oase Control Cable Adapter can be purchased to link other units. In addition, with all pumps, you have the option of using the secondary inlet port to run an optional Aquamax remote strainer or Remote surface skimmer , both of which can improve the circulation within your pond and reduce the likelihood of 'dead' areas and silt build up. Just like its predecessor the design retains the seasonal function control (SFC) and can be dry installed below water level(SFC does not work in a dry running installation). Supplied with 10m of mains cable, hosetails, and a 25, 32 and 38mm plastic hose clip. item.g:title: Oase FiltoClear 13000 Filtration Set
item.g:description: The Oase FiltoClear 13000 pressurised pond filters sets are a highly developed range of pressurised filters and top quality pumps which have outstanding filtration properties and are easy to maintain. Oase FiltoClear 13000 Pressurised Pond Filter Sets Features Combination of mechanical biological cleaning and effective UVC technology Including OASE Clear Water Guarantee Ideal for supplying higher elevated watercourses or waterfalls Setup below the surface level of the water is also possible Patented Easy-Clean-Technology for easy and convenient cleaning without opening the filter Easy-to-operate waste outlet function UVC indicator light for monitoring of the UVC clarifier Pollutant level indicator and flow-through indicator All function-regulating parts are arranged so that they are easily accessible in the cover Through burying or covering with a decorative rock cover it can be perfectly integrated in the water garden Perfectly suited for architectural pools thanks to virtually invisible technology High-quality, impact-resistant material Industry leading Oase Aquamax Eco Premium Filter Pumps Highly Developed FiltoClear 13000 Pressurised Pond Filter The Oase FiltoClears now have an improved and unique, easy to operate built-in cleaning system. Simply remove the discharge cap, connect your waste hose (not supplied), pump the cleaning handle up and down removing all the waste and turn the valve to discharge. The benefit of a pressurised filter is the ability for it to be lower than the discharge point, which in many cases makes it easier to conceal. The Oase FiltoClear includes an integral ultra violet light with an indicator window which makes it simple to see at night if the UV bulb is working. The newest design release in 2022 offers several improvements on the previous range - Easier to Clean mechanism, higher wattage lamps, no need to remove the quartz sleeve when changing the lamp, metal clamping ring and a hood over the UV electrical unit. All FiltoClears are supplied with 5m of mains cable and a 2 year guarantee, which can be increased to 3 years by sending off the guarantee card to Oase. Also included are 4 hosetails, one each for the in, out and discharge hoses and one for the other end of the discharge hose. The new motor incorporates Oase's Core 6 Technology with six windings instead of the traditional 4, these windings have also been curved giving smoother running enhancing efficiency and making them quieter. In addition, with all pumps, you have the option of using the secondary inlet port to run an optional Aquamax remote strainer or Remote surface skimmer , both of which can improve the circulation within your pond and reduce the likelihood of 'dead' areas and silt build up. Just like its predecessor the design retains the seasonal function control (SFC) and can be dry installed below water level(SFC does not work in a dry running installation). The 9000 -21000 models include a separate hosetail to take 50mm hose. Supplied with 10m of mains cable, hosetails, and a 25, 32 and 38mm plastic hose clip. All Oase AquaMax Eco Premium pumps are covered by a 3 year guarantee, which can be extended to 5 years free of charge, simply by sending the warranty card off to Oase. item.g:title: Oase BioSmart 14000 Set - Easy Clean Pond Filter Kit
item.g:description: The OASE BioSmart 14000 filter sets are an introductory package from Oase, combining the Ultra Violet Light and Filter in one simple system. The OASE BioSmart Filter sets ensure clear and healthy pond water thanks to the combination of a large filter foam surface and integrated UVC technology. The BioSmart's 14000 built in Ultra Violet, utilises a highly efficient PLS Ultra Violet bulb. The filter consists of foam cartridges suspended from a plate. To clean them simply pull the handles which compress the foam against the plate, squeezing out the waste. This waste and the remaining water is then run to waste via the integrated sludge outlet. The filter outlet is half way up the tank allowing partial burial if required, although the sludge drain is at the bottom of the tank and must be accessible for cleaning. The filters are supplied with a thermometer and 3m of cable for the integrated UVC. The 7000 and 14000 filters kits are combined with Oases' own range of pumps with 2 year guarantee to offer fantastic value. BioSmart 14000 Filter Set Features • Complete Kits for Goldfish and Koi ponds • Kit includes Filter, UV, Pump and Hose • In Filter cleaning with de-sludge • Mid outlet height for easy concealment • Oase "Clear Water Guarantee"
item.g:product_type: Pond Products > Pumping and Filtering your Pond > Combined Pond Filter, UV and Pump Packages > Oase BioSmart Sets - Easy Clean Filter Kits
item.g:google_product_category: Animals & Pet Supplies > Pet Supplies > Fish Supplies > Aquarium & Fish Tank Accessories

item.g:title: Oase BioSmart 18000 Set - Easy Clean Pond Filter Kit
item.g:description: The OASE BioSmart 18000 filter sets are an introductory package from Oase, combining a Vitronic 18w Ultra Violet Light, an Aquamax Eco Classic 5500 and the BioSmart 18000 filter along with 5m of 38mm (1½”) hose in one simple system. The OASE BioSmart Filter sets ensure clear and healthy pond water thanks to the combination of a large filter foam surface and UVC technology. The Vitronic Ultra Violet, utilises a highly efficient PLS Ultra Violet bulb and bolts on to the end of the BioSmart filter. The filter consists of foam cartridges suspended from a plate. To clean them simply pull the handles which compress the foam against the plate, squeezing out the waste. This waste and the remaining water is then run to waste via the integrated sludge outlet, which in the 18000 kits is controlled through an internal valve lever. The filter outlet is halfway up the tank allowing partial burial if required, although the sludge drain is at the bottom of the tank and must be accessible for cleaning. The BioSmart 18000 kits are supplied with a thermometer, a pollutant level indicator which signals the right time for cleaning and a 3rd type of foam which is ultra fine for an improved bacteria level. The BioSmart 18000 kits include the AquaMax Eco Classic Pump which is a redesigned evolution of the top selling AquaMax Eco, offering the reliability of the Aquamax range without the extra features. The Oase AquaMax Eco Classics are able to pass particles of up to 8mm whilst maintaining economic power efficiency levels. Supplied with 10m of mains cable they have a 3 year guarantee that can be extended to 5 years if you send off the guarantee card. The outlet for this filter takes 75mm rigid or flexible hose pipe (not included) which can be purchased from the following pages: 76mm Outflow Rigid Pipe https://www.watergardeningdirect.com/acatalog/75mm-Oase-Rigid-Pipework.html 76mm Flexible Hosepipe https://www.watergardeningdirect.com/acatalog/Corrugated-Flexible-Hose-Pipe-76mm-3-Inch-ID-Per-Metre.html BioSmart 18000 Filter Set Features • Complete Kits for Goldfish and Koi ponds • Kit includes Filter, UV, Pump and Hose • In filter cleaning with de-sludge • Mid outlet height for easy concealment • Oase "Clear Water Guarantee"
