item.g:title: Evolution Aqua EvoUV 15w Ultra Violet Clarifier
item.g:description: Introducing the most up to date version of the Ultra Violet Clarifier form Evolution Aqua. The EvoUV 15w maintains the high flow rates and energy efficiency of the older models but now has an easily accessible electrical box. As with their previous versions, the long water chambers on these UVs ensure the water and algae are near to the UV light for as long as possible, making them very efficient units. The EvoUV 15w can be mounted horizontally or vertically to ensure they are suitable for a wide range of installation positions and include mounting brackets. The 2021 version of the EvoUV's also features an electronic ballast and thermal safety protection system, which ensures that the units will switch off automatically before they overheat or if they are accidentally run without water passing through. The EvoUV 15w model is supplied with screw threaded hosetails for the connection of 25mm (1"), 32mm (1¼") and 38mm (1½") flexible pipework. Alternatively, the integrated 1½" BSP female screw thread makes them easy to connect to rigid pipework. All models are supplied with 2.2m of mains cable and a 2 year guarantee. Evolution Aqua EvoUV 15w (2021) Features: Large body chamber allowing long contact time Electronic ballast with thermal safety protection Can be mounted horizontally or vertically Conventional 15w T8 bulbs for low replacement costs 2 year guarantee

As with their previous versions, the long twin water chambers on these UVs ensure the water and algae are near to the UV lights for as long as possible, making them very efficient units. The EvoUV 110w can be mounted horizontally or vertically to ensure they are suitable for a wide range of installation positions and include mounting brackets. The 2021 version of the EvoUV's also features an electronic ballast and thermal safety protection system, which ensures that the units will switch off automatically before they overheat or if they are accidentally run without water passing through. The EvoUV 110w model is supplied with sockets that are ready to take 2" solvent weld rigid pipework connections and is not supplied with hosetails. All models are supplied with 2.2m of mains cable and a 2 year guarantee. Evolution Aqua EvoUV 110w (2021) Features • Large twin body chamber allowing long contact time • Electronic ballast with thermal safety protection • Can be mounted horizontally or vertically • 2 x conventional 55w T8 bulbs for low replacement costs • 2 year guarantee

item.g:title: Oase Bitron C 24 Ultra Violet Light
item.g:description: The Oase Bitron 24C Ultra Violet Light is part of the Oase Bitron C range of pond ultra violet lights which are the result of many years of intensive research, which has culminated in this state of the art design These ultra violet clarifiers are supplied with one inlet and two outlets. Both outlets have regulator values and by adjusting these you can control the amount of water which passes over the light. This enables the most efficient use of the light giving the best results. The build up of limescale in an ultra violet is well known for substantially reducing the effectiveness of a unit. This problem had been overcome in the Bitron C in two ways. Firstly the permanent magnets reduce the build up limescale in the whole pond system including pumps. Secondly a continuously spinning cleaning device, which is powered using the water flow, ensures that no build up, even silt, starts on the quartz sleeve. All of the Oase Bitron ultra violet lights have an integrated indicator light or window allowing you to quickly see if the bulb is working. They have been designed to easily fit in an unobtrusive way on to the Oase BioTec range of filters. Supplied with a 2 year guarantee, hose clips and a blanking cap if the two outlets are not required.

item.g:title: Oase Bitron ECO 120w Pond Ultra Violet Light
item.g:description: The Oase Bitron ECO 120w pond ultra violet light is the premium model of Oases' UV range. Designed for large ponds and big flowrates these UV’s are very effective in clearing your pond water. A single inlet will take hose up to 50mm (2”) in diameter and directs the flow in to the newly designed high volume housing which gives a longer contact time between water and bulb. The quartz sleeve has an automatic cleaning rotor which is continuously turned by the flow of water and prevents debris from building up and blocking the output of UV light. The double outlet can fit directly to Oases' ProfiClear, BioTec 30, BioTec ScreenMatic 36 and 140000. The automatic bypass membrane adjusts to the flow through the unit to ensure the optimum flow past the UV light without impact on the overall flow. The membrane will self adjust to altered flowrates from new pumps or the seasonal flow control. The bulb can be accessed to be changed without having to remove the quartz sleeve making this process quicker, easier and with less chance of problems. New to the ECO 120w Bitron Ultra violet lights is the introduction of the digital monitor and control system which not only shows the status of your bulb and the water temperature, but also allows the performance function selection to be adjusted. The ECO function selection adjusts the period of time the bulb will illuminate, this potentially saves up to 50% compared to a convention ultra violet light. With this next generation UV comes new Ultra-efficient Bulbs which have up to 50% longer life spans giving up to 12,000 running hours use. Supplied with 5m of cable and a 2 year warranty which can be extended to 3 years by registering the sale with Oase. Oase Bitron ECO 120w Pond Ultra Violet Light Features: Suitable for Goldfish ponds of up to 60,000L or Koi ponds of up to 30,000L High intensity treatment of suspended algae, turbidity and harmful bacteria in the pond water Now with unique UVC bulb with 50% longer service life (12,000 hrs) High volume UVC housing with a new design and organic shape for a particularly long water dwell time Eco control system enables maximum energy efficiency with savings potential of up to 50% Eco mode saves up to 525 kg CO2/year Automatic / continuous quartz cleaning Intelligent bypass regulation automatically adapts the flow rate to the pump capacity in the filter system Clever UVC function monitor, display for bulb change and water temperature Horizontal or vertical setup possible 5m Mains cable Up to 3 year guarantee

item.g:title: Standard 3 Switch Electrical Box
item.g:description: These weatherproof switch box are highly resistant to impact, heat, chemical and atmospheric agents and intended for use outdoors, specially for water gardeners. Installation is easy, all you need to do is remove the 4 self tapping screws to release the lid and connect your incoming mains to the blue terminal blocks and the outgoing supply to the black terminal blocks. Controlling the attached devices is then as easy to use as a standard light switch. The switches are covered and sealed with black flexible PVC boot covers. Fitted on the bottom of the enclosure are the weatherproof cable glands, which will accommodate cables from 5 to 8mm in diameter. These boxes are supplied with installation instructions, two sealing plugs for unused cable glands and a neoprene lid sealing gasket. These boxes have a 5A fuse fitted and spare fuses are available. The maximum load on each switch is 360w and a total box load of 1200w.
item.g:product_type: Pond Products > Pumping and Filtering your Pond > Electrical Accessories > Electrical Switch and Control Boxes > Standard Electrical Switch Boxes

item.g:title: Velda T-Flow Tronic 15 (5000L - 15000L) - Blanket Weed Remover
item.g:description: The Velda T-Flow Tronic 15 (5000L - 15000L) blanket weed remover is a revolutionary system that eliminates fibrous and slime algae from your garden pond in a way that is safe for fish and plants. The core of the T-Flow Tronic blank weed remover consists of an anode, made from a mineral copper alloy developed by Velda, and a stainless steel cathode. By means of the microprocessor controlled display unit, pulses are generated, which are led to the core of the T-Flow Tronic. Through these pulses, positively charged copper ions are released, also known as mineralization. These ions are also referred to as minerals. In a defined concentration, the ions form a natural barrier against algae. The concentration of copper ions to remove fibrous algae and stop the growth lies between 0.2 and 0.3 PPM. This is an absolutely safe concentration for people, animals, and plants. For comparison, according to the European drinking water standards, 2 PPM is the maximum allowed for drinking water. A positive side-effect of using the T-Flow Tronic is that the pond water will be healthy, and it spreads a neutral, fresh scent. Supplied with a 2 year guarantee. The cable lengths on the T-Flow Tronic Blanket Weed Remover between the control box and the end cap is 3.5m. The mains cable to the transformer is 0.3m and the low voltage cable from the transformer to the control box is 3.9m. At last a blanket weed remover which is cheap to run, safe and highly effective.
item.g:product_type: Pond Products > Pumping and Filtering your Pond > Velda T-Flow Tronic Blanket Weed Removers
item.g:google_product_category: Hardware > Lamps, Lighting & Ceiling Fans

item.g:title: Oase Mantova - Bronze Wall Water Spout (Square)
item.g:description: The Oase Mantova - Bronze Wall Water Spout is an attractive way to create a water feature on smaller walls, where space is limited or to complement larger spillways. These solid brass fixtures add a captivating focal point to both traditional and contemporary walls and patios and are available in four architectural designs with oil rubbed bronze or antique copper finish to fit any style. The Oase Mantova - Bronze Wall Water Spouts incorporate an integrated drip edge to eliminate backflow down the wall and can take flows of 1200 - 4500 litres per hour (250 - 1000 gallons per hour). At a flowrate of 2700 litres per hour and with a lift of approx. 450mm the water will travel horizontally around 380mm from the front lip into the pond/reservoir. The spouts are not supplied with any wall fixings and need to be held in place by the pipework behind them. We can supply an (optional) Wall Spout Connection Set with the required adaptors and fittings needed for installation into a wall. Oase Mantova - Bronze Wall Water Spout (Square) Dimensions : Height 126mm x Width 126mm x Depth 120mm

item.g:title: Rockways - Welsh Slate Aber Falls Step Cascade
item.g:description: The Rockways - Welsh Slate Aber Falls Step Cascade Watercourses are preformed elements which are specifically designed to be used as individual items or interconnect to form pleasing streams. Being handmade from tough polyurethane, they produce watercourses of superb realism and strength. The Welsh Slate Aber Step Cascades feature 2 levels with a small waterfall step and have a lovely looking Welsh slate appearance (dark grey) with an algae green tint to match the design of the Welsh Slate Aber Falls Drop Cascades. These features are fully weatherproof and UV stabilised to ensure that they will not fade. Due to the high quality manufacturing process, these watercourses also weigh significantly less than real stone, making them easy to install. The Rockways - Welsh Slate Aber Falls Step Cascade has a "knockout" connection underneath to allow the connection of the included stepped hose adaptor, which would allow the use of 20mm, 25mm or 32mm (¾", 1", 1¼") pipework. item.g:title: Pontec PondoMatic Pond Vacuum
item.g:description: Pontec PondoMatic Pond Vacuum is a great value pond sludge vacuum cleaner which can remove loose particles of dirt up to 10mm in size, algae, string algae, sludge, dead vegetation and bits of leaves from the pond by way of suction. The Pontec PondoMatic 3 has a 30 litre tank which is made of impact resistant plastic and has an integrated sludge draining system. The sludge is drawn through an adjustable suction nozzle (2-10mm) into the container via a 4m connecting hose. This vacuum operates on a 25 second suction time to collect sludge from the bottom of your pond, followed by a 25 second drain to discharge the dirty water from the main chamber. This cycle repeats continually whilst the vacuum is switched on. Included are 3 vacuum style nozzles. Pontec PondoMatic Pond Vacuum Features: 30 Litre Vacuum Tank 1400 Watt Motor 4m Vacuum Suction Hose 2m Discharge Hose 3 vacuum nozzles included (universal, crevice and string algae) 2 Year Guarantee
item.g:product_type: Pond Products > Looking After Your Pond and Fish > Pond Vacuums
item.g:google_product_category: Lawn & Garden > Gardening > Gardening Accessories & Supplies

item.g:title: Power X Change - Cordless Pond Vacuum With 2 Batteries and Charger
item.g:description: We are all now embracing the ease of using cordless tools and you can now do this with your pond vacuum. If your pond is too far away from your mains supply or you just want to avoid cables running around your garden then the Power X Change Cordless Pond Vacuum is an ideal vacuum for you. It is ideal for removing loose particles of dirt up to 10mm in size, as well as algae, string algae, sludge, dead vegetation and bits of leaves from the base of a small pond, by way of suction. The sludge is drawn through an adjustable suction nozzle (4-10mm) into the vacuum body via a 4m suction hose. Like many of the other vacuums once the container is full of sludge and water, the motor switches off automatically and a special valve at the end of the 2m long discharge hose opens allowing the sludge and water to drain out of the tank, this takes approximately 25 seconds. The vacuum then re-starts. The Power X Change is supplied with 2 extra vacuum style nozzles: crevice nozzle and a flat nozzle with rubber lip and a net for the discharge hose to catch larger particles, such as leaves and blanket weed. Supplied with a 2 year guarantee. The 500 watt motor is powered by 2 x 18v batteries (3ah each) and will produce a flow of 3000 litres per hour and lift water up to 1.8m. In automatic operation (pond cleaning) the batteries can run the vacuum for up to 60 minutes but if you use it as a wet and dry vac on continuous operation then they will power the vacuum for 30 minutes. Supplied with 2 batteries and a charger. Please note that the waste from the vac should be release in to a drain or soak away or alternatively the waste water and sludge can be added to the garden as it is a very effective fertiliser. Power X Change Cordless Pond Vacuum Features • 500 Watt Motor • 3000 litres per hour flowrate • Battery Powered for easier operation • 2 18v batteries and a charger INCLUDED • 4m Vacuum Suction Hose • 2m Discharge Hose • 4 Suction nozzles • 2 Year Guarantee

item.g:title: Plastic Decoy Heron
item.g:description: The Plastic Decoy Heron is a realistic, life-like deterrent designed to help reduce the risk of herons visiting your garden pond. Herons are naturally territorial birds and will often avoid areas where they believe another heron is already present, making decoys a simple and non-invasive method of protection. This model is manufactured from durable, weather-resistant injection moulded plastic and measures approximately 63cm in height and 63cm in length, closely matching the size and posture of a real heron. It can be used freestanding or secured into position using the included ground stake, allowing flexible placement around the pond. Plastic Decoy Heron Features Realistic heron design to mimic a natural territorial presence Helps deter herons by exploiting their instinct to avoid other herons Manufactured from durable, weather-resistant plastic for outdoor use Can be used freestanding or fixed in place with the included stake Low maintenance and requires no power or installation Herons are most active during early morning and dusk and are known to revisit successful feeding spots. Introducing a visible deterrent such as a decoy heron can help disrupt this behaviour, particularly when installed before a heron becomes accustomed to feeding at the pond. For best results, the position of the decoy should be changed periodically. If left in the same place for extended periods, herons may become accustomed to it and ignore its presence. Decoys are often most effective when used as part of a broader pond protection strategy alongside netting or perimeter deterrents. The Plastic Decoy Heron offers a straightforward and cost-effective way to help protect pond fish without the need for complex equipment or ongoing maintenance.
item.g:product_type: Pond Products > Looking After Your Pond and Fish > Heron Deterrents
item.g:google_product_category: Animals & Pet Supplies > Pet Supplies > Fish Supplies > Aquarium & Fish Tank Accessories

item.g:title: Bermuda Floating Pond Thermometer
item.g:description: Knowing the pond water temperature is an essential factor that influences the overall condition of your pond as well as the health of your fish. The Bermuda Floating Pond Thermometer is a simple and convenient way to keep you informed about the water temperature, which will greatly help when deciding the appropriate use of fish foods and treatments. The Bermuda Floating Pond Thermometer includes an easy viewing window with large temperature indications for quick readings. It comes with a handy anchoring cord and is designed to float on the water surface for easy access. It records temperatures between 30 to 120 °F (0 to 50 °C). Its light, all-plastic construction is fish friendly and will not rust.

item.g:title: Koi and Goldfish Spawning Brushes (Pack of 2)
item.g:description: These high quality Koi and Goldfish Spawning Brushes from Black Knight will leave you amazed at how simple collecting your fish eggs can be. As the fish breeding season is weather and temperature dependent spawning can occur anytime between April and July. The female will want to lay her eggs on plants and in ponds without plants this can be a problem. It is vital that the female releases the eggs or they can become "Egg bound" which can be fatal, so introducing a Spawning Brush whether you want to keep the eggs or not is a good idea. By placing the brushes just below the water level, one above the other, at the edge of the pond, your fish will be encouraged to spawn. Spawning takes several hours and usually happens in the early hours of the morning, during spawning the eggs will stick to the brushes. The adults will quickly eat the eggs so if you want to keep the eggs remove the brushes from the main pond once spawning has finished. The purpose made spawning brushes are made from a soft material that won't harm your fish and are not the same material as filter brushes Fish Spawning Brush Dimensions Brush Length - 150cm (59"), Brush Diameter - 14cm (5½") Fish Spawning Brush Features • 2 Brushes per pack • Soft bristles to prevent harm • Fixing rings to allow anchoring

item.g:title: Evolution Aqua - STOP Blanket Weed - 1000g
item.g:description: Evolution Aqua - STOP Blanket Weed is a unique product which will kill & prevent the regrowth of blanket weed if used as instructed. Evolution Aqua STOP Blanket Weed is easy and simple, contains no harmful chemicals and safe for all pond inhabitants. Evolution Aqua - STOP Blanket Weed is a totally natural product that inhibits the growth of blanket weed and is harmless for all pond inhabitants including fish, frogs, filter-bacteria and plants. As many of us know, heavy blanket weed growth in our ponds, although not a chemically dangerous problem, is unsightly and blocks our filters/pumps when it breaks off. Most existing products on the market are designed to kill the weed once it has formed. Evolution Aqua - STOP Blanket Weed is totally fish safe, simply affects the calcium structure of the blanket weed and inhibits its growth and its ability to produce reproductive spores. Manufacturers Warning Label (extract) • Contains Monolinuron • ALWAYS READ THE INSTRUCTIONS CAREFULY BEFORE USE • Not for use in Ornamental ponds when Frogs / Toads are spawning. • Not for use in wildlife ponds. Alternative Products for Natural Ponds Blagdon - Algaway - Blanket Weed Treatment EcoPond - Barley-bio Algae Control Blagdon - Barley Straw Bales Evolution Aqua - STOP Blanket Weed Sizes : STOP Blanket Weed - 1000g - Treats 10000 Litres (2200 G) 3 times = 30000 Litres (6600 G) STOP Blanket Weed - 2500g - Treats 25000 Litres (5500 G) 3 times = 75000 Litres (16500 G) STOP Blanket Weed - 4000g - Treats 40000 Litres (8800 G) 3 times = 120000 Litres (26400 G) Dosing Rate = 1 scoop (30mg) per 900 Litres (198 G) Important Notes As with all anti algae treatments, please ensure that your pond is kept well oxygenated and that large quantities of decomposing algae are manually removed. This product is not suitable for wildlife ponds or ponds with spawning frogs and toads.

item.g:title: Cloverleaf Blanket Answer All Season - 800g
item.g:description: Cloverleaf Blanket Answer All Season - 800g - is a new addition to the UK's bestselling blanketweed treatment range. Blanketweed can grow at cooler temperatures than other pond plants and tries to establish itself as the dominant plant species in a pond early in the early Spring. item.g:description: The 623g Blagdon Algaway Blanket Weed Treatment is an effective and economical way of preventing and eradicating Blanket Weed and String Algae / Thread Algae. The product works by altering the water chemistry to create an environment which kills blanket weed and enhances the growth of your pond plants. In the first month, you will need to treat the pond weekly and then as needed to ensure the Blanket Weed does not return. This product is harmless to wildlife and pets. Each level measure of the product lid (38g) will treat 650 litres (143 gallons), which is the equivalent to 58g per 1000 litres (220 gallons) Blagdon - Algaway 623g - Treats a total of 10,740 litres (2360 gallons) Important Note : As with all anti-algae treatments, please ensure that your pond is kept well oxygenated and that large quantities of decomposing algae are manually removed.

item.g:title: Blagdon - Pond Balance - 205g - Treats 1500 G / 6810 L - (3 x 500 G / 2270 L)
item.g:description: We have brought back Blagdon - Pond Balance which is one of the most popular and effective blanket weed treatments we have ever sold. With the introduction of some new brands the popularity of this product waned, but as the algae becomes accustomed to these new treatments customer are turning back to Pond Balance. It is a treatment which alters the water chemistry to create an environment which is not conducive for blanket weed to grow in without harming other aquatic plants. The first treatment will turn your pond cloudy for a while but this soon clears. In the first month you will need to treat the pond 3 times and then monthly thereafter to maintain the effect. The dosages below are based on the three treatments. item.g:description: The 250ml eco-friendly EcoPond - Barley-bio Algae Control is a treatment to control Blanket Weed and Green Water using high quantities of micro-organisms cultivated on a Barley Straw substrate. item.g:title: Flexible Hose 12mm (½ Inch) (ID) Per Metre
item.g:description: The 12mm (½") internal diameter flexible hose is one of 8 different types of hose we supply to suit all the products we sell. The corrugation of the 12mm (½") hose contains a strengthener, which enables the hose to be flexible and strong but will not kink in most pond installations. The 12mm (½") hose is black for easy concealment and to discourage growth of algae on the inside, which can, long term, lead to a reduction in the hose diameter and thus affect the pumps performance. When using flexible pipework we recommend the use of Stainless Steel Jubilee Clips to ensure a secure and leak free installation. For extra savings, this 12mm (½ Inch) flexible pipework as also available in 30m rolls.

item.g:title: Heavy Duty Corrugated Flexible Hose Pipe - 25mm (1 Inch) (ID) Per Metre
item.g:description: The Heavy Duty Corrugated Flexible Hose Pipe - 25mm (1") (ID) contains strengtheners which allow the hose to be flexible and strong but will not kink in most pond installations. This is complimented by a greater wall thickness which produces a smooth internal wall for reduced friction and better flowrate. The 25mm (1") Heavy Duty flexible hose is black for easy concealment and this also discourages growth of algae on the inside, which can, long term, lead to a reduction in the hose diameter and thus affect the pumps performance. The increased wall thickness reduces the flexibility but increases its strength, this allows it to handle higher pressure. When using flexible pipework we recommend the use of Stainless Steel Jubilee Clips to ensure a secure and leak free installation. 25mm (1") Flexible Hose Features • UV resistant • Good sinking characteristics • Very smooth, flow optimised inner wall design

item.g:title: Oase Multi Water Distributor - 25mm (1 Inch)
item.g:description: The Oase Multi Water Distributors are a quick and simple way to split the output from a water feature pump into 2 or 3 connections. The Oase Multi Water Distributors are also supplied with flow control valve on each of the outlet connections and a blanking cap to allow 2 connections to be used. If the inlet hosetail is being used it will accept 20mm, 25mm, 32mm or 38mm (¾", 1", 1¼" or 1½") flexible pipework. Oase Multi Water Distributors Features • Allows a single connection to be split into 2 or 3 connections (25mm / 1") • Control valve built into each outlet • Each outlet has a rotating connection • Can be connected directly to a pump or via a flexible pipe. item.g:title: Oase Auto Fill Kit
item.g:description: The Oase Auto Fill Kit is a simple solution for automatically topping up a water feature sump or pump chamber. Evaporation or "splash out" can cause the water level within your pond or water feature to fall over time. With the installation of an Auto Fill Kit which is connected to a mains water supply, small amounts of water can be added at a time reducing the need for manual top-ups. The Oase Auto Fill Kit uses a simple and reliable "toilet cistern" type float valve which can be fitted to the flat surface of a plastic reservoir (through a 22mm diameter hole) and then connected to a mains water feed pipe. The Oase Auto Fill Kit Includes: • A float valve with a range of 38 - 45 mm between the lowest and the highest level water points • A "Snap" type hose connector Oase Auto Fill Kit Technical Limits • Maximum water pressure : 5 bar (72 PSI) • Maximum flowrate 340 litres per hour (75 gallons per hour)
item.g:product_type: Pond Products > Pumping and Filtering your Pond > Flexible Hose and Fittings > Auto Top Up Devices
item.g:google_product_category: Animals & Pet Supplies > Pet Supplies > Fish Supplies > Aquarium & Fish Tank Accessories

item.g:title: Evolution Aqua - Nexus - Inline Dechlorinator Cartridge - 30cm (12 inch)
item.g:description: As all fish keepers know, it is necessary to remove chlorine and other impurities from tap water when introducing it to a pond or aquarium. Failure to do this can result in fish health problems and it also adversely affects the growth of beneficial bacteria in all filters. The most common method of Dechlorinator is to add chemical treatments to break down the chlorine. This method is costly and can require accurate measurement of the amount of water to be treated. The De-Tox de-chlorinator simply connects in-line to a hose pipe with standard hose fittings (supplied). The De-Tox carbon filter removes the toxins in tap water prior to it coming into contact with your fish and filters. The high grade activated carbon in these dechlorinator cartridges will remove: Chlorine, Chloramines, Bromine, Malachite Green, many dyes, colour e.g. humic acids, organics e.g. proteins, antibiotics, hormones and ozone Sizes : Nexus - Inline Dechlorinator Cartridge - 30cm (12") -Treats up to 150,000 Litres (33000 G) Nexus - Inline Dechlorinator Cartridge - 76cm (30") -Treats up to 350,000 Litres (77000 G)
item.g:product_type: Pond Products > Looking After Your Pond and Fish > Tests and Treatments > Tap Water Treatments > Nexus - Inline Dechlorinator Cartridge
item.g:google_product_category: Animals & Pet Supplies > Pet Supplies > Fish Supplies > Aquarium & Fish Tank Cleaning Supplies

item.g:title: Oase AquaMax Eco Titanium 33000 Dry Mounted Pump
item.g:description: The Oase AquaMax Eco Titanium 33000 dry mounted pond pump has been designed specifically with larger ponds in mind which do not have the need to lift water very high above the water level. The AquaMax Titanium produces a very high volume of water at low pressure and exceedingly low power consumption - 33000 litre per hour for only 145 watts. The Titanium has been built to be installed in a dry chamber as part of a gravity fed filter system but can be used submerged in a pond or the last stage of a filter chamber. However, the 63mm (2½” BSP) inlet and outlet are threaded and do not come with any fittings or a pre filter and so installation into a system or pond will need to be considered. Like the other Oase AquaMax Premium pumps, the AquaMax Eco Titanium 33000 pump also features the Environmental Function Control (EFC by OASE) which protects against dry running and blocking, as well as the Seasonal Flow Control switch which if used, will slow down the pump automatically when the water temperature drops to a certain level, reducing your power consumption. This can lead to a 30% energy savings. The Titanium pump is not actually made of Titanium but has a cast Stainless Steel housing. The impeller is capable of pumping particles up to 6mm in size, and the rotor shaft and bearings are of high quality SCI ceramics for a reliable and long lifespan. Included with the Titanium pump are 10m of mains cable and a 3 year guarantee, which can be extended to 5 years free of charge simply by sending the warranty card off to Oase. Oase AquaMax Eco Titanium 33000 Dry Mounted Pond Pump Exceedingly low power consumption - only 145 watts Maximum flow rate 33000 litres per hour Can be mounted in or out of the water 63mm (2½” BSP) inlet and outlet size High quality SCI ceramic rotor shaft and bearings Cast stainless steel housing 6mm maximum particle pumping size 5 year guarantee These pumps are part of the OASE Control (previously called "Easy Garden Control (EGC)") range, which allows remote monitoring and control via free access to the OASE Cloud. This allows you to communicate with your pond whilst away from home. See the "More Info" tab below for other OC (EGC) compatible products.

item.g:title: Blagdon - Green Away - 250ml
item.g:description: Blagdon - Green Away - 250ml is a solution to the green water algae which makes ponds look unsightly, turning the pond water into "Pea Soup" obstructing the viewing of fish. The algae also cuts out light to submerged aquatic plants and robs the plants of essential nutrients. Large algal blooms also create water quality problems causing rapid changes in pH. Blagdon Green Away is a non-algaecide "Plant Friendly" pond treatment that clears suspended green water algae. Green Away does not damage other pond plants and so can be used to help establish a "natural balance" to keep algae away. Clumps single celled algae that cause green water together, so that they will either sink to the bottom of the pond or get caught in your filter. Harmless to filters and all species of pond fish, plants and water using wildlife Blagdon - Green Away - 250ml - Treats 5000 Litres (1100 G)
item.g:product_type: Pond Products > Looking After Your Pond and Fish > Tests and Treatments > Green or Dirty Water Treatments > Blagdon - Green Away - Green Water Treatment

item.g:title: Pontec PondoHyacinth - Artificial Floating Water Hyacinth
item.g:description: Many people struggle to create shade in their pond either because of fish activity, pests or moving/spraying water, but these floating plants will not be affected by any of these problems. Water Hyacinths create fantastic shade for fish and an underwater world for insects to live, but unfortunately these plants do not survive UK winters. The highly realistic Pontec PondoHyacinth Water Hyacinths can provide the same effect and can be used as singles or in groups to a create pond covering giving shade for the fish and cutting out light to reduce the growth of algae, as well as helping your fish to hide from predators. Made from a soft durable and weather resistant foam and plastic materials, these 14cm wide artificial Water Hyacinths offer a great alternative or addition to fresh pond plants. By introducing Artificial Pond Plants any pond can benefit from the visual impact they produce as well as the beneficial shading they produce. These plants can simply be rinsed in clean water and then placed in your pond either free floating or anchored using the anchor eye on the bottom.

item.g:title: Velda - Aquatic Water Lily Soil - 10 Litre Bag
item.g:description: The Lelite Aquatic Lily Soil from Velda is a nutrient rich soil that has been composed especially for water lilies. It contains blue loam and dried peat. Due to the special and light structure of the mix Lelite allows sufficient oxygen to prevent the roots from choking. Also as a result of the minerals and trace elements added, a fully rooted ball of soil will form and healthy growth of the lily involved will be the result. The development of a water lily depends for a great part on the substrate in which the tuber has been planted. A strongly developed tuber will form healthy leaves and produces many flowers. Lelite Aquatic Lily Soil has been specially composed by Velda to allow your water lilies to flower in the best possible way. Lelite Aquatic Lily Soil contains the most important building materials for optimum growth, formation of leaves and flowers. The light composition of the product provides proper water circulation along the radical tuber, whereas the blue loam added will stimulate strong root growth. (15 Litres needed per 25 x 25 x 25 cm basket) Unfortunately, due to its weight, we are unable to supply this product to Europe or the Highlands and Islands of Scotland.

item.g:title: NT Labs MediKoi Wheatgerm With Garlic Fish Food (6mm) - 1.75Kg
item.g:description: NT Labs Medikoi Wheatgerm with Garlic 1.75Kg is a complete feed for all pond fish, ideal for late autumn, winter and early spring feeding. This specially formulated diet has been selected to be easily metabolised by your fish, and the reduced protein results in less waste being produced when the fish's metabolism slows in the cooler months. The high-quality ingredients, including garlic, help to encourage your overwintering fish to feed and help maintain their immune system to readily fight infection. Alternate feeding with Medikoi Health during the cooler months for an even wider range of beneficial supplements to ensure your fish get the right nutrition and support when they need it. Why include Garlic in fish food? The inclusion of garlic stimulates the appetite of fish, and the sulphur-rich compounds found in garlic can permeate a fish's skin. Garlic is well known for repelling skin parasites such as white spot, flukes and fish lice which can attack vulnerable, overwintering fish. Suitable for Spring and Autumn (Do not feed when fish are dormant in very cold weather) NT Labs Medikoi Wheatgerm with Garlic Fish Food - 1.75Kg Ingredients Wheat, Wheat Feed, Wheatgerm, Maize, Maize Gluten, Soya, Salmon Oil, Garlic, Calcium Carbonate NT Labs Medikoi Wheatgerm with Garlic 1.75 Kg Fish Food Nutrition Protein 21% Crude Oil & Fat 5% Crude Fibre 5% Crude Ash 6% NT Labs Medikoi Wheatgerm with Garlic Fish Food - 1.75 Kg Additives (per 1000g) Vitamin A 28875 IU Vitamin C 1851 mg, Vitamin D 2165 IU Vitamin E 205 mg

item.g:description: NT Labs MediKoi Staple Fish Food With Colour Enhancer (6mm) - 1.75Kg is a fantastic everyday food, designed to meet the basic needs of your fish. It is a high digestible and full of high-quality ingredients that are easily assimilated and metabolised by your fish. As the food is highly digestible the fish maximise the conversion to nutrition leading to less waste which will reduce maintenance on your filter and pond as well as ensuring water quality remains at optimal conditions. MediKoi Staple Fish Food With Colour Enhancer is also packed full of vitamins and minerals to keep your fish healthy throughout the year. The spirulina in the Medikoi Staple Fish Food is a well-known colour enhancer used by Japanese koi breeders and helps to intensify the colour of your fish. NT Labs MediKoi Staple Fish Food With Colour Enhancer Feeding Recommendations Medikoi Staple can be fed throughout the pond season. For an even greater variety of vitamins and additives, feed Medikoi Staple in conjunction with any of our other Medikoi foods as part of a standardised feeding programme. Feed twice daily in the warmer months, on each occasion a quantity that fish will likely consume within 10 minutes. Feed once per day in the cooler months, or feed Medikoi Wheatgerm with Garlic. Do not feed if fish are dormant in very cold weather below 8°C. Do not overfeed. Keep contents sealed in original packaging away from direct sunlight. Store in a cool, dry environment. NT Labs MediKoi Staple Fish Food With Colour Enhancer - 1.75Kg Ingredients Wheat, Soya Dehulled, Soya Protein Concentrate, Sunflower Meal, Wheat Gluten, Lucerne Protein Concentrate, Monocalcium Phosphate, Lecithin, Spirulina, Algae (Schizochytrium limacinum) NT Labs MediKoi Staple Fish Food With Colour Enhancer - 1.75Kg Fish Food Nutrition Crude Protein 34% Crude Oil & Fat 5% Crude Fibre 3.6% Crude Ash 6.9% NT Labs MediKoi Staple Fish Food With Colour Enhancer - 1.75Kg Additives (per 1000g) Vitamin A - 10000 IU per kg Vitamin C - 250 mg, D 3000 IU per kg Vitamin E - 200 mg per kg

item.g:title: NT Labs MediKoi Health Fish Food (6mm) - 1.75Kg
item.g:description: NT Labs Medikoi Health Fish Food - 1.75Kg has been designed to keep your fish in the best condition to fight off any disease. You can use it to supplement your existing food but as it a complete feed for your fish you can feed them Medikoi Health exclusively. The high-quality, natural ingredients include Stimmune and beta-glucans which support the continued formation of white blood cells, the most important part of any immune system. Also included in the recipe is propolis, a natural product made by bees, a specially formulated blend of herbs, along with lots of vitamins and minerals to help keep your fish healthy all year round. Combining Medikoi Health with Medikoi Staple into one feed will help you achieve the brightest, healthiest fish. NT Labs Medikoi Health Fish Food - 1.75Kg Feeding Recommendations For beautiful, healthy fish, alternate feeding to include Medikoi Health for 3 weeks followed by Medikoi Staple for 2 weeks, and so on. Feed twice daily during the growing season, on each occasion a quantity that fish will likely consume within 10 minutes. In winter, feed only once per day. Alternatively, feed your fish Medikoi Wheatgerm with Garlic during these colder months. Do not feed if fish are dormant in very cold weather below 8°C. Do not overfeed. Keep contents sealed in original packaging away from direct sunlight. Store in a cool, dry environment. NT Labs Medikoi Health Fish Food - 1.75Kg Key Components Stimmune - a special formulation of beta-glucans, designed to support the immune system and maintain healthy liver function. Propolis - a natural product found in bee hives, which supports fish during their recovery from infection. Herbs - a unique blend of nutraceutical, naturally occurring herbs to help maintain resistance to infection. NT Labs Medikoi Health Fish Food - 1.75Kg Ingredients Soya Dehulled, Wheat Flour, Wheat, Poultry Meal, Fish Meal, Maize Gluten, Lecithin, Monocalcium Phosphate, Wheatgerm, Yeast Products (Stimmune) NT Labs Medikoi Health Fish Food - 1.75Kg Nutrition Crude Protein 33% Crude Oil & Fat 5% Crude Fibre 3.1% Crude Ash 6.3% NT Labs Medikoi Health Fish Food - 1.75Kg Additives (per 1000g) Vitamin - A 10000 IU per Kg per Kg Vitamin - C 250 mg per Kg Vitamin - D 2880 IU per Kg Vitamin - E 200 mg per Kgm)

item.g:title: Oase InScenio FM-Master 3 Switch Box
item.g:description: The InScenio FM-Master 3 Switch Box from Oase is the solution to providing remote control functionality to your electrical pond products. The FM Master 3 has 4 power connections to run up to 4 items all of which can be connected in a fully weather proof enclosure. One of the connections is a 3 pin socket which provides a continuous power supply which could be used to connect to another switch box or a product which does not require switching. Two of the 4 connections can be remotely switched on and off using the included remote control and the final connection provides on and off, plus variable (dimmer) power to control the flowrates of many pumps. InScenio FM-Master 3 Features • Weatherproof cover • Mounting spike • 1 x 230 volt input connection • 1 x socket permanent current 230 V • 2 x connection with remote on/off, 230 V, max. 2000 W combined • 1 x connection with remote on/off and dimmer function max. 40-320 W • Total connected load max. 12A / 2700 W • Up to 80m remote control range • 2 year guarantee

item.g:title: Oase InScenio FM-Master Control System
item.g:description: Finally there is a convenient remote control App based system for turning various devices in the garden off and on, or for reducing flow rates by dimming, simply by using your smart phone. The Oase InScenio FM-Master Cloud Control Switch Box are a very high quality junction box with several differences. They offer the ability to run 4 different mains power cables, 3 of which can be switched on and off and the fourth can be dimmed. These controllers allow each power outlet to be controlled over 24 hours with integrated timers. The InScenio FM-Master Cloud comes with a weatherproof splash proof cover which can be easily removed, they are supplied with a stake so their location is not limited to a wall or fence like other junction boxes and can be controlled remotely. The FM-Master Cloud has a wireless Wi-Fi connection and you download an App (from Apple store or via Goggle Play) which allows you to control it via your tablet or Smartphone (iOS 7.x or higher and Android 4.0.3 required). Amongst the products which can be dimmed are the smaller Aquarius Universal pumps. The Oase InScenio FM-Master Cloud Control Switch Box also offers a connection for an OC (EGC / DMX) connection cable which can currently be used with the new Aquamax versions, the new larger Aquarius pumps, PondJet and the Profilux and PondJet RGB Lights. The InScenio FM-Master Cloud allows connection locally whenever you are within range of your home wireless router and remotely via the Oase Cloud system using either the FREE Apple IOS or Android App. The InScenio FM-Master OC Cloud Control System allows connection locally whenever you are within range of your home wireless router and remotely via the Oase Cloud system using either the FREE Apple IOS or Android App. (See below for links) The Oase InScenio FM-Master Cloud Switch Box Features 1 x 230 volt input plug 3 x sockets on/off, 230 V, max. 2000 W combined 1 x socket dimmer function max. 40-320 W Total connected load max. 16A / 3600 W 2 year guarantee + 1 year extra if registered with Oase 3m of mains cable. Guaranteed for 2 years plus an extra year if registered with Oase. Apple IOS and Android App Links OASE Easy Control - Apple IOS Oase Easy Control - Android These controllers are part of the OASE Control (previously called "Easy Garden Control (EGC)") range which allows remote monitoring and control via free access to the OASE Cloud. This allows you to communicate with your pond whilst away from home. See the "More Info" tab below for other OC (EGC) compatible products.

item.g:title: MasterPlug Safety RCD Adaptor
item.g:description: RCD (Residual Circuit Breakers) are an essential part of any electrical installation and are particularly important outdoors. The MasterPlug Safety RCD Adaptor is designed to accept a standard 3 pin mains plug and so can be moved from one product to another. The MasterPlug Safety RCD Plug is designed to protect against the risks of electrocution and fire caused by earth faults by constantly monitoring the electrical current. If it detects electricity flowing down an unintended path, such as through a person who has touched a live part or a faulty piece of equipment that has "shorted out", the RCD will switch the circuit off very quickly, significantly reducing the risk of death or serious injury. MasterPlug Safety RCD Plug Features • Maximum load 3120 watts • 30 milli-amp Trip Current • Trip speed 40 milli-seconds (typical) double pole contact break • 13 amp fused • Manufactured to BS 7071 1992 The MasterPlug RCD plug is a "non latching" type and will switch off if power to them is turned off. Every time the appliance is turned off or if there is a power cut, the RCD will trip and have to be reset by going to the socket. Please note that this product is not weather proof and is intended to be used indoors or in a weatherproof box or enclosure.

item.g:description: Velda Activated Filter Carbon is a special filter medium which is used to purify water. Activated carbon is excellent at removing a variety of organic compounds, including fine dirt, aromatic substances and colourings. It is made from super activated carbon and compressed into small rods. In this way the material permits a very good flow rate and provides crystal clear water. Velda Activated Filter Carbon is suitable to filter pond water and can be used in any type of pond filter. Activated carbon is an excellent choice for your pond. Although it will not remove every possible contaminant on its own, activated carbon is an important component in a multi-stage filtration and purification system. Once activated carbon becomes full, it can no longer remove any more contaminants. Therefore, it is important to replace it regularly. A good rule of thumb is once per month, but if you notice changes in your pond’s odour or colour, it may be time to replace it. Includes free treatment net bag Due to its ability to absorb some chemical compounds, it is recommended that Activated Carbon is removed from your pond when using fish treatment to ensure that it does not reduce their effectiveness. item.g:title: Oase LunAqua Power LED 3 Light Sets
item.g:description: The Oase LunAqua Power LED 3 Light Set is a 3 light set, each of which has a powerful output of warm white light from a small, robust, compact light unit. These lights produce a considerable quantity of light and significant energy savings and are one of Oases' brightest LED spotlight sets. Each of these spotlights consumes only 5.8w, yet is as bright as a 50w bulb. Typical of the Oase design principles these spotlights are not only powerful but also hugely versatile; the set includes an underwater transformer, 3 lights and cables, all capable of working at a depth of up to 4m below water level. These compact lights measure 65mm in diameter and produce a warm white light with a light flux of 580 lumens. Each spotlight connects to the transformer via a 5m cable, but 10m extension cables are available, and you can use up to 4 of these per light, meaning the lights could be up to 90m away from one another. Using the light bracket, you can locate the light on a fountain extension, on a wall or in the ground using the spike. The waterproof transformer is supplied with 3m of mains cable, and the whole product is supplied with a 2 year warranty which can be upgraded to 3 years completely free of charge simply by registering your purchase with Oase. Oase LunAqua Power LED Light Dimensions: 65mm Dia x 100 mm Height Oase LunAqua Power LED 3 Light Set Features 3 Spotlight set with fully waterproof transformer Top quality, robust LED spotlights 5.8w consumption per light, Equivalent to a 50w light with a light flux of 580 lumens per light. 5m of connecting cable, plus up to 4 optional 10m extension per light 3 year guarantee Oase LunAqua Power LED 3 Light Set Contents 3 x LunAqua Power LED Lights with 5m cables 3 x Mounting brackets with pipe clamps 3 x Mounting bracket spikes 1 x 30w LunAqua Power LED Driver (transformer) with 3m mains connection Maximum Submersion Depth: 4.00m Optional Extras: Single add on LunAqua Power LED light 10m LunAqua Power LED Extension Cable

item.g:title: Oase Profi Lux RGB Light - Single
item.g:description: The Oase Profi Lux RGB LED lights bring a whole new world of possibilities and features to your pond and garden lighting. Each Profi Lux light can be used in or out of the water and will produce a wide range of static or changing colours. The Profi Lux light range are sold as individual components and are combined to meet your specific needs. Each Oase Profi Lux RGB LED light setup will require the following items (as a minimum) 1 x Profi Lux Light (this item 1 x Profi Lux LED Controller (will control up to 4 lights) - Click Here The controller (transformer) comes with a pre-set lighting display, however, by adding either an Oase Cloud Controller or an FM-Master Cloud Controler then you have the ability to control the display and the colour generated by the lights from an app on your smart phone or tablet. The Oase Cloud Controller OC is the less expensive option and only allows you to control the lighting system but does not supply power to the lights. The FM-Master Cloud OC is more expensive but is also a junction box which can run 3 other electrical products (pumps, UV's, filters), which if compatible with the OC system can also be controlled. Each of these high quality RGB LED spotlights is supplied with a ground spike for garden use or can be free-standing under the water (4m maximum depth) or even attached to fountain risers via the adaptable base. Each light includes a 5m connection cable which can be extended using an optional 7.5m Profi Lux extension cable , allowing each light to be up to 12.5m from the controller. The Profi Lux 24V underwater controller (transformer) can control up to 4 spotlights. All Profi Lux products are guaranteed for 2 years, which can be extended to 3 years if registered with Oase.
item.g:product_type: Pond Products > Create a Unique Look And Feel > Garden and Underwater Pond Lights > Oase Profi Lux RGB Lighting
item.g:google_product_category: Hardware > Lamps, Lighting & Ceiling Fans

item.g:title: Oase Profi Lux RGB Light Controller
item.g:description: The Profi Lux 24V underwater controller (transformer) can control up to 4 Profi Lux spotlights and has a 5m mains power cable. All Profi Lux products are guaranteed for 2 years, which can be extended to 3 years by sending off the guarantee registration card to Oase. The controller (transformer) comes with a pre-set lighting display, however, by adding either an Oase InScenio Cloud Controller or an Oase InScenio FM Master Cloud Control System then you have the ability to control the display and the colour generated by the lights from an app on your smart phone or tablet. The Oase Cloud Controller is the less expensive option and only allows you to control the lighting system but does not supply power to the lights. The FM-Master Cloud Control is more expensive but is also a junction box which can run 3 other electrical products (pumps, UV's, filters), which if compatible with the OC system can also be controlled. In addition to the 4 connection sockets for the lights the Controller has two other sockets. item.g:description: The Pontec PondoMax Eco 1500 Waterfall and Filter pumps are an energy efficient pump capable of handling solid particles of up to 4mm (1500 / 2500). item.g:title: Oase AquaMax Eco Premium 7000 Filter and Waterfall Pump
item.g:description: The Oase AquaMax Eco Premium 7000 are the very latest version of Oases' high performance AquaMax Eco range of solid handling pond filter pumps. In 2024 Oase redesigned the motor for the Aquamax Eco Premiums resulting in a quieter, more energy efficient pumps, saving 14% - 24% of the running costs (depending on the model) which should also help them last longer than their older models (that is saying something). The new motors have what Oase call "Core 6 Technology" which means they have six windings instead of the traditional 4, these windings have also been curved which produces smoother running, adding to their efficiency and also making them quieter. These new Oase AquaMax Eco Premium pumps also feature impellors that have been improved and are now effectively handmade with glass-fibre reinforced plastic making them much stronger and allowing them to take solids of up to 11mm in size. All of the new AquaMax Eco Premium pumps can now be controlled electronically via the Oase Smart Phone App using the DMX technology which is available in their OC ("Oase Control" system, formerly known as EGC) range of products. Individual pumps can be controlled using an Oase Eco Controller (OAE016) or if the pump is part of an installation using other OC products which can be remotely controlled then a Oase Control Cable Adapter can be purchased to link other units. All of the AquaMax Eco Premium pumps have the option of using the secondary inlet port to run an optional remote strainer (OAA501) or skimmer (OAA102), both of which can improve the circulation within your pond and reduce the likelihood of 'dead' areas and silt build up. Like their predecessors these pumps still have the seasonal function control (SFC) function which automatically slows the pump down (saving money) in colder water temperatures and they can still be dry installed (SFC does not work in dry installations) and reliable protection against blockages and dry running with EFC (Environmental Function Control) All AquaMax Eco Premium 7000 pumps are supplied with 10m of mains cable, inlet and outlet hosetails which will accept 25mm - 38mm flexible hosepipe and a 25, 32 and 38mm plastic hose clip. The Oase AquaMax Eco Premium 7000 pumps are covered by a 3 year guarantee, which can be extended to 5 years free of charge, simply by sending the warranty card off to Oase. Oase Aquamax Eco Premium 7000 Features • Flowrates of up to 7000 litres per hour. • Improved efficiency • Brilliant power balance: Reliable flowrate's at lower power consumption • Secondary inlet connection for optional strainer or skimmer for dirt feeding of further pond zones • Unique, patented frost protection: to -20°C • Delivery rate is controllable mechanically and electronically (Using the Oase App) • Quiet at the dry installation • Will pump particles of up to 11mm • "Environmental Function Control" (EFC by OASE) protects against dry-run or blocking These pumps are part of the OASE Control (previously called "Easy Garden Control (EGC)") range which allows remote monitoring and control via free access to the OASE Cloud. This allows you to communicate with your pond whilst away from home. See the "More Info" tab below for other OC (EGC) compatible products.

item.g:title: Hozelock Aquaforce 1000 Filter and Waterfall Pump
item.g:description: The Hozelock Aquaforce 1000 pond filter pumps offer improved efficiency, performance and reliability. The range has been specifically designed for filtration, waterfalls or watercourses and offers a cost effective flowrate in terms of initial purchase and running costs. The new robust all-in-one cage design is quick and simple to open, but offers a considerably increased cage surface area, allowing the maximum amount of waste to be collected and pumped to the filter system. It also means that the cage is far less likely to clog reducing the need for cleaning. Included with the pump is the new wildlife protection insert, which allows you to reduce the inlet solids diameter from 6-10mm (depending on model) down to 2mm. This prevents wildlife such as Tadpoles, Newts and small fish getting into the cage. The Aquaforce 1000 motors feature a water cooling system, which ensures that the pumps are kept at a constant temperature and reduces the risk of overheating. Ceramic bearings along with thrust washers ensure the motors are ultra reliable. Supplied with 10m of cable and hosetail for 25, 32, and 40mm (1", 1¼" and 1½") connection sizes. Due to their proven reliability Hozelock have now increased the guarantee to 5 years.

item.g:title: Evolution Aqua Varipump 10000 Remote Control Pond Pump
item.g:description: The Varipump 10000 by Evolution Aqua is a controllable pond pump, suitable for large ponds and aimed to go with the EasyPod and Nexus range of filters. Output flowrate and therefore the energy consumption can be controlled at the push of a button using the digital control panel . Available in three sizes, these quiet and reliable pumps are powerful enough to run the largest of ponds and filters, and in the most demanding of situations. The control box allows fine adjustment in increments of 1%, once adjusted the display will continuously show the power consumption in watts. These pumps are suitable for use in and out of the pond and come with a single stepped barbed hosetail which will take 25mm, 32mm and 38mm hose. The Varipump 10000 also has two further smooth hose connectors but this time they are not stepped, these will take 40mm hose. These fittings are not solvent weldable, but can be used with the appropriate boot fittings to allow connection to rigid pipework. The slots in the inlet cage are 5mm and the cage clips off easily for maintenance or to reveal a threaded inlet connection. The Varipumps sit in a removable foot which can be secured to a base should you wish and the pump can then be slid out of the foot for maintenance. The Evolution Aqua Varipumps are supplied with 2m of cable to the weatherproof control box and then 10m from the control box to the pump, this 10m cable has a cable connector so the pump can be easily disconnected from the control box. Supplied with a 2 year guarantee. Evolution Aqua Varipump 10000 Pond Pump Features • Ideal for EasyPod and Nexus range of filters • Remote Panel Control Panel • Electronically controllable in 1% increments • Can be used inside or outside of the pond • Can be connected to rigid pipework ("boot" fittings not included) • Flowrate of up to 10000 LPH (2200 GPH)

item.g:title: Oase AquaMax Eco Premium 6000 - 12v Filter and Waterfall Pump
item.g:description: The Oase AquaMax Eco Premium 6000 12v is the latest version of the Oase high performance AquaMax Eco range of solid handling pond filter pumps. The Oase AquaMax Eco Premium is a fully redesigned evolution of the top selling AquaMax Eco and extends its high reliability and low running costs. Now the "Premium" version of this pump raises the bar even higher. The Oase AquaMax Eco Premium is even more energy efficient than the AquaMax Eco and features even lower power consumption, resulting in a major reduction of the running costs. In addition, with all Oase AquaMax Eco Premium pumps, you have the option of using the secondary inlet connection to run an optional remote strainer (OAA501) or skimmer (OAA102), both of which can improve the circulation within your pond and reduce the likelihood of 'dead' areas and silt build up. Supplied with 2.5m of mains cable running to the weatherproof transformer, then 8m of cable carrying the 12v power to the pump, hosetails, and a 25, 32 and 38mm stainless steel hose clip. As an optional extra, the 12v cable can be extended by a further 10m to give a total of 18m by using the Oase 12v - 10m extension cable . These pumps also feature Environmental Function Control (EFC by OASE), which protects against dry running and blocking In addition to the standard hosetail for 25, 32 and 38mm flexible pipework. All Oase AquaMax Eco Premium 6000 12v pumps are covered by a 3 year guarantee, which can be extended to 5 years free of charge, simply by sending the warranty card off to Oase. Oase AquaMax Eco Premium 6000 - 12v Features • Brilliant power balance: Reliable flowrates at lower power consumption • Secondary inlet connection for optional strainer or skimmer • Unique, patented frost protection: to -20°C • 2.5m mains cable & 8m 12v cable (extension available) • Will pump particles of up to 10mm (6000) or 11mm (12000) in size • "Environmental Function Control" (EFC by OASE) protects against dry-run or blocking • Safe 12v technology perfect for implementation in swim ponds and bathing ponds

item.g:title: Oase AquaMax Eco Twin 30000 - Remote Control Filter and Waterfall Pump
item.g:description: The Oase AquaMax Eco Twin is the very latest version of Oases' high performance AquaMax Eco range of solid handling pond filter pumps. The Oase AquaMax Eco Twin is a fully redesigned evolution of the top selling Oase Promax and extends it's high reliability and performance. Now the "Twin" version of this pump raises the bar even higher. The Oase AquaMax Eco Twin is even more energy efficient than the Oase Promax and features even lower power consumption's, making a major reduction to the running costs. In addition, with the Oase AquaMax Eco Twin pumps, you have the option of using the secondary inlet connection to run an optional remote strainer (OAA501) or skimmer (OAA102), both of which can improve the circulation within your pond and reduce the likelihood of 'dead' areas and silt build up. Unlike most other pumps, the Oase AquaMax Eco Twin 30000 pond pumps feature a twin motor design and have full remote control functionality. The external control box includes a LCD display to indicate the current power level of each of the two motors. These motors can be independently switch on / off or have their flow rates increased or decreased using the wireless remote control., The Oase AquaMax Eco Twin 30000 feature Oases' unique "EFC Function" (Environmental Function Control), which automatically switches the pump off to prevent damage, when it senses dry running. At the other extreme, the Oase AquaMax Eco Twin 30000 pond pumps feature a frost protection system to prevent damage to the pumps in water at as low as -20°C. The Oase AquaMax Eco Twin 30000 pond pumps are supplied with a 50mm (2") outlet hosetail to ensure maximum flow rates. In addition a secondary inlet connection hosetail is supplied for 25, 32 and 38mm flexible pipe work. The Oase AquaMax Eco Twin 30000 pond pumps are covered by a 3 year guarantee, which can be extended to 5 years free of charge, simply by sending the warranty card off to Oase. • Brilliant power balance: Reliable flow rates at lower power consumption • Secondary inlet connection for optional strainer or skimmer for dirt feeding of further pond zones • Twin motor design • Flow rates is controllable mechanically and electronically • Supplied with 10m of mains cable. • Will pump particles of up to 11mm in size • Environmental Function Control (EFC) protects against dry-run or blocking • Unique, patented frost protection: to -20°C

item.g:title: Oase Eco Pump Control
item.g:description: The OASE Eco Pump Control is a clever new product which is designed for connection to the AquaMax and Aquarius Eco Premium and Expert ranges of pumps to provide remote information and control. This simple and clever controller will allow electronic adjustment of the flowrate of the pump, and thanks to its 2 way communication, it will also tell you the pump's current flowrate. The OASE Eco Pump Control can be mounted anywhere that its 10m EGC connection cable can reach, as it's fully weatherproof, and its power supply is provided through the cable by the pump. The illuminated digital display helps you control the pump's output in 1% increments and confirms the pump's power consumption, RPM, and runtime and allows you to switch on/off the SFC feature. Supplied with a 3 year warranty, This unit is supplied with a 10m control cable which can be extended by the use of extension cables if required. OASE Eco Pump Control Features Remote control and reporting of AquaMax / Aquarius Eco Premium / Expert ranges No separate power connection required Illuminated digital display Included 10m control connection cable and mounting spike Remote on / off, flowrate and Seasonal Flow Control Fault reporting and other information 3 year guarantee

item.g:title: Oase AquaMax Eco Expert 20000 - 12v Filter and Waterfall Pump
item.g:description: The Oase AquaMax Eco Expert 20000 - 12v is a low voltage version of the highly respected AquaMax Eco Expert pumps. They are an energy-efficient pump range designed for extremely powerful but economic performance, they are perfect for use in demanding filter systems or for large watercourses and waterfalls and as they are 12 V they are perfect for swimming ponds and natural pools, even if they contain sea water! They have robust stainless steel strainer which allows particles as large as 11mm to pass through and be pumped. The design includes unique, patented frost protection meaning the pump will not be damaged at temperatures as low as -20°C. The Oase AquaMax Eco Expert 20000 - 12v pumps include Oases' Environmental Function Control (EFC) protection which means the pump is switched off if the Impeller chamber is not full of water. This guards against dry running and blocking problems. Suitable for submerged or dry running installations (but is not self priming). These pumps are unusually quiet in operation meaning they are ideal for use in pump chambers. Oases' Patented Seasonal Flow Control (SFC) included in the design which if switched on will reduce the flow as the temperature drops. This can lead to 30% energy savings. The Oase AquaMax Eco Expert - 12v pumps have 2m of power cable to the weatherproof transformer and 8m of 12v cable between the transformer and the pump. A 10m extension cable is available to extend the low voltage run (OAE072). Supplied with a 3 year warranty, which can be upgraded to 5 years by sending the guarantee card off to Oase. Oase AquaMax Eco Expert 20000 - 12v Pond Pump Features • Very high flowrate - Up to 19300 LPH • Suitable for large watercourses. waterfalls, swimming ponds and natural pools • Can pass up to 11mm solids • Can be dry mounted or submerged • Large stable base and handle • Side outlet position • Exceptionally quite • Environmental Function Control (EFC) protection • Seasonal Flow Control (SFC) • Up to 5 years warranty • OASE Control (OC) compatible • OASE Eco Pump Control compatible These pumps are part of the OASE Control (previously called "Easy Garden Control (EGC)") range which allows remote monitoring and control via free access to the OASE Cloud. This allows you to communicate with your pond whilst away from home. See the "More Info" tab below for other OC (EGC) compatible products. If you only need local control of this pump, then the Oase Eco Pump Control can be used instead of the full EGC system.

item.g:title: Oase AquaMax Eco Gravity 10000 Pond Pump
item.g:description: The Oase AquaMax Eco Gravity 10,000 Pond Pump is a purpose designed gravity feed pump that can be dry mounted or located in the final section of a gravity fed filter. With a specific focus on cost efficiency this pump is particularly suitable in situations which do not have the need to lift water very high above water level. The AquaMax Eco Gravity 10000 produces a very high volume of water at low pressure and exceedingly low power consumption - up to 10,000 litres per hour for only 65 watts. The AquaMax Eco Gravity 10,000has been built to be installed in a dry chamber as part of a gravity fed filter system using the supplied 110mm (4") inlet adaptor and fixing plate or can be used submerged in a pond or last stage of a filter chamber with its stainless steel inlet cage which will pass particles of up to 6mm in size. To ensure minimum friction and maximise performance this pump is supplied with a 50mm (2") outflow connector. The AquaMax Eco Gravity 10,000 is supplied with a removable base which can be used to prevent vibration through your pipework or can be removed to allow installation in confined spaces. This pump is covered by a 3 year guarantee, which can be extended to 5 years free of charge, simply by sending the warranty card off to Oase. Oase AquaMax Eco Gravity 10,000 Pond Pump Features • Exceedingly low power consumption - only 65 watts • Maximum flow rate 10,000 litres per hour • Can be mounted in or out of the water • 50mm (2 BSP") inlet and outlet size • Supplied with 110mm (4") adaptor • High quality SCI ceramic rotor shaft and bearings • 6mm maximum particle pumping size • 5 year guarantee

item.g:description: The new Oase Filtral 1500 Complete Pond Filters are the next generation of internal pond filters for wildlife ponds of up to 1500 litres and goldfish ponds of up to 700 litres. item.g:title: Oase Filtral 3000 Complete Pond Filter
item.g:description: The New Oase Filtral 3000 Complete Pond Filters are the next generation of internal pond filters for wildlife ponds of up to 3000 litres and goldfish ponds of up to 1500 litres. These fully redesigned filters include an integrated pump, filter and UVC and can be completely hidden in a pond. The Oase Filtral 3000 pond filters provide clear and healthy water, are easy to install and have a choice of outflow connections. Small in size but large in features, these complete filter units incorporate both medium and fine grade foam for mechanical filtration, which is followed by ceramic and plastic media for biological filtration. The top quality construction and easy to open clips mean cleaning and maintenance of this product are quick and simple, and the inclusion of a simple UV indicator is a reassuring confirmation of the functioning of the UV light. The outflow can either be used to feed a small water feature via the included hosetail, which will accept 13mm (½"), 20mm (¾") or 25mm (1"), or it can also be used to produce a fountain of various designs using the Fountain Kit. The Oase Filtral 3000 unit also includes a Filtral Aeration Set which is designed to use a Venturi principle to add air bubbles into the outflow of a Filtral. This addition will help to enhance the oxygen levels within a pond, which enhances biological activity, the oxygen level within the water and general circulation within a pond. Oase Clear Water Guarantee Oase Filtral 3000 Complete Pond Filter Features An efficient integrated pump. 2 foam filter grades to ensure crystal clear water. Ceramic and plastic elements to ensure healthy fish and plants. A UVC to eliminate green water. Visible UV indicator light. Includes Fountain Head and Stem Kit. Includes Aerator Set. Oase Filtral 3000 Dimensions: 9cm long x 24.5cm wide x 14cm tall Aeration Set Installation Note. The air bubbles produced by this unit are created by forcing the water from your filter through a small opening in the aerator (this is called a Venturi). For this to function properly, it requires a minimum quantity of water, and therefore the more bubbles being created, the more it will reduce the performance of your fountain.

item.g:description: Specifically designed for the Oase Filtral 3000, 6000 and 9000 (NOT 1500) Complete Pond Filters. item.g:title: Smart Solar - Super Bright Solar Star String Lights - 100 LED's
item.g:description: The Super Bright Solar Star String Lights are a superb set of solar powered decorative star lights ideal for decorating shrubs, parasols and doorways. This set has 100 white super bright LED's which are powered by a separate solar battery station which has a total cable length of 21.8m. The lights will automatically illuminate at night giving light for up to 6 hours when fully charged and can operate in either constant or flashing mode. Supplied with a 1 year guarantee. Fantastic lights to add interest to your garden especially at Christmas, Halloween or Summer BBQ's 100 Super Bright Solar Star String Light Set Features • Solar Powered - no mains required • Up to 6 hours running time when fully charged • 100 Super bright LEDS Stars • Automatic Dusk and Dawn Sensor • Constant or Flashing Mode • Includes 2 x 1.2v AA Rechargeable Batteries (Replaceable)

item.g:title: Smart Solar - Solar Powered Rope Lights - 100 LED's
item.g:description: The Solar Powered Rope Lights are a versatile set of solar powered LED lights encased in a clear outer tube making them ideal for decorating shrubs, parasols, trees and doorways. This set has 100 bright white LED's which are powered by a separate solar battery station which has a total cable length of 10.5m (2m then 8.5m of lighting) and contains a replaceable battery. The solar panel has a 3 position switch to set either "On" / "Off" or "Flash". When in the "on" or "Flash" mode the lights will automatically illuminate at night giving light for up to 6 hours when fully charged. If however the switch is set to "Off" the solar panel will continue to charge, allowing you to charge over a few days to ensure maximum duration on a special occasion. Supplied with a 1 year guarantee. Solar Powered Rope Lights Set Features • Solar Powered - no mains required • Up to 6 hours running time when fully charged • 100 White LEDS • Automatic Dusk and Dawn Sensor • 3 Position switch - On / Off or Flash

item.g:title: Smart Solar - Triple Starburst Solar String Lights
item.g:description: The Triple Starburst Solar String Lights are a set of 3 clusters of micro Led's which create a mini starburst effect. Each of the 3 clusters has 16 strands which have 2 micro Led's per strand giving a total of 32 Led's per cluster. The set has a 2m cable from the solar panel to the first light and then 50cm between clusters they are ideal for decorating trees, shrubs or parasols. This set is powered by a small solar panel which charges a 3.7v (14500) 500mAh replaceable battery. The solar panel has a 3-position switch to set either "Off" / all white LEDS / Red, Blue & White clusters / flashing between the two. In addition, the lights will automatically illuminate at night giving light for up to 6 hours when fully charged. If however the switch is set to "Off" the solar panel will continue to charge, allowing you to charge over a few days to ensure maximum duration on a special occasion. Supplied with a 1 year guarantee. Triple Starburst Solar String Light Set Features • Solar Powered - no mains required • Up to 6 hours running time when fully charged • 96 micro Led's • Automatic Dusk and Dawn Sensor • 3 Position switch - On / White / Red, Blue, White / Flash

item.g:title: Black Knight Filter Brush - 4 inch x 9 inch (10cm x 23cm)
item.g:description: Black Knight Filter Brush - 4 inch x 9 inch (10cm x 23cm) Black Knight filter brushes are made from the very highest quality Hydrotek polypropylene twisted into two stainless steel wires to form a cylindrical brush with a loop at one end for hanging. The other end is capped with a plastic knob for safety. They last indefinitely and are the easiest to use, most efficient and most cost-effective pond filter medium you can buy. Our brushes are used in filtration systems in fish farms, hatcheries, public aquaria, domestic fish ponds and research institutes in this country and abroad. No other filter medium is as widely used or has been as extensively tested and proved. How to use Black Knight Filter Brushes If you have a small pond with a few goldfish and a couple of Koi then a single chamber with three to six lines of brushes will be ideal. For a more demanding situation, it will be necessary to use a much larger chamber or to link two or three together. These can all contain brushes or you can use them in the first and second chambers and then other media, such as Kplus or foam , in the last chamber. When designing your layout remember to include an overlap so the brushes interlink. Black Knight Filter Brush Benefits • Great for both biological and mechanical filtration • Low unit cost • Easy to clean • Very effective at reducing foam filter cleaning • Massive surface area for biological colonisation Black Knight Filter Brush Sizes The measurements given refer to the main body of the brush, every brush has a 3 inch (8cm) top ring and a ¾ inch (1.5cm) bottom spike 4 inch (10cm) Filter Brushes • 4" x 9" ( 10cm x 23cm) • 4" x 12" (10cm x 30cm) • 4" x 16" ( 10cm x 40cm) • 4" x 20" ( 10cm x 50cm) 6 inch (15cm) Filter Brushes • 6" x 12" (15cm x 30cm) • 6" x 16" ( 15cm x 40cm) • 6" x 20" ( 15cm x 50cm) 8 inch (20cm) Filter Brushes • 8" x 16" (20cm x 40cm)

item.g:title: Evolution Aqua K1 Media - 3 Litre Bag
item.g:description: The Evolution Aqua K1 Media Moving Bed process, which has been scientifically tried and tested in fish farming and waste water treatment for over 10 years, is now available for fish keepers and is exclusively distributed worldwide by Evolution Aqua. The media is engineered in a wheel shape and has a slight positive buoyancy. This allows a small amount of water flow to circulate the media throughout the vessel. This flow is created with your air pump and air stones or diffuser etc. How Evolution Aqua K1 Media works Maturing the Evolution Aqua K1 bio-media is important because a delicate eco-system is naturally developing for the bacteria involved in the nitrification process. Evolution Aqua K1 Media provides the maximum active surface area for the bacteria to colonise, more than other types of static media. It is this process which removes harmful ammonia and nitrite from the water. How is Evolution Aqua K1 Media different to other media As the Evolution Aqua K1 Media moves within the filter, it causes the old dead bacteria on the outside to be displaced. This makes space for new younger heavier feeding bacteria to rapidly colonise. Within the wheel is a protected surface which enables colonies of bacteria to naturally follow their life cycle, of maturing, dying and then fuelling the latter stages of the nitrification cycle. K1 media has been designed to provide the best possible habitat for both young and mature beneficial bacterial colonies. What is meant by - self cleaning Unlike foam, matting, or other forms of static filtration media, the Evolution Aqua K1 Media is designed to move freely within your filter. The constant chaotic movement of the air from your pump, causes the media to self clean and thus requires no maintenance. This allows the filter to reach optimum effectiveness without the disturbance of periodic cleaning, avoiding unnecessary loss of bacteria within the filter. Evolution Aqua - K1 Bio-Media Performance • Each litre of K1 media will handle up to 5 grams of food per day. • Each 3 litre bag of K1 media will handle up to 15 grams of food per day.
