item.g:title: Evolution Aqua Kplus Media - 25 Litre Bag
item.g:description: Evolution Aqua Kplus (K+) Filter Media is a impregnated plastic media, for use in biological pond filters - specifically in moving bed bio reactors as used in the Nexus filters as well as Bead and Aquarium filters. This new generation of media has been redesigned to give it an extremely high surface area of 1,350m² per m³, with a protected surface area of 1,025m² per m³, but that's just the first improvement. As Evolution Aqua K+ Media is extruded, Minerals and Enzymes are added to the raw material, doing this adds the following benefits: • The addition of these minerals creates a rough surface on the media. This textured surface has a microscopic honeycomb of peaks and craters that allow waste particles to collect, and nitrifying bacteria to form. • The minerals act as a food source for the bacteria, helping the bacteria to develop and multiply at a faster rate, further improving maturation times. • Calcium alone has proven advantages for developing and maintaining effective bio-films. • The enzymes that are added also help to make the media “sticky” so waste particles can adhere to media easier. • Salt is added during the extrusion process, which is dissolved during the cooling process, leaving a rough surface on which bio-film can easily adhere. How Evolution Aqua Kplus (K+) Filter Media works Maturing of the Evolution Aqua Kplus (K+) Filter Media is important because a delicate eco-system is naturally developing for the bacteria involved in the nitrification process. Evolution Aqua Kplus (K+) Filter Media provides the maximum active surface area for the bacteria to colonise, more than other types of static media. It is this process which removes harmful ammonia and nitrite from the water. Due to the Minerals and Enzymes which are added during the manufacturing process, this critical maturing process is significantly accelerated, ensuring your filter biological capacity is established as quickly as possible. The shape of Kplus (K+) optimises the amount of “quiet zones” within the media where a stable bio-film can develop. Whilst K+ Media keeps the integral profile of K1 Media at its core, there is an extra layer of cells and fins around the outside of each piece that enable microscopic organisms such as Rotifers and Vorticella to thrive. This is an additional benefit as competitor media do not have such “quiet zones” that would allow these higher life forms of filter feeders to develop. The bacteria and organisms that form within the bio-film ensure the media delivers optimum levels of biological filtration in the moving bed, which has been proven filtration technology for many years in the fish keeping hobby. How is Evolution Aqua K Medias different to other media As the Evolution Aqua K Medias moves within the filter, it causes the old dead bacteria on the outside to be displaced. This makes space for new younger heavier feeding bacteria to rapidly colonise. Within the wheel is a protected surface which enables colonies of bacteria to naturally follow their life cycle, of maturing, dying and then fuelling the latter stages of the nitrification cycle. K1 media has been designed to provide the best possible habitat for both young and mature beneficial bacterial colonies. What is meant by - self cleaning Unlike foam, matting, or other forms of static filtration media, the Evolution Aqua Kplus (K+) Filter Media is designed to move freely within your filter. The constant chaotic movement of the air from your pump, causes the media to self clean and thus requires no maintenance. This allows the filter to reach optimum effectiveness without the disturbance of periodic cleaning, avoiding unnecessary loss of bacteria within the filter. Evolution Aqua - Kplus (K+) Filter Media - 25 Litre Bag Specification Length: 8mm Diameter: 10.2mm Surface Area: 1350m² per m³ Protected Surface Area: 1025m² per m³ Volume: 25 Litres

item.g:title: Black 250 gram - 2m (6ft 6 Inch) wide Underlay - Overlay per linear metre
item.g:description: Our 250gm/m² Black Pond Liner Underlay is a top quality densely woven fibre which is root resistant and puncture resistant. This high density material has a weight of 250 g/m². The 250 g/m² pond liner underlay is so strong and dense that we even have problems cutting it in house and as such, we are happy to recommend this underlay as a very effective protection for your liner. It is cut off a roll 2m (6ft 6 inch) wide. As an alternative to our standard underlay, this black coloured version is more discreet if not fully covered, so it is particularly useful when being used above liners but under stonework as a protective layer. When Should I Use Black Pond Liner Underlay/Overlay? Black 250 g/m² pond liner underlay/overlay can be used beneath the pond liner in the same way as standard underlay, helping to protect the liner from stones, roots, rough ground and other puncture risks below the pond. Its main advantage is that it is more discreet where the material may not be fully covered. This makes it particularly useful above the pond liner, underneath rocks, slabs, edging stones, waterfalls, streams or decorative stonework where the liner surface may need extra protection from rubbing or pressure points. Use black underlay / overlay when you want both practical liner protection and a neater appearance in areas where standard light-coloured underlay could be more visible. What is the difference between standard underlay and black underlay / overlay? Both products help protect the pond liner from puncture risks, but they are normally used slightly differently. Standard underlay is mainly used beneath the pond liner, between the ground and the liner. Black underlay/overlay can also be used beneath the liner, but it is especially useful above the liner where rocks, edging stones or decorative stonework may sit against the liner surface. The black colour makes it more discreet if any of the material remains partly visible. For general protection beneath the liner where the underlay will not normally be visible, see our standard 250g/m² pond liner underlay .

item.g:description: Gold Label 80ml Underwater Pond Sealant in Black bonds a wide range of materials even under water: Butyl Rubber, Vinyl, Glass, Plastic, Ceramic, Stone, Concrete and even wood - Solvent free so fine to use in ponds with fish still in place provided they do not ingest it. Size: 80ml Colour:- Black Gold Label Underwater Sealant - Instructions for Use For best results clean all surfaces to be free from algae, grease and limescale etc. Place sealer directly onto the surface you wish to bond or seal. For bonding where there is movement (expansion or contraction) or different substrate, leave a minimum 5mm bead between surfaces. For joining liner, use two beads 15mm apart and leave to cure for 36 hours at ambient temperature and for a patch, run a continuous bead around the edge of the patch and gently press into place. Store in dry conditions between 10 - 25°C Do not use below +10°C Not suitable for HDPE plastics and Polyex liners

item.g:title: Evolution Aqua Surge Filter + UV (18w)
item.g:description: The Evolution Surge Filter + UV is new for 2024 but uses the proven design of the Evolution Aqua Tempest, K+Media and the newly patented Air Technology cleaning and is an easy to install compact filter for ponds of up to 5000 litres. How does the Serge Filter + UV work? When the flow of water from your pump moves through the water chamber which contains K+ filtration media for friendly bacteria, it pushes the K+ media against a retaining plate creating a mechanical barrier, this clumps the media together and helps it to filters out waste particle. With every circulation through the unit the water passes over the 18w UV lamp which flocculates (clumps) green water algae together making them easier to catch withing the filtration media. When the filter needs cleaning, you simply switch off the pump, close the inlet and outlet ball valves and open the waste valve, as you do so air rushes up to the body chamber creating turbulence which agitates and cleans the waste from the K+ media and the dirty water exits through the waste valve, making it a very quick and easy cleaning process. The Surge Filter + UV is supplied with the inlet and outlet hosetails (to suit 20mm, 25mm, 32mm hose), valves, 18w UV, waste assembly, 2 mounting brackets, 500mm of clear waste 25mm hose and an elbow for the waste connection. For the filter to work it does need to be mounted vertically with the inlet at the bottom and outlet at the top. The Surge is supplied with a 2 year guarantee. Evolution Surge Filter + UV Features • Combined Filter for Goldfish and Koi ponds upto 5000 litres • Filter includes integrated 18w UVC • Amazingly simple cleaning with no sludge build-up • 2 year guarantee

item.g:title: One Way / Non Return Valve (25mm,32mm,38mm)
item.g:description: Our One Way / Non Return Valve is a simple rubber flap non-return valve which is made from sturdy polypropylene and is ideal for preventing water from draining back from a header pool or reservoir during maintenance. Due to the design incorporating a flap it should be used with clean water, which is free from weed and debris, however it can be opened by undoing the 4 nuts and bolts for cleaning if needed. item.g:title: Oase Aquarius Universal Classic 440 Feature Pump
item.g:description: The Oase Aquarius Universal fountain pumps have been designed specifically with ornaments, statuary and water features in mind, they offer impressive performance from pumps with compact dimensions. The Aquarius Universal 440 features a very low water intake point allowing operation in much shallower water than other pumps. item.g:title: Oase BioTec ScreenMatic 2 - 40000 - Filtration Kits
item.g:description: The Oase BioTec 40000 ScreenMatic 2 - Complete Filtration Systems are complete kits that come with the state of the art BioTec ScreenMatic 2 40000 Pond Filter, Bitron 36C Ultra Violet lights and the Aquamax Eco Premium 13000 Filter Pump. With the introduction of the BioTec ScreenMatic 2 Filters Oase have shown that they are always innovating and improving their pond filters. The Biotec ScreenMatic 2 range now features an improved coarse debris system and electronic control system. Simple operation, fast, clean maintenance and outstanding filtration are the results. A specially designed sieve catches all debris particles above 300 microns that arrive in the filter. The sieve has been designed as a belt which rotates when dirty via a built-in 12v motor and is scraped clean as it turns. The dirt build up on the screen is monitored by a new sensor system which only operates the 12v motor when needed, thus saving running costs and wear and tear. The waste falls in to an increased capacity tray for disposal. The water which is enriched with oxygen, then falls into the chamber below, flows through the filter zones and then reaches the next filter chamber. The friendly filter bacteria present in the pond water settle and multiply in the oxygen rich sponges. The individual chamber situated just in front of the outlet holds a number of Zeolite filled cartridges which are ideal when starting up the filter. Once established the material inside can be changed to Phosless (not supplied) which will help prevent algae growth in the pond. Each filter is also supplied with a plunger to allow for easy cleaning of the foam cartridges and a brush to aid cleaning of the belt. Once the foams have been squeezed out a valve is pulled and the dirty water drains from the tank. The drain is at the bottom of the BioTec ScreenMatic 2 Filter is 50mm. The Oase BioTec 40000 ScreenMatic 2 Pond Filter Units and Bitron 36C UV's are supplied with a 2 year guarantee which can be upgraded to 3 years by registering your purchase with Oase. However the included Oase Aquamax Eco Eco Premium pumps are covered by a 3 year guarantee, which can be extended to 5 years free of charge, simply by sending the warranty card off to Oase. Oase Biotec ScreenMatic 2 40000 Pond Filter Features Intelligent filter system for fish ponds up to 20m³ (20000 litres) The automatic coarse debris extraction using "conveyer belt" sieve technology High quality filter sponges for biological filtration Intelligent control functions Simple plug and play operation 300 µm first stage cleaning sieves Pollutant discharge using included slide valve Oase Bitron 36C UV The Bitron C range of UV's are the result of many years of intensive research, which have culminated in this state of the art design. These ultra violet clarifiers are supplied with one inlet and two outlets. Both outlets have regulator values and by adjusting these you can control the amount of water which passes over the light. This enables the most efficient use of the light giving the best results. The build up of limescale in an ultra violet is well known for substantially reducing the effectiveness of a unit. This problem had been overcome in the Bitron C in two ways. Firstly the permanent magnets reduce the build up limescale in the whole pond system including pumps. Secondly a continuously spinning cleaning device, which is powered using the water flow, ensures that no build up, even silt, starts on the quartz sleeve. Each model has an integrated indicator light or window allowing you to quickly see if the bulb is working. Supplied with a 2 year guarantee, hose clips. Top Quality Oase AquaMax Eco Premium 13000 Filter Pumps The Oase AquaMax Eco Premium 5000 - 21000 are the very latest version of Oases' high performance AquaMax Eco range of solid handling pond filter pumps. In 2024 Oase have redesigned the motor for the Aquamax Eco Premiums resulting in a quieter, more energy efficient pumps, saving 14% - 24% of the running costs (depending on the model) which should also help them last longer than their older models (that is saying something). The new motors have what Oase call "Core 6 Technology" which means they have six windings instead of the traditional 4, these windings have also been curved which produces smoother running, adding to their efficiency and also making them quieter. These new Oase AquaMax Eco Premium OC pumps also feature impellers that have been improved and are now effectively handmade with glass-fibre reinforced plastic making them much stronger and allowing them to take solids of up to 11mm in size. All of the new AquaMax Eco Premium OC pumps can now be controlled electronically via the Oase Smart Phone App using the DMX technology which is available in their OC ("Oase Control" system, formerly known as EGC) range of products. Individual pumps can be controlled using an Oase Eco Pump Control or if the pump is part of an installation using other OC products which can be remotely controlled

item.g:title: Rockways - Midi Single Step Cascade Watercourse
item.g:description: The Rockways - Midi Single Step Cascade Watercourses are preformed elements which are specifically designed to be used as individual items or interconnect to form pleasing streams. Being hand made from tough polyurethane they produce watercourses of superb realism and strength. These features are fully weatherproof and UV stabilised to ensure that they will not fade. Due to the high quality manufacturing process these watercourses also weigh significantly less than real stone making them easy to install. The Rockways - Midi Single Step Cascade Watercourse is designed to be used as a single feature (although it may be possible to create a stream if positioned carefully). All units have a "knock out" connection underneath to allow the connection of the included stepped hose adaptor which would allow the use of 20mm, 25mm or 32mm (¾", 1", 1¼") pipework. The Rockways - Midi Single Step Cascade Watercourse Dimensions: Length 600mm x Width 430mm (width of bottom lip 120mm) The Rockways - Midi Single Step Cascade Watercourse Maximum Flowrate: 1500 litre per hour (330 gallons per hour).

item.g:title: Aqua Forte Garden Sniper Bird Scarer
item.g:description: Despite the name the Aqua Forte Garden Sniper Bird Scarer does not shoot the birds out of the sky, instead it has a PIR motion sensor which will detect the movement of birds, cats, dogs and even rabbits. Once it detects movement it opens a valve and water shoots through the sprinkler head creating noise and movement to scare the unwanted visitor away. You need to have a permanent mains water hose connection to the base of the unit and the as the unit is solar powered, it does rely on sufficient sunlight to be effective and should be placed in direct sunlight. As it needs a hose connection and solar power this is for use during the summer months. The biggest pest this scarer is used for is Herons closely followed up by Cats. Herons prefer to land near the pond and walk in so you should set the scarer up so that the PIR covers the landing area rather than the pond. With cats you may wish to direct the sensor over the pond area. The PIR can detect creatures up to 10m away and it can be adjusted to work day and / or night. Aqua Forte Garden Sniper Bird Scarer Features • Harmless, just sprays water to scare intruders • Solar Powered • Requires a permanent water feed. • Can be set to run day and or night. • Helps deters Herons and Cats. Supplied with a 12 month guarantee.
item.g:product_type: Pond Products > Looking After Your Pond and Fish > Heron Deterrents
item.g:google_product_category: Animals & Pet Supplies > Pet Supplies > Fish Supplies > Aquarium & Fish Tank Accessories

item.g:title: Oase Aqua Active AlGo Universal - Total Algae Control - 5L
item.g:description: Oase Aqua Activ AlGo Universal - Total Algae Control - 5L is an advanced pond treatment that works effectively against Blanket Weed (String Algae) and other algae within a pond. By specifically targeting the algae's metabolism it gradually kills the weed and helps prevent re-growth. This is a single dose treatment product which takes 2 - 3 weeks to see its full effect and should be used at a 50% strength once every 4 weeks to prevent re-growth. Manufacturers Warning Label (extract) • Contains Monolinuron • ALWAYS READ THE INSTRUCTIONS CAREFULY BEFORE USE • Harmful to Aquatic Life with long lasting effects. • When use properly, harmless to Plants, Fish and Microorganisms. • When use properly, harmless to Dogs, Cats and Birds. Alternative Products for Natural Ponds Blagdon - Algaway - Blanket Weed Treatment EcoPond - Barley-bio Algae Control Blagdon - Barley Straw Bales Oase Aqua Activ AlGo Universal - Total Algae Control Treatment Capacity 5l Treats up to 100,000 Litres (22,000 G) Important Notes As with all anti algae treatments, removing as much blanket weed as possible before use will prevent the die off from chocking the pond, ensure that your pond is kept well oxygenated and remove any decomposing algae as it dies off.
item.g:product_type: Pond Products > Looking After Your Pond and Fish > Tests and Treatments > Blanket Weed Treatments

item.g:title: Blagdon - Clear Pond - 1 Litre
item.g:description: Blagdon - Clear Pond is a coagulant that will clump any particles together, so that they will either sink to the bottom of the pond or get caught in your filter. Good for brown murky water. It also assists filtration by making particles larger so that they are trapped and removed. Blagdon - Clear Pond is suitable for use in all ponds, safe for use with all species of pond fish and harmless to filters and all species of pond fish, plants and water using wildlife. Blagdon - Clear Pond - 1 Litre - Treats 22700 Litres (5000 G)

item.g:title: Blagdon Blue Pond Colour Dye - 250ml
item.g:description: The 250ml bottle of Blagdon Blue Pond Colour Dye from Blagdon helps reduce the growth rate algae by reducing the amount of sunlight that enter into the pond. This blue dye is harmless to filters and all species of pond fish, water using wildlife and plants that grow above the water. For best results start using this product in the Spring, before the algae has had a chance to begin growing. Simply shake the bottle thoroughly and fill the dosage chamber as directed. For every 3,100 litres (682 gals) of pond water, add one 25ml measure of the product. Mix the Blue Pond Colour in a bucket of water and evenly distribute it over the pond. If you want a more intense colour, adjust the dosage to suit your preference. Blagdon Blue Pond Colour Dye Benefits : • Creates beautiful, blue pond water • Simple to use • Reduces algae growth • Help to protects fish from predators • Safe for Pet, plants & wildlife • Best used from March to September Blagdon Blue Pond Colour Dye - 250ml - Treats 31000 L (6820 G) Dosing: 25ml per 3100 Litres (682 G) periodically (March - September) Product Warning: Keep out of reach of children. Keep in original container, in a cool dry place, out of direct sunlight. Undiluted product will stain clothing and other items.

item.g:title: NT Labs MediKoi Growth Fish Food With High Protein (6mm) - 1.75Kg
item.g:description: NT Labs MediKoi Staple Fish Food With Colour Enhancer - 1.75Kg - 6mm diameter has been specifically formulated to enhance the growth rate of your fish, but it is also a complete feed for all pond fish and helps maintains the health of your fish This food is full of high-quality ingredients, including fish oils rich in omega-3 and omega-6. These can be assimilated and fully metabolised by your fish, reducing the waste they produce whilst ensuring your fish receive the most important vitamins and nutrition needed for maximum, healthy growth. Lower waste can mean less maintenance on your pond and filter along with healthier water quality. Mixing your feed between Medikoi Growth, Health and Staple will give you the best growth rate, supports the fish’s immune system and enhances their natural colours. NT Labs MediKoi Staple Fish Food With Colour Enhancer - 1.75Kg - 6mm diameter is suitable for fish 35 - 55 cm in length NT Labs MediKoi Staple Fish Food With Colour Enhancer Feeding Recommendations Medikoi Staple can be fed throughout the pond season. For an even greater variety of vitamins and additives, feed Medikoi Staple in conjunction with any of our other Medikoi foods as part of a standardised feeding programme. Feed twice daily in the warmer months, on each occasion a quantity that fish will likely consume within 10 minutes. Feed once per day in the cooler months, or feed Medikoi Wheatgerm with Garlic. Do not feed if fish are dormant in very cold weather below 8°C. Do not overfeed. Keep contents sealed in original packaging away from direct sunlight. Store in a cool, dry environment. item.g:title: Evolution Aqua - Pure Sludge Bomb
item.g:description: From the makers of the original Pure Pond Bomb, the Evolution Aqua Pure Sludge Bomb has been specifically designed to target the organic waste and sludge that builds at the base of a pond. Reducing sludge is of great benefit to your pond as this helps to improve the water quality, increase oxygen levels and even reduce maintenance. The PURE Sludge Bomb contains millions of beneficial bacteria and natural enzymes that rapidly break down and digest sludge and organic waste, simply drop the PURE Sludge Bomb with the activating gel directly into your pond or filter and it get to work straight away. PURE Sludge Bomb can be used regularly from the spring when the pond comes to life to the Autumn to help the pond be ready for the winter and is safe for all ornamental fish ponds A single Evolution Aqua PURE Sludge Bomb is suitable for all Koi ponds, ornamental ponds and self contained water features up to 20000 Litres (4400 Gallons) as there is no risk of overdosing.

item.g:title: Oase AquaMax Eco Expert 21000 Filter and Waterfall Pump
item.g:description: The Oase AquaMax Eco Expert 21000 pumps are an energy-efficient pump range designed for extremely powerful but economic performance, they are perfect for use in demanding filter systems or for large watercourses and waterfalls. They have robust stainless steel strainer which allows particles as large as 11mm to pass through and be pumped. The design includes unique, patented frost protection meaning the pump will not be damaged at temperatures as low as -20°C. The Oase AquaMax Eco Expert 21000 pumps include Oases' Environmental Function Control (EFC) protection which means the pump is switched off if the Impeller chamber is not full of water. This guards against dry running and blocking problems. Suitable for submerged or dry running installations (but is not self priming). These pumps are unusually quiet in operation meaning they are ideal for use in pump chambers. Oases' Patented Seasonal Flow Control (SFC) included in the design which if switched on will reduce the flow as the temperature drops. This can lead to 30% energy savings. Supplied with 10m of power cable and a 3 year warranty, which can be upgraded to 5 years by sending the guarantee card off to Oase. Oase AquaMax Eco Expert 21000 Pond Pump Features • Very high flowrate 21000 LPH • Can pass up to 11mm solids • Can be dry mounted or submerged • Large stable base and handle • Side outlet position • Exceptionally quiet • Environmental Function Control (EFC) protection • Seasonal Flow Control (SFC) • Up to 5 years warranty • OASE Control (OC) compatible • OASE Eco Pump Control compatible These pumps are part of the OASE Control (OC) range which allows remote monitoring and control via free access to the OASE Cloud. This allows you to communicate with your pond whilst away from home. See the "More Info" tab below for other OC compatible products. If you only need local control of this pump then the Oase Eco control can be used instead of the full OC system

item.g:title: NT Labs MediKoi Probiotic Multi Season Fish Food (6mm) - 5Kg
item.g:description: The 5Kg NT Labs Medikoi Probiotic Multi Season Fish Food has been designed to bring you a complete, professional diet for koi at a wide range of water temperatures. The ingredients contained in Medikoi Probiotic are of the highest quality, and have been selected to support healthy growth, significantly enhance colour definition and optimise body shape. This Probiotic food includes not only beneficial gut bacteria to help your fish break down foods more effectively, but also contains a prebiotic (fructo-oligosaccharide). This combination of probiotic bacteria and a prebiotic ensures a healthy, active population of gut bacteria and digestive enzymes to efficiently break down food to release all the vital nutrients it contains, allowing your fish to achieve its optimal body mass gain whilst reducing waste to keep your pond clean and clear. The nutritional balance of Medikoi Probiotic enables this complete feed to be fed over a large temperature range (from 5°C - 26°C), making this the best choice for your koi all year round. The pellets of Medikoi Probiotic have been vacuum-coated to prevent the proteins and oils in the food from leaching into the water and causing an unsightly surface slick to form. 5Kg NT Labs Medikoi Probiotic Fish Food Feeding Recommendations For beautiful, healthy fish, alternate feeding to include Medikoi Health for 3 weeks followed by Medikoi Probiotic for 2 weeks, and so on. Feed twice daily during the growing season, on each occasion a quantity that fish will likely consume within 10 minutes. In winter, feed only once per day. Alternatively, feed your fish Medikoi Wheatgerm with Garlic during these colder months. Do not overfeed. Keep contents sealed in original packaging away from direct sunlight. Store in a cool, dry environment. 5Kg NT Labs Medikoi Probiotic Fish Food Key Components Probiotics - to enhance gut bacteria. Prebiotic - to encourage further gut bacterial development. Spirulina and Astaxanthin - to naturally enhance colour pigmentation . 5Kg NT Labs Probiotic Fish Food Ingredients Fish Meal, Wheat, Krill Meal, Wheatgerm, Maize Starch, Fish Oil, Spirulina, Monocalcium Phosphate, Yeast Products (Stimmune), Inulin 5Kg NT Labs Probiotic Fish Food Nutrition Crude Protein 38% Crude Oil & Fat 8% Crude Fibre 1.5% Crude Ash 10% 5Kg NT Labs Probiotic Fish Food Additives (per 1000g) Vitamin - A 25000 IU Vitamin - C 330 mg Vitamin - D 1604 IU Vitamin - E 220 mg 5Kg NT Labs Probiotic Fish Food Trace Elements (per 1000g) 3b107 Iron (chelate of protein hydrolysates) 60 mg 3b202 Iodine (calcium iodate, anhydrous) 5 mg 3b407 Copper (chelate of protein hydrolysates) 5 mg 3b505 Manganese (chelate of protein hydrolysates) 20 mg 3b612 Zinc (chelate of protein hydrolysates) 60 mg 4b1820 Bacillus subtilis C-3102 (DSM 15544) 1x10 CFU

Alternatively, feed your fish Medikoi Wheatgerm with Garlic during these colder months. Do not overfeed. Keep contents sealed in original packaging away from direct sunlight. Store in a cool, dry environment. 1.75Kg NT Labs Medikoi Probiotic Fish Food Key Components Probiotics - to enhance gut bacteria. Prebiotic - to encourage further gut bacterial development. Spirulina and Astaxanthin - to naturally enhance colour pigmentation . 1.75Kg NT Labs Probiotic Fish Food Ingredients Fish Meal, Wheat, Krill Meal, Wheatgerm, Maize Starch, Fish Oil, Spirulina, Monocalcium Phosphate, Yeast Products (Stimmune), Inulin 1.75Kg NT Labs Probiotic Fish Food Nutrition Crude Protein 38% Crude Oil & Fat 8% Crude Fibre 1.5% Crude Ash 10% 1.75Kg NT Labs Probiotic Fish Food Additives (per 1000g) Vitamin - A 25000 IU Vitamin - C 330 mg Vitamin - D 1604 IU Vitamin - E 220 mg 1.75Kg NT Labs Probiotic Fish Food Trace Elements (per 1000g) 3b107 Iron (chelate of protein hydrolysates) 60 mg 3b202 Iodine (calcium iodate, anhydrous) 5 mg 3b407 Copper (chelate of protein hydrolysates) 5 mg 3b505 Manganese (chelate of protein hydrolysates) 20 mg 3b612 Zinc (chelate of protein hydrolysates) 60 mg 4b1820 Bacillus subtilis C-3102 (DSM 15544) 1x10 CFU

item.g:title: Oase AquaMax Eco Premium 5000 Filter and Waterfall Pump
item.g:description: The Oase AquaMax Eco Premium 5000 are the very latest version of Oases' high performance AquaMax Eco range of solid handling pond filter pumps. In 2024 Oase redesigned the motor for the Aquamax Eco Premiums resulting in a quieter, more energy efficient pumps, saving 14% - 24% of the running costs (depending on the model) which should also help them last longer than their older models (that is saying something). The new motors have what Oase call "Core 6 Technology" which means they have six windings instead of the traditional 4, these windings have also been curved which produces smoother running, adding to their efficiency and also making them quieter. These new Oase AquaMax Eco Premium pumps also feature impellors that have been improved and are now effectively handmade with glass-fibre reinforced plastic making them much stronger and allowing them to take solids of up to 11mm in size. All of the new AquaMax Eco Premium pumps can now be controlled electronically via the Oase Smart Phone App using the DMX technology which is available in their OC ("Oase Control" system, formerly known as EGC) range of products. Individual pumps can be controlled using an Oase Eco Controller (OAE016) or if the pump is part of an installation using other OC products which can be remotely controlled then a Oase Control Cable Adapter can be purchased to link other units. All of the AquaMax Eco Premium pumps have the option of using the secondary inlet port to run an optional remote strainer (OAA501) or skimmer (OAA102), both of which can improve the circulation within your pond and reduce the likelihood of 'dead' areas and silt build up. Like their predecessors these pumps still have the seasonal function control (SFC) function which automatically slows the pump down (saving money) in colder water temperatures and they can still be dry installed (SFC does not work in dry installations) and reliable protection against blockages and dry running with EFC (Environmental Function Control) All AquaMax Eco Premium 5000 pumps are supplied with 10m of mains cable, inlet and outlet hosetails which will accept 25mm - 38mm flexible hosepipe and a 25, 32 and 38mm plastic hose clip. The Oase AquaMax Eco Premium 5000 pumps are covered by a 3 year guarantee, which can be extended to 5 years free of charge, simply by sending the warranty card off to Oase. Oase Aquamax Eco Premium 5000 Features • Flowrates of up to 5000 litres per hour. • Improved efficiency • Brilliant power balance: Reliable flowrate's at lower power consumption • Secondary inlet connection for optional strainer or skimmer for dirt feeding of further pond zones • Unique, patented frost protection: to -20°C • Delivery rate is controllable mechanically and electronically (Using the Oase App) • Quiet at the dry installation • Will pump particles of up to 11mm • "Environmental Function Control" (EFC by OASE) protects against dry-run or blocking These pumps are part of the OASE Control (previously called "Easy Garden Control (EGC)") range which allows remote monitoring and control via free access to the OASE Cloud. This allows you to communicate with your pond whilst away from home. See the "More Info" tab below for other OC (EGC) compatible products.

item.g:title: Generic - 13w - 2 Pin PLS TUV Ultra Violet Bulb Double Lug For A Fish Mate Pressurised 15000
item.g:description: The 13w 2 Pin TUV PLS lamps for a Fish Mate Pressurised 15000 are compact UVC (germicidal) lamps used in Ultra Violet Clarifiers. The compact size of the lamp allows for a small system design and design flexibility. TUV PLS lamps offer constant UV output over their complete lifetime, for high system efficacy. Thanks to the single ended lamp base, lamp replacement is easy. The base fitting has 2 lugs on each side and is suitable for most brands of Ultra Violet Lights. Not suitable for Hozelock Easyclear 9000 and newer Bioforce filters. 13w 2 Pin PLS TUV Ultra Violet Lamp Benefits • Security of effectiveness over the complete lifetime of the bulb • Short-wave UV radiation with a peak at 253.7 nm (UVC) for disinfection purposes • Protective inside coating ensures constant UV output over the complete lifetime of the lamp • Lamp glass filters out the 185 nm ozone-forming line • PL-S lamp base contains a special starter for almost instant starting UV Bulb Specification • Description : Generic 13w PLS UV bulb (2 pins at one end and two lugs per side) • Length - Overall : 178mm • Length - Glass : 140mm • Ceramic - Width : 16mm • Ceramic - Breadth : 32mm

item.g:title: Oase Waterfall Spring / Spillway Box 35000
item.g:description: The Oase Waterfall Spring / Spillway Box 35000 is a simple solution to the problem of installing a waterfall without a header pool. These one piece waterfall boxes are simply placed on the liner at the top of the stream with the rear flange sealing to the liner at the back of the box. These ultra strong boxes are designed to be covered in rocks and cobbles and have a raised lip on the top of the water chute to prevent stones, cobbles or even soil falling into the water. In addition to adding strength, the internal support cones also diffuse the water flow to ensure an even coverage across the outflow lip. Unlike other spillways these one piece waterfall springs are completely sealed, so no matter how much water is pumped in, the only place it can come out is through the opening at the front, ensuring water is never lost. Oase Waterfall Spring / Spillway Box 35000 Dimensions • Oase Waterfall Spring 35000 - 1003mm long x 486mm wide x 260mm high (960mm Waterfall width) Oase Waterfall Spring / Spillway Box 35000 Features • One piece box to ensure leak free installation • Maximum flowrate 36000 litres per hour • Extra strong to allowing them to be camouflaged with rocks and cobbles • 3" (75mm) BSP female connection on 35000 • 3" (75mm) BSP to 2" (50mm) BSP male to male adaptors supplied with 35000
item.g:product_type: Pond Products > Building Your Pond Or Water Feature > Stream or Waterfall Headers / Spillway

item.g:title: Oase Pond Jet ECO Premium Floating Fountain
item.g:description: Bring your pond or lake to life with the Oase PondJet Eco Premium, a high-performance floating fountain pump that creates a stunning water display up to 3.75 metres high. Ideal for large ponds and water features, this self-contained unit combines effortless installation with impressive performance and energy efficiency. Spectacular Floating Fountain Display The PondJet Eco Premium features a powerful pump suspended beneath a float, pushing water through 12 built-in nozzles to form an elegant arching fountain up to 3.75m high and 3m wide. The floating design means there's no need to build a platform—just 0.5m of water depth is required beneath the unit. Easy to Install & Maintain No platform needed – pump stays above debris and sediment Simple tethering – secure in place or easily move it to shore for maintenance Works in shallow water – only 0.5m depth required below pump Upgraded Power & Efficiency In 2025, Oase upgraded this model with the Aquarius Eco Premium 13500 pump, featuring innovative CORE 6 Technology for: 25% lower energy consumption than previous models Quieter, smoother operation with six curved motor windings A taller fountain display – now up to 3.75m high You can also swap out the nozzle to customise your display using compatible options like the Foam Jet (35-10) or Vulcan (37-2.5) . The Foam Jet creates a single column full of a mix of air and water which is 1.8m high and 32 mm in diameter. If you choose the Vulcan (37-2.5), then it creates what is often thought of as a more traditional fountain with a central jet and two lower tiers, which is 3.7m tall and 2.2m in diameter. An illuminated fountain has a particularly beautiful effect in the evening and in hours of darkness. We offer sets which include the PondJet pump and either white or RGB lighting kits to illuminate your fountain in the evening. Dynamic Display & Smart App Control Choose between constant full-power operation or enabling the dynamic display mode, which varies the water flow in a preset pattern for a more animated water feature. For full control, connect the pump to the Oase Control (OC) system using the Oase Control Cable (sold separately). With the InScenio FM-Master OC, you can manage your fountain and lighting through the Oase app on your phone or tablet, and you have access to 10 more preset dynamic displays. What’s Included Oase PondJet Eco Premium (includes float and integrated nozzle) 20m mains power cable 3-year warranty, extendable to 5 years with Oase registration Optional: Enhance your display with the PondJet Light Set (sold separately), featuring 3 x LunAqua Power LED lights, mounting brackets, a transformer, and a 20 m power/OC cable.

item.g:title: Velda Artificial Orange Lily - 17cm
item.g:description: Many people struggle to create shade in their pond either because of fish activity, pests or moving/spraying water, but these floating plant will not be affected by any of these problems. The Velda Orange Artificial Water Lily will survive the British winter. Use them as singles or in groups to create pond cover giving shade for the fish and cutting light out to reduce the growth of algae. They may also help your fish hide from predators. The Velda - Orange Artificial Water Lily is made from a soft durable and weather resistant foam and plastic materials, these 17cm wide artificial red water lily's offer a great alternative or addition to fresh pond plants. By introducing Artificial Pond Plants any pond can benefit from the visual impact they produce as well as the beneficial shading they produce. These plants can simply be rinsed and then placed in your pond, either as singles or in groups. Each artificial lily has a loop underneath which could be used with a length of nylon wire/string (not supplied) to secure the lily in place or to group multiples together.

item.g:title: Pontec Pondorell 1500 - Solar Pond Filter
item.g:description: Ideal for wildlife ponds, the Pontec Pondorell 1500 - Solar Pond Filter is a compact, solar-powered underwater filter which includes a pump, filter material and a UVC unit and is suitable for wildlife ponds up to 1,500 litres (without fish stocks). Being solar powered there is no energy cost and no need for mains powered cable; however, it is supplied with a mains adapter so if it is close enough to power, it can be operated even on cloudy days. Powered by a 15w solar panel, the pump draws the water through the filter and UV and pushes the water up through the fountain nozzle. The 2 fountain nozzles supplied are a fine spray jet and a bell jet. The maximum depth for the fountain nozzles when using the extensions is 300mm. The pump and UV are supplied with 5m of cable, which then connects to a 5m joiner and extension cable, allowing the panel to be located up to 10m away from the filter location. The Pontec Pondorell 1500 - Solar Pond Filter includes a mains power adapter which has a 1.8m cable but does not include a battery unit. Supplied with a 2-year guarantee. Pontec Pondorell 1500 - Solar Pond Filter Features Solar Powered - No Mains Requires Suitable for wildlife ponds 2 Fountains Head Designs 10m Solar cable 1.8m Mains Adapter 2 Year Guarantee Pontec Pondorell 1500 - Solar Pond Filter Dimensions: Panel - 440mm x 290mm Pump/Filter - 270mm x 190mm x 115mm

item.g:title: Oase Aquarius Eco Premium 4500 Water Feature Pump
item.g:description: The Oase Aquarius Eco Premium 4500 Water Feature Pumps are part of the latest generation of water feature pumps with smart control via Oase Control (OC) and CORE 6 Technology. The new CORE 6 Technology motors from Oase were introduced in 2024 in their flagship Aquamax Premium filter pumps. These motors have six windings instead of the traditional 4, with curved windings producing smoother running, enhanced efficiency and a quieter running pump. Combined these enable power consumption to be reduced by between 46% and 50% compared to previous models. In addition to the Core 6 motor technology these new versions also have the option for a dynamic display and connection, via EGC cable (not included), to the Oase Control (OC) system. The Dynamic display is a preprogrammed (non-adjustable) sequence of flow changes which will adjust the flow to a fountain nozzle (not supplied) or water feature creating a varying display. The Oase Control (OC) systems offer a few options for remotely controlling the pump, from the basic Eco Controller (simple manual buttons), to the Inscenio Controller and Inscenio FM-Master where you can control the function and displays from a mobile App. Supplied with 10m of cable, 2 way distribution controller and hosetails (inlet and outlet) which will take 25, 32, 38mm (1, 1¼,1½”) hose, all pumps can be submerged in the pond or dry mounted outside but below water level. The Oase Aquarius Eco Premium 4500 Water Feature Pumps are protected against blocking and running dry and come with a 3 guarantee which can be extend by a further 2 years if you register your purchase with Oase. The Aquarius Universal is mainly designed as a water feature pumps, however it can also be used as a high performance fountain pump if used with optional Oase fountain fittings Oase also supply the Aquarius fountain pump sets Oase Aquarius Eco Premium 4500 Water Feature Pump Features Flowrate up to 4500 litres per hour 4m Maximum lift New Core 6 Motor Technology Reduced power consumptions Low water inlet point Wet or Dry running Dynamic Display option Oase Control (OC) compatible These fountain pumps are part of the OASE Control (previously called "Easy Garden Control (EGC)") range which allows remote monitoring and control via free access to the OASE Cloud. This allows you to communicate with your pond whilst away from home. See the "More Info" tab below for other OC (EGC) compatible products.
item.g:product_type: Pond Products > Pumping and Filtering your Pond > Pond Fountain Pumps and Accessories > Oase Aquarius Eco Premium Feature Pumps
item.g:google_product_category: Animals & Pet Supplies > Pet Supplies > Fish Supplies > Aquarium & Fish Tank Accessories

item.g:description: The Oase Aquarius Eco Premium 6500 Water Feature Pumps are part of the latest generation of water feature pumps with smart control via Oase Control (OC) and CORE 6 Technology. These motors have six windings instead of the traditional 4, with curved windings producing smoother running, enhanced efficiency and a quieter running pump. Combined these enable power consumption to be reduced by between 46% and 50% compared to previous models. In addition to the Core 6 motor technology these new versions also have the option for a dynamic display and connection, via EGC cable (not included), to the Oase Control (OC) system. The Dynamic display is a preprogrammed (non-adjustable) sequence of flow changes which will adjust the flow to a fountain nozzle (not supplied) or water feature creating a varying display. The Oase Control (OC) systems offer a few options for remotely controlling the pump, from the basic Eco Controller (simple manual buttons), to the Inscenio Controller and Inscenio FM-Master where you can control the function and displays from a mobile App. Supplied with 10m of cable, 2 way distribution controller and hosetails (inlet and outlet) which will take 25, 32, 38mm (1, 1¼,1½”) hose, all pumps can be submerged in the pond or dry mounted outside but below water level. The Oase Aquarius Eco Premium 6500 Water Feature Pumps are protected against blocking and running dry and come with a 3 guarantee which can be extend by a further 2 years if you register your purchase with Oase. The Aquarius Universal is mainly designed as a water feature pumps, however it can also be used as a high performance fountain pump if used with optional Oase fountain fittings Oase also supply the Aquarius fountain pump sets Oase Aquarius Eco Premium 6500 Water Feature Pump Features Flowrate up to 6500 litres per hour 4m Maximum lift New Core 6 Motor Technology Reduced power consumptions Low water inlet point Wet or Dry running Dynamic Display option Oase Control (OC) compatible These fountain pumps are part of the OASE Control (previously called "Easy Garden Control (EGC)") range which allows remote monitoring and control via free access to the OASE Cloud. item.g:title: Betta Choice - Solar 5250 - Solar Waterfall Pump Set
item.g:description: The Betta Choice - Solar 5250 - Solar Waterfall Pump Set is a 5250 litre per hour solar pump kit with a 50w solar pump, 2 x 50w panels with ground spikes, 5m connecting cable, Y-cable connector and outlet hosetail (25mm, 32mm and 38mm). The Betta Choice Solar Waterfall Sets have been specifically designed and engineered for the UK's climate and feature large, high powered PV solar panels to ensure improved performance even in overcast or cloudy conditions. Quick and easy to install, the 5250 litres per hour solar pumps have a 3.0m maximum lift of 2.5m and should be placed within the pond or water feature and connected to the PV panels via the 5m cable included. The low voltage system is fully waterproof and safe to use outside with no mains required. Simply place the PV panel in an area with direct sunlight at approximately 45-60 degrees to the sky in a south facing direction and enjoy your new water feature! Built-in run dry protection, the solar pumps will cut out if the water level drops too low and brushless motor technology with locked rotor and overheat protection. This kit comes with a 1 year guarantee, which can be extended to 2 years if the purchase is registered with the manufacturers with 30 days of purchase. item.g:title: Cloverleaf Sludge Answer - 250ml
item.g:description: Cloverleaf Sludge Answer 250ml is a simple way to clean the bottom of your pond. If your pond water looks a bit murky or smells unpleasant, there’s a good chance that sludge has built up at the bottom. This can come from fallen leaves, fish waste, leftover food, or dead algae and will continue to increase over time. Left untreated this sludge can ultimately cause both Oxygen and brown water clarity problem which spoils the pond for both you and your fish. Cloverleaf Sludge Answer 250ml makes it easy to deal with this problem. It contains a special mix of friendly bacteria and natural enzymes that break down the silt and sediment sitting on the pond floor, helping to clear the water and keep your fish and plants healthy. This process is completely safe for fish, plants, pets, and wildlife. Use regularly through spring, summer, and autumn to keep your pond looking its best. Cloverleaf Sludge Answer 250ml benefits Helps clear cloudy water and improve visibility Reduces bad smells caused by waste build-up Makes your pond healthier for fish and plants Safe and natural – no chemicals, no hassle How to use Cloverleaf Sludge Answer 250ml This product works best if used regularly through spring, summer, and autumn. How Much To Use The standard dosage is 100ml of Cloverleaf Sludge Answer for every 1000 litres ( 220 gallons) of pond water . This should be added to a bucket and evenly distributed around the pond and can be repeated every 28 days. For particularly stubborn slit problems this can be increased to 50ml per 1000 litres of pond water To maximise its effectiveness it helps to switch off your UV for the first 24 hours after adding this treatment Cloverleaf Sludge Answer - 250ml - Treats up to 2500 Litres (550 G)

item.g:description: This 70cm x 70cm Water Feature Metal Grid with Insert offers a straightforward and reliable way to cover water feature reservoirs. item.g:title: Bermuda 400 Solar Pump Filter, UV with Battery
item.g:description: The Bermuda Solar 400 is perfect for wildlife ponds up to 800 litres as it has a solar powered pump, filter and UV and will help keep the water clear and healthy. Each set includes the solar panel, pump, filter, UV (5w) and battery pack (no mains charger) along with the fountain nozzle fittings. The pump and UV each have 5m of cable which plugs into the battery, as does the panel (2m cable). Unlike other units of this type, the Bermuda Solar 400 is supplied with a battery unit that will store up to 4 hours of power, which can then be used to run the pump and UV, UV only or the pump only. These units only work through the battery and so will not function outside of the programmed time slot. The starting time slot is fixed when it is set and will restart every 24 hours. They come with the option of two fountain nozzles a fine Spray Jet or a Bell Jet. The maximum height for the fountain nozzles when using the extensions is 300mm and is supplied with a 1 year guarantee. Bermuda Solar 400 Wildlife Pond Filter Features An efficient integrated pump, filter and UV. 2 Foam filter grades to ensure crystal clear water. Sponge, Bio surface elements and filter pebbles to ensure healthy fish and plants. A UVC to eliminate green water. The battery unit allows for up to 4 hours running (per 24 hours) 9w Solar Panel 1 Year Guarantee. Bermuda Solar 400 Dimensions Pump/Filter - 270mm x 190mm x 115mm 9w Solar Panel - 345mm x 245mm

item.g:title: NT Labs MediKoi Sturgeon Food (4.5mm) - 3Kg
item.g:description: Medikoi Sturgeon Food is a quick-sinking pellet, specifically formulated to provide a complete feed for sturgeon and sterlet. The food is packed with highly digestible protein in a form which allows your fish to be fully metabolised it. It is also packed full of vitamins, minerals and oils, making this feed highly palatable for sturgeon, sterlet and other species of pond fish. The key components are Protein (46%) and Oils (15%) Protein - A high proportion of readily and easily assimilated proteins, allowing it to be easily and fully metabolised and digested by sturgeon, minimising waste and so minimising your maintenance. These proteins provide your fish with the essential amino acids they require which can only be found in in a high-quality diet. Oils - Medikoi Sturgeon contains oils rich in omega-3 which meet the high energetic requirements of sturgeon and sterlet. It is safe to feed to your sturgeon and sterlet all year round. Sinking Feed - This pellet has been designed to quickly sink to the bottom of the pond to ensure that your sturgeon and sterlet can begin feeding immediately, helping to maintain optimum water quality. Medikoi Sturgeon Food - 3Kg Feeding Recommendations Before feeding Medikoi Sturgeon, feed your pond fish Medikoi Staple, or another food in the Medikoi range, to keep these other species occupied and prevent them outcompeting your sturgeon for this high-quality, sinking feed. Spring: As water temperatures begin to increase, so too will the activity and energy demand of your sturgeon and sterlet. Gradually add Medikoi Sturgeon pellets to the pond, only adding more when all the pellets have been eaten. Summer: During these warmer months, sturgeon and sterlet growth is at its maximum, creating high energy demands in these fish. Be sure to feed Medikoi Sturgeon regularly, an amount which your sturgeon will consume before they become disinterested. Autumn and winter: Sturgeon will continue to feed at temperatures as low as 4°C. Continue to feed Medikoi Sturgeon as temperatures begin to drop, but monitor the amount your sturgeon are eating and adjust the amounts you provide for them accordingly. Do not overfeed. Keep contents sealed in original packaging away from direct sunlight. Store in a cool, dry environment. Medikoi Sturgeon Food - 3Kg Ingredients Wheat, Fish Meal, Poultry Meal, Poultry Blood Meal, Maize Gluten, Wheat Gluten, Sunflower Meal, Fish Oil, Lecithin, Yeast Products (Stimmune) Medikoi Sturgeon Food - 3Kg Nutrition Crude Protein 46% Crude Oil & Fat 15% Crude Fibre 1.8% Crude Ash 6.4% Medikoi Sturgeon Food - 3Kg Additives (per 1000g) Vitamin - A 10000 IU Vitamin - C 500 mg Vitamin - D 1888 IU Vitamin - E 200 mg

item.g:title: Oase AquaActive AlGo Direct 500ml - Blanketweed Killer
item.g:description: Blanketweed (Thread Algae) loves clear, healthy, free flowing water and it is common for customers with crystal clear ponds to complain about it growing on their waterfall, blade, statues and streams. Unlike many other products Oase Aquactiv Algo Direct works through direct contact with the algae and is ideal for treating localised problems. After application Blanketweed is killed within a few hours and the active ingredient breaks it down into its natural occurring components, which means it can also be used in swim ponds (refer to safety wait time). As the pH and carbonate hardness are important when using this product, Oase include a pH and KH rapid test to check the pH value is between 6.5 and 8.5 and the carbonate hardness is >5°dKH, this ensures the safe application of this treatment. Maximum Pond Volume 10,000 litres. item.g:description: Add a splash of movement and light to your garden with the Pontec Pondosolar LED Island which is a quick to install compact floating solar pump. item.g:title: MasterPlug Heavy Duty 13A - 3 Pin Plug
item.g:description: The Masterplug Heavy Duty 13A plug has a impact resistant body and solid brass sleeved pins which can easily withstand the few knocks which can occur with outdoor products and should fit in most outdoor three pin plug sockets. Completely rewireable, the plug is manufactured to BS1363-2 and has a 13 amp fuse. Supplied with a 1-year guarantee. Why do I need a plug? When the regulations came into effect requiring all electrical products to be fitted with plugs, pond equipment was given an exception. Within the UK pond filtration market, it is recommended that all products that are permanently connected to the mains power supply are "hard wired" into a suitable weatherproof switchbox, this is why all pond products are supplied without fitted plugs. In certain situations you may choose to us a suitable weatherproof connection box which is designed to be used with standard 3 pin plugs, if this is the case the Masterplug Heavy Duty 13A plug would be a good option. Please remember that outdoor electrical work should only be done by a "competent person" and if you are in any doubt you should always consult a qualified electrician.

item.g:title: Oase Maxima 60 Pondless Grid Module
item.g:description: Oase Maxima 60 Pondless Grid Module is ideal for creating Pondless water features such as waterfalls without a visible reservoir. The Maxima blocks are extremely durable modular matrix blocks for creating hidden water tanks which are placed underground in lined ponds. The Maxima 60 blocks come in a flat pack form and simply need clipping together. The lattice style design maximises their strength whilst not impacting on the water volume allowed within them - 96% of the volume is water storage. The Oase Maxima 60 blocks can take huge weights compared to other reservoirs - up to 6000kg. In a typical installation a hole would be dug and then lined with a Butyl or Greenseal EPDM liner, a Pump Vault (sold separately) would be installed and the blocks built up to fill the rest of the void. The whole area would then be covered with rocks or large aggregate (bigger than the lattice holes). The reservoir area can then be filled with water creating effectively a large underground reservoir with much more water capacity then a preformed reservoir. The pump would be located in the Pump Chamber and would push the water through hose to your waterfall, stones or feature. Supplied with a 2 year guarantee. Oase Maxima 60 Pondless Block Module Features Ultra strong - will support upto 6000 Kg Simple clip together construction 96% water storage capacity 2 year guarantee This grid is often used with the Oase Pondlesss Pump Vault 20000 Oase Maxima 60 Pondless Block Module Assembled Size Length: 686mm x Width: 406mm x Depth: 222mm For deeper areas the Oase Maxima 120 Pondless Grid Module can be used

item.g:title: Oase Pondless Pump Vault 20000 Module
item.g:description: The Oase Pondless Pump Vault 20000 Modules are designed to be used in conjunction with the Maxima 60 Block modules to create hidden underground reservoirs and allow easy access to your water pump for cleaning and maintenance. Each Oase Pondless Pump Vault 20000 Module has an area which can be drilled to allow the hose to be routed out through the Maxima grids, however cutting a path through the grids could impact the weight they can support. The Pump Vault 20000 has moulded exit position to allow the easy installation of a OASE 3 Way Diverter Valve (sold separately) which is ideal if you are running multiple features. The Oase Pondless Pump Vault 20000 Modules have slots on the two short sides to allow the water to flow in the chamber, these are 210mm up the tank so this needs to be taken in to account when designing the size of the reservoir area. These pump vaults are made from very heavy-duty polyethylene, comes with a lid which can hold a maximum weight 100kg and are supplied with a 2 year guarantee. This Large single white light is a 6.5w high quality 24v LED light which produces a warm white light (3000k) and has a brightness of 250 Lux, it is fully waterproof and can be installed underwater or anywhere around your garden. The Oase LunAqua Connect Large White Solo Light can be connected to either a Oase LunAqua Connect Power unit or via an Oase LunAqua Connect Easy Switch Controller using its 3m connection cable. This solo light is supplied with a stable base and a ground spike and comes with a 2 year warranty which can be upgraded to 3 years completely free of charge simply by registering your purchase with Oase. Oase LunAqua Connect Large Solo White Light dimensions: 61mm Dia x 98 mm Height Oase LunAqua Connect Large White Solo Light Features Top quality, robust LED spotlight 6.5w consumption 500 Lux of warm white light (3000K) 30 Degree light beam angle. 3m of connection cable 2 + 1 year guarantee 1m Maximum submersion depth Please note This is a single add-on light for an existing system or custom build kit and requires a power unit which is not included.
item.g:product_type: Pond Products > Create a Unique Look And Feel > Garden and Underwater Pond Lights > Oase LunAqua Connect LED Lighting

item.g:title: Oase LunAqua Connect Medium RGB Solo Light
item.g:description: The Oase LunAqua Connect Medium RGB Solo Light is part of the Oase LunAqua Connect lighting system and can be used as an add-on for an existing system or within a complete custom build set-up. This Medium single RGB light is a 7.5w high quality 24v LED light which produces a full spectrum of colours (over 90 CRI) and has a brightness of 200 Lux, it is fully waterproof and can be installed underwater or anywhere around your garden. The Oase LunAqua Connect Medium RGB Solo Light can be connected via an Oase LunAqua Connect Easy Switch Controller using its 3m connection cable. This solo light is supplied with a stable base and a ground spike and comes with a 2 year warranty which can be upgraded to 3 years completely free of charge simply by registering your purchase with Oase. Oase LunAqua Connect Medium Solo RGB Light dimensions: 53mm Dia x 87 mm Height Oase LunAqua Connect Medium RGB Solo Light Features Top quality, robust LED spotlight 6.5w consumption 200 Lux full spectrum RGB light (over 90 CRI) 30 Degree light beam angle. 3m of connection cable 2 + 1 year guarantee 1m Maximum submersion depth Please note This is a single add-on light for an existing system or custom build kit and requires a power unit and controller which are not included. RGD White Mode Please note that although it is technically possible to adjust the RGB light to produce a white light, this will not match the warm white light off the white spotlight.

item.g:title: Oase LunAqua Connect Easy Switch Controller
item.g:description: The Oase LunAqua Connect Easy Switch Controller can be used to expand and control an existing Oase LunAqua Connect lighting system or be used as part of a complete custom build set-up. This controller has 2 x white lighting connectors and 1 x RGB lighting connector allowing multiple white and RGB lights to be controlled. Once installed this adds dimming and timing to all lights (out of each outlet) and even colour changing options to RGB lights, all from this with the easy to use controller or remotely using the Oase Switch app on your mobile phone (IOS or Android). The weatherproof controller is only limited by the maximum load of the power unit (either 36w or 60w) and the total cable length (from the controller) within the system being less than 100m. The Oase LunAqua Connect Easy Switch Controller is supplied with a 2 year warranty which can be upgraded to 3 years completely free of charge simply by registering your purchase with Oase. Oase LunAqua Connect Easy Switch Controller Features Control Oase LunAqua Connect lights with controller or Oase Switch mobile app Needed for use of Oase LunAqua Connect RGB lights Adds timing and dimming function to all lights in the system (along each line of the outlets). Adds colour changing control to connected RGB lights (not individual lights). Fully Weatherproof. Connection for 2 x white light cable runs. Connection for 1 x RGB light cable run. 3m of connecting cable to Oase LunAqua Connect power unit 2 + 1 year guarantee.
item.g:product_type: Pond Products > Create a Unique Look And Feel > Garden and Underwater Pond Lights > Oase LunAqua Connect LED Lighting
item.g:google_product_category: Hardware > Lamps, Lighting & Ceiling Fans

item.g:title: Oase LunAqua Connect 36w Power Unit
item.g:description: The Oase LunAqua Connect 36w Power Unit is part of the Oase Connect lighting system and can be used within a complete custom build set-up. This power unit can run upto 36w of Oase Connect LED white lights directly or a combination of white and / or RGB lights through a Oase Easy Switch Controller. The Oase LunAqua Connect 36w power unit is fully weatherproof, has 1.5m of mains cable and is supplied with a 2 year warranty which can be upgraded to 3 years completely free of charge simply by registering your purchase with Oase. Oase LunAqua Connect 36w Power Unit Features Can be used in a custom build set-up Power upto 36w of Oase Connect lights Will run Oase Connect White lights directly Provides power to an Oase Easy Switch Controller Fully Weatherproof 1.5m of mains cable 2 + 1 year guarantee How many lights could a Connect 36w Power Unit run? Here are some possible combinations: With a Controller: 14 x Small white lights (14 x 2.5w = 35w) 9 x Medium white lights (9 x 4w = 36w) 5 x Large white lights (5 x 6.5w = 32.5w) With a Controller: 4 x Medium RGB lights (4 x 7.5w = 30w)

item.g:title: 250g/m² Underlay to Suit (58 Sqm - 2m x 29m)
item.g:description: Our 58 Square Metres of top-quality 250gm/m² pond liner underlay is designed to provide exceptional protection against roots and punctures. Made from a densely woven fibre, this high-density material is engineered for durability and long-lasting performance. Key Features: Superior Durability: Our 250gm/m² pond liner underlay is constructed from a high-quality, densely woven fibre that is both root resistant and puncture resistant, ensuring maximum protection for your liner. Exceptional Strength: So robust that even our in-house cutting process is challenged by its density, this underlay is recommended for those seeking the best protection for their pond liners. Easy Application: Cur from a 2m (6ft 6in) wide roll, the underlay is designed for straightforward installation, providing a reliable barrier for your pond. Invest in our premium 250gm/m² pond liner underlay for unbeatable durability and effective liner protection. Perfect for DIY pond projects and professional installations, this underlay is the ideal solution to safeguard your pond liner and extend its lifespan.

item.g:title: 30m Roll - 12mm (½") Flexible Hose Pipe
item.g:description: This is a 30m roll of the standard 12mm (½") internal diameter flexible hose we supply to suit all the products we sell and offers great value for larger projects, with a 10% lower price than the "by the metre" rate. The corrugation of the 12mm (½") hose contains a strengthener, which enables the hose to be flexible and strong but will not kink in most pond installations. The 12mm (½") hose is black for easy concealment and to discourage growth of algae on the inside, which can, long term, lead to a reduction in the hose diameter and thus affect the pumps performance. When using flexible pipework we recommend the use of 12mm Stainless Steel Jubilee Clips to ensure a secure and leak free installation.
item.g:product_type: Pond Products > Pumping and Filtering your Pond > Flexible Hose and Fittings > Corrugated Flexible Hose Pipe - 30m Rolls
item.g:google_product_category: Hardware > Plumbing > Plumbing Fittings & Supports

item.g:description: This is a 30m roll of the Heavy Duty Corrugated Flexible Hose Pipe - 50mm (2") (ID) contains strengtheners which allow the hose to be flexible and strong but will not kink in most pond installations. This is complimented by a greater wall thickness which produces a smooth internal wall for reduced friction and better flowrateand offers great value for larger projects, with a 10% lower price than the "by the metre" rate. The 50mm (2") Heavy Duty flexible hose is black for easy concealment and this also discourages growth of algae on the inside, which can, long term, lead to a reduction in the hose diameter and thus affect the pumps performance. The increased wall thickness reduces the flexibility but increases its strength, this allows it to handle higher pressure. When using flexible pipework we recommend the use of 50mm Stainless Steel Jubilee Clips to ensure a secure and leak free installation. 50mm (2") Flexible Hose Features • UV resistant • Good sinking characteristics • Very smooth, flow optimised inner wall design

item.g:title: Blagdon Liberty 500 Solar Pump Kit
item.g:description: The Blagdon Liberty 500 Solar Pump and Light Kit is a very versatile new solar fountain pump kit from Blagdon which can be used as a convemtional or floating fountain pump in a pond or in a water feature. This Solar Fountain kit includes a float which the pump suspends underneath ensuring it is away from any waste or wildlife at the bottom of the pond and is also supplied with 2 different fountain heads and the LED light ring for different display options in your pond. To save battery power the LED light has a sensor to ensure it will only come on in the dark. The solar pump can be used to run a feature instead of a fountain and can be connected using a 12mm hose (via included contol valve) to then pump the water up to a feature 1.5m above water surface, although the flow will be greatly reduced at 1.5m (see table below). The solar panel in this set has 3 settings - Continuous On - Automatically starts each day when the sun is strong enough, the panel charges the battery which powers the pump. If the sunlight is strong enough, the battery will receive more power than it takes to run the pump and so will start to charge up. If there is sufficient charge in the battery when a cloud moves in front of the sun or as dusk comes the pump will continue to run until all the charge is depleted. Repeat Daily Timer - Runs for 4 hours every day from the time you choose. Can be set to automatically turn on during the evening so if you are at work all day you can enjoy your feature when you get home. On Demand - Instantly runs for 4 hours. Great for impromptu BBQ’s and parties. The kit includes the 482 litre per hour (106 GPH) pump (5m cable), 10.5w solar panel with a built in 5 hour Li-ion battery, an LED light ring (5m cable), float, net bag and nylon cord for anchoring the pump, two fountain heads, 6 x 80mm extension tubes, a control valve with a 12mm hose connection, along with a ground spike and wall fixings. Max fountain height 750mm. Supplied with a 3 year guarantee. Blagdon Liberty 500 Solar Pump Kit Features Operates in direct sunlight or from battery Powered 10w solar panel 3 modes of operation Low voltage water pump and LED light 2 different fountain heads 5m cable to solar panel Maximum flow rate: 482 LPH Will accept 12mm hose pipe via included contol valve No operating costs Optional 5m extension cable set 3 year guarantee Blagdon Liberty 500 Solar Pump Flowrates (at High Battery Level) Height (M) Flowrate (LPH) 0 482 0.25 361 0.5 315 0.75 262 1.0 210 1.25 142 1.5 81

item.g:title: Oase 3 Way Water Diverter
item.g:description: The Oase 3 Way Water Diverter was originally intended to be used in conjunction with the Oase Pump Vault 20000, as a way of connecting a single flexible pipe to feed 3 individually valved flexible pipes, which is particularly useful if you are running 3 water features from one pipe. However with the inclusion of a stepped inlet hosetail this package can be used in other situations where a single pipe is feeding 3 items, such as 3 waterfalls or 3 water chutes or even 3 water blades. Each of the 3 outflow hosetails will accept a 25mm or 32mm (1" or 1¼") flexible pipe and the inlet hosetail will allow the connection of a 38mm or 50mm (1½" or 2") pipe. To help balance the flow through each outlet, the distributor has a valve on each connection and is supplied with one adjustment handle which can be moved to be used on each valve. Oase 3 Way Water Diverter Features • 1 inlet 3 outlets • Control valve on each outlet • 1 x 38mm or 50mm (1½" or 2") inlet • 3 x 25mm or 32mm (1" or 1¼") outlets

item.g:title: Blagdon Affinity Ice Vent Pond Heater
item.g:description: The Blagdon Affinity Ice Vent Pond Heater is a floating 50 watt pond heater suitable for ponds up to 5000 litres and once installed will help keep an area of pond surface free from ice (down to -10°C). The unique low wattage, convection design means the heater only requires minimal energy. The sleeve surrounding the heater element helps create a flow of water past the element increasing its effectiveness, whilst protecting anything in the pond from coming into contact with the hot surface. Although fish become inactive (torpor) when the pond water temperature drops low enough, they still breath and so still need oxygen and produce carbon dioxide. If the pond freezes over it stops gas exchange meaning no oxygen will get into the pond and the harmful gases are trapped, because of this it is vital to keep an area of the pond free from ice. You shouldn't smash ice or poor boiling water on to melt it; both of these can cause health issues for your fish. As the Blagdon Affinity Ice Vent Pond Heater only consumes 50 watts it is a relatively cost-effective way of preventing the pond from freezing over and keeping the oxygen supply available for your fish. The Blagdon Affinity Ice Vent Pond Heater will keep an area of the pond surface free from ice; it will not heat the pond. Blagdon Affinity Ice Vent Pond Heater Features Wattage: 50w 2 Year Guarantee 10 metres of mains cable Maintains an air hole down to -10 Degrees Celsius. Float diameter: 162mm Total Height:325mm

item.g:title: Blagdon Minipond 9000 Pond Filter
item.g:description: The Minipond 9000 is a compact box filter designed for smaller goldfish ponds. It combines ultraviolet clarification, foam filtration and biological media to help manage green water algae, suspended dirt and fish waste. Water enters through hosetail connections and passes through the UV chamber before flowing over a spray bar and through three foam layers, which remove dirt particles and clumped algae. The water then passes through ceramic biological media that supports beneficial bacteria for waste breakdown. Final filtration stages include a replaceable polymer wool pad and carbon impregnated foam, helping to polish the water before it returns to the pond. The outlet position allows the unit to be partially buried for a more discreet installation. Blagdon Minipond 9000 Pond Filter Features 5W UV lamp Three foam layers with ceramic biological media Replaceable polymer wool pad and carbon impregnated foam Hosetail inlet connections for 13mm, 20mm and 25mm hose 38mm outlet connection Supplied with 5m of cable 3 year guarantee

item.g:title: Blagdon Clean Pond Machine 7000 - Pond Filter
item.g:description: The Clean Pond Machine 7000 is a pressurised pond filter designed to provide mechanical, biological and UV filtration with simplified maintenance. It is suitable for smaller ponds requiring clear water and reduced cleaning effort. The filter uses 2-in-1 CHI media which interlocks to trap fine debris while providing a surface for beneficial bacteria. item.g:title: Cloverleaf Blanket Answer - All Seasons - 10Kg
item.g:description: Cloverleaf Blanket Answer All Season - 10Kg - is a new addition to the UK's bestselling blanketweed treatment range. Blanketweed can grow at cooler temperatures than other pond plants and tries to establish itself as the dominant plant species in a pond early in the early Spring. Until now you just had to wait for the temperature to rise before you could treat the water, but this version of the Blanket Answer from Cloverleaf can be used from temperatures as low as 2°C, so you can tackle the problem almost before it gets started. Blanket Answer has long been a favourite option for UK pond keepers with its unique blend of minerals and enzymes, now has a new unique formula which is still perfectly safe with for use with all pond fish, plants, and biological filtration systems. A single dose is often enough but it can be used all year round should you need a follow up dose. When applied the water may go milky for 2-5 days but this will clear, and results can normally be seen within 14 days. Works at temperatures as low as 2°C Cloverleaf Blanket Answer All Season - 10Kg - Treats up to 125000 Litres (27500 G) Dosing Rate = 1 scoop (32g) per 400 Litres (90 G) Important Notes As with all anti algae treatments, please ensure that your pond is kept well oxygenated and that large quantities of decomposing algae are manually removed.

item.g:title: Gold Label 80ml Underwater Pond Sealant - Clear
item.g:description: Gold Label 80ml Underwater Pond Sealant in Clear bonds a wide range of materials even under water: Butyl Rubber, Vinyl, Glass, Plastic, Ceramic, Stone, Concrete and even wood - Solvent free so fine to use in ponds with fish still in place provided they do not ingest it. This 80ml tube tube is a ideal for smaller job and uses a "Squeezer key" to push the sealant from the tube. Tube Size: 80ml Colour:- Clear Gold Label Underwater Sealant - Instructions for Use For best results clean all surfaces to be free from algae, grease and limescale etc. Place sealer directly onto the surface you wish to bond or seal. For bonding where there is movement (expansion or contraction) or different substrate, leave a minimum 5mm bead between surfaces. For joining liner, use two beads 15mm apart and leave to cure for 36 hours at ambient temperature and for a patch, run a continuous bead around the edge of the patch and gently press into place. DO NOT PRESS FLAT . Use A 5mm bead for optimum cure and bond strength. Initial cure 24 hours, continuing to harden up to 7 days. For use on concrete, first use a suitable primer. Store in dry conditions between 10 - 25°C Do not use below +10°C Not suitable for HDPE plastics and Polyex liners

item.g:title: Oase FiltoClear 60000 - Pond Filter
item.g:description: The Oase FiltoClear 60000 is a high-capacity pressurised pond filter designed for larger ponds requiring effective mechanical and biological filtration combined with integrated UVC technology. As part of the updated FiltoClear range, this model builds on the established design with increased capacity, improved circulation options and enhanced filtration performance. Oase FiltoClear 60000 Pressurised Pond Filter Features Combination of mechanical and biological filtration with integrated UVC clarifier Twin inlet and twin outlet connections for improved pond circulation Suitable for larger ponds and higher fish stocking levels Can be installed below water level for discreet placement Patented Easy-Clean system for cleaning without opening the filter Independent cleaning of multiple foam chambers Integrated waste outlet and base drain connection UVC indicator window for monitoring lamp operation Pollution level indicator for maintenance guidance Supplied with multiple hosetails and 5m mains cable The FiltoClear 60000 introduces a redesigned internal structure featuring four separate foam columns arranged around a central outlet tube. Each column contains four grades of foam to improve waste capture across different particle sizes. These chambers can be cleaned independently, allowing staged maintenance without disrupting the entire filter. With dual inlets and outlets, this model allows multiple pumps and return points to be used, improving water circulation throughout the pond. Unused connections can be capped where required. The integrated UVC system uses higher output lamps to help control green water by clumping suspended algae, while the quartz sleeve does not need to be removed during lamp replacement. A pollution indicator signals when cleaning is required, and waste can be discharged via the integrated outlet or optional drain valve connection. This model is supplied with 50mm hosetails for inlet, outlet and waste connections, along with a blanking cap for the base drain. The drain hole at the base of the tank can be used to help empty the contents from time to time, it is supplied with a blanking cap but a Ball Valve and hosetail kit are available as an accessory. All FiltoClears are supplied with 5m of mains cable and a 2 year guarantee, which can be increased to 3 years by sending off the guarantee card to Oase.
