item.g:title: Velda - Peat Free Pond Plant Soil - 10 Litre Bag
item.g:description: This 10 Litres bag of Velda Peat Free Pond Soil is a specialist planting medium designed for use with aquatic plants, water lilies and marginal pond plants. It provides a stable, low-organic substrate that supports healthy root development while helping maintain water clarity. This peat-free pond soil has a loose structure that promotes water circulation and oxygen movement through the planting medium. The formulation contains carefully balanced nutrients and trace elements to support steady plant growth over an extended period. Velda Peat Free Pond Soil - 10L Bag Features Peat-free formulation for pond planting Low organic content to help maintain water clarity Loose structure encourages water circulation and oxygen movement Balanced nutrients and trace elements for sustained plant growth Suitable for water lilies and marginal pond plants Acid-free composition The composition is designed to support strong root development and stable plant growth without encouraging excessive nutrient release into the pond. This helps maintain biological balance while providing a suitable medium for aquatic planting. The peat-free formulation also provides a more sustainable option for pond planting. By avoiding peat, this planting medium reduces environmental impact associated with peat extraction while still providing suitable conditions for aquatic plants. For water lilies and most marginal plants, a layer of at least 15cm of pond soil is recommended. To help prevent water cloudiness , the surface of the soil can be covered with washed gravel or a fine-grained substrate. When using planting baskets, an inlay cloth can be used to reduce soil washout. item.g:title: Oase ProfiClear Premium Compact - M - Pond Filter - Gravity Fed - ECG
item.g:description: The Oase ProfiClear Premium Compact M Gravity Fed Pond Filter is an advanced automatic pond filtration system designed for large garden ponds, koi ponds and swim ponds. It combines mechanical drum filtration with biological moving bed filtration in a compact unit, helping to deliver clear water and stable water quality while reducing routine maintenance. Pond water enters directly into the centre of the drum and passes through fine 80 micron sieve screens, which trap debris before the water moves into the biological stage. When the screens begin to block, an integrated water sensor automatically starts the cleaning cycle, rotating the drum and activating high-pressure water jets to clean the mesh. Waste is then flushed out to drain, helping the filter maintain efficient operation with minimal manual intervention. Oase ProfiClear Premium Compact M Gravity Fed Pond Filter Features Combines automatic drum filtration with moving bed biological filtration Automatic self-cleaning system activated by an integrated water sensor 80 micron sieve screens for fine mechanical debris removal 40 litres of Hel-X 13 biomedia for biological filtration Integrated aerator connection for moving bed operation Suitable for gravity-fed installations connected to bottom drains or side outlets Integrated pressure pump for drum cleaning Quiet operation with extensive noise damping Pollutant rakes on the sieves to assist with removal of string algae Includes slide valve for pollutant discharge Compatible with the Oase Control system for app-based control when used with the InScenio FM Master Cloud This filter is designed as a gravity-fed unit, allowing most of the body of the filter to be buried below pond water level while still requiring the top of the tank to remain 105mm above the pond water level. It has a single 110mm inlet and 110mm outlet connection, making it suitable for larger pond installations where a gravity system is preferred. The second stage of filtration uses a moving bed chamber containing 40 litres of Hel-X 13 media. Water is released into this chamber through a perforated retransfer tube, and the media is kept in constant motion by air supplied through the integrated aerator system. This oxygen-rich environment supports beneficial bacteria, helping to break down toxins and maintain healthy pond conditions. For larger and higher-demand pond systems, the ProfiClear Premium Compact M offers a practical combination of automatic solids removal and efficient biological treatment in one unit. It is suitable for natural ponds up to 88,000 litres, goldfish ponds up to 44,000 litres, and koi / swim ponds up to 22,000 litres. item.g:title: MasterPlug - WiFi Controlled Storm Weatherproof Power Socket
item.g:description: The MasterPlug WiFi Controlled Storm Weatherproof Power Socket is a smart outdoor double socket designed for remotely controlling and scheduling electrical equipment in garden and outdoor environments. Using a 2.4GHz WiFi connection, the unit allows power to be switched via app control, voice assistants or manual touch control, without requiring a separate hub. This twin 13A outdoor socket is housed within a robust IP66-rated enclosure designed to protect against rain, dust and outdoor conditions. Each socket can be controlled remotely using the BG Home app, with support for scheduling, countdown timers and random security functions. Multiple cable entry knockouts provide flexible installation, while LED indicators show socket power status even when the cover is closed. The patented cable entry system helps prevent accidental opening of the cover during use. item.g:title: Quadro 3 - Rectangular Reservoir with Metal Grid and Insert - 150L
item.g:description: The Quadro 3 - Rectangular Reservoir with Metal Grid and Insert is a strong and sturdy water reservoir which can be used for many types of water features and can be installed in the ground or freestanding. These strong plastic sumps are slightly tapered allowing the top rim to be supported by the surrounding ground. When installed in this way the galvanised steel grid can support a water feature of up to 250 Kg. This kits also feature an inset access cover which allows you to remove and clean your water pump without having to disturb your feature. The grid size is 5cm Square and perfect for large cobbles and fast drainage. If you would like to use smaller aggregate material like gravel or granite chippings a non-rotting water permeable material like greenhouse netting will have to be placed over the grid to stop it falling through. item.g:title: Medium Round Reservoir and Tabbed Grid Kit (60cm Dia)
item.g:description: The Medium Plastic Reservoir and Metal Grid Kits are supplied by the specialist stone water feature manufacturer Eastern Connections are a perfect solution when adding a self-contained water feature or a stream collection sump within your garden. These strong plastic sumps are slightly tapered, allowing the top rim to be supported by the surrounding ground. When installed in this way the galvanised steel grid can support a water feature of up to 200 Kg. These kits also feature an inset access cover which allows you to remove and clean your water pump without having to disturb your feature. The grid size is 5.5cm square and perfect for large cobbles and fast drainage. If you would like to use smaller aggregate material like gravel or granite chippings, a non-rotting water permeable material like underlay or greenhouse netting will have to be placed over the grid to stop it falling through. Take care to ensure the material and smaller aggregate do not hinder the speed of drainage and cause flooding. Please note that if it is not possible to support the reservoir lip when installed, the maximum weight limit would be 100 Kg Medium Plastic Reservoir and Metal Grid Kit Features • Medium - 60cm Diameter - 90 Litres • Extremely strong & weatherproof • Includes a galvanised steel grid • Support a water feature of up to 200 Kg • Includes inset access cover • 5.5cm square grid size Medium Plastic Reservoir and Metal Grid Kit Dimensions Inner Diameter: 60cm Outer Diameter: 66cm Height: 33.5cm Grid Diameter: 59cm Grid + Support Tabs Diameter: 67cm Optional Auto Fill Kit The Oase Auto Fill Kit is a simple solution for automatically topping up a water feature sump. Evaporation or "splash out" can cause the water level within your water feature to fall over time. With the installation of an Auto Fill Kit which is connected to a mains water supply, small amounts of water can be added at a time, reducing the need for manual top-ups.

item.g:title: Smart Solar - Azure Falls Cascade Solar Water Feature
item.g:description: The Azure Falls Cascade solar water feature is a compact solar-powered water feature with a modern cascading design, ideal for patios, terraces, and smaller garden spaces. Made from durable polyresin with an attractive blue finish, this self-contained feature creates a gentle flowing water effect without the need for mains wiring or ongoing running costs. Water is circulated from the hidden internal reservoir to the top of the feature, where it flows down through the cascading channels before collecting in the lower pool. The gentle movement of water helps create a relaxing garden atmosphere, while the solar-powered operation allows for flexible placement around the garden. Azure Falls Cascade Features Solar-powered cascading water feature Modern blue polyresin design Self-contained hidden water reservoir Remote solar panel with 3m cable Built-in low water level sensor for pump protection Automatically shuts off if the water level becomes too low No mains wiring required Quick and easy assembly Lightweight and easy to reposition 1 year manufacturer’s guarantee The integrated solar pump continuously circulates water through the feature during suitable sunlight conditions, producing a gentle trickling sound as the water moves through each channel. The upgraded pump system includes a built-in water level sensor which automatically switches the pump off if the water level drops too low, helping to reduce the risk of pump damage. The remote solar panel allows the panel to be positioned separately from the feature itself for improved sunlight exposure. This water feature is well suited to patios, balconies, courtyards, and decorative garden areas where a compact and low-maintenance feature is required. For best performance, place the solar panel in direct sunlight. The manufacturer recommends storing the feature indoors during cold weather to help protect it from frost damage. item.g:title: Oase LevelControl Automatic Water Feature Top Up System
item.g:description: The Oase LevelControl Automatic Water Feature Top-Up System is an electronically controlled automatic refill system which, once connected to a mains water supply, is designed to maintain a consistent water level within pondless waterfall reservoirs, disappearing water feature sumps, and water feature grid systems. Using conductive level sensing technology and a mains-operated solenoid valve, the system automatically replaces water lost through evaporation, splash-out, and natural water movement. The system continuously monitors the water level inside the hidden reservoir using the supplied conductive sensor. When the water level drops below the preset level, the controller automatically opens the included 1" solenoid valve to allow fresh mains water into the reservoir. Once the correct water level has been restored, the valve automatically closes again. Oase LevelControl Automatic Water Feature Top-Up System Features Automatic electronic water top-up system Ideal for pondless waterfall reservoirs and water feature grids Helps maintain a stable reservoir water level automatically Suitable for disappearing fountains and self-contained water features Designed to reduce false triggering caused by moving water or wave action Includes weatherproof controller and 1" BSP solenoid valve LED status display for valve operation monitoring Simple installation and low-maintenance operation Sensor mounting bracket included 2 year manufacturer’s guarantee The LevelControl system is particularly useful on reservoir-based water features where water loss through evaporation and splash-out can gradually reduce the operating water level. By automatically topping up the reservoir when required, the system helps maintain reliable pump operation while reducing manual maintenance. The system is designed to reduce false triggering caused by moving water or wave action, while the adjustable sensor allows the switching differential to be reduced to approximately 10mm for accurate level management. The supplied weatherproof control unit features LED indicators showing the operational status of the solenoid valve. Installation is straightforward, with separate connections provided for the sensor, valve, and mains transformer. item.g:title: PondXpert - Food Flinger Solar Fish Feeder - 6L Automatic Pond Feeder
item.g:description: The PondXpert FoodFlinger Solar Pond Feeder is a programmable automatic fish feeder designed to provide controlled feeding for pond fish throughout the day. Powered by an integrated solar charging system with built-in rechargeable battery backup, this feeder offers a practical solution for maintaining regular feeding schedules while reducing daily maintenance. Suitable for pond pellets and sticks, the FoodFlinger can be programmed for multiple daily feeds with adjustable feed durations and feeding distances. The unit can either broadcast food across the pond surface or direct food into a concentrated area using the included chute and protective cover system. PondXpert FoodFlinger Solar Pond Feeder Features Solar-powered automatic pond fish feeder Integrated rechargeable battery backup Programmable digital feeding controls Adjustable feeding duration and feeding distance Suitable for a wide range of pond fish foods Digital LCD display with simple button controls Manual feeding function Wide food distribution pattern Includes directional feeding chute and protective cover Supplied with fixing pegs for installation into soft ground 2 year guarantee The integrated control panel allows easy adjustment of current time, feeding schedules, feed duration and feeding distance. Three feeding distance settings are available, helping tailor food distribution to suit different pond sizes and fish feeding behaviour. Depending on the selected setting and food type, the feeder can propel food approximately 1 metre, 2 metres or 3 metres across the pond surface. A manual feeding button is also included, allowing additional feeding outside programmed schedules when required. The wide food distribution pattern can help spread food over a larger area, reducing competition during feeding. The FoodFlinger is designed for installation beside the pond and includes fixing pegs for anchoring into soft ground. Alternatively, it can be secured onto a hard surface using screws. The integrated solar panel continuously charges the internal battery during daylight conditions, while an optional 12V mains charger can be purchased separately for additional charging support during lower light periods. PondXpert FoodFlinger Solar Pond Feeder Technical Details Battery Capacity: 2200mA Food Capacity: 6 Litres Suitable Food Size: 3mm - 10mm Feeds Per Day: 1 - 6 Feeding Duration: 0 - 20 Seconds Approximate Feeding Distance: 1m / 2m / 3m Feeding Angle: 120° Dimensions (L x W x H): 275 x 252 x 420mm Guarantee: 2 Years What's Included PondXpert FoodFlinger Solar Pond Feeder Feeding chute Protective chute cover Fixing pegs Integrated solar panel and rechargeable battery Good to Know Designed for installation beside the pond, not inside the water Best installed in a location with good sunlight exposure Not suitable for flake fish foods Optional 12V mains charger available separately Food should be kept dry and free from clumping for reliable operation

PondXpert FoodFlinger Mains Adaptor Features Optional mains charging adaptor for the PondXpert FoodFlinger Designed to recharge the built-in feeder battery indoors Ideal during periods of poor weather or reduced sunlight Helps maintain reliable feeder operation year-round Simple plug-in charging connection Suitable as a spare or backup charger The adaptor is particularly useful during winter months or prolonged cloudy conditions where solar charging alone may not provide sufficient battery recovery. This adaptor is intended for indoor charging use only and is designed specifically for compatibility with the PondXpert FoodFlinger Solar Pond Feeder. item.g:title: PondXpert - Floating Pond Protectors - 30 Ring Pack
item.g:description: The PondXpert Floating Pond Protectors provide a discreet solution for helping protect pond fish from herons and other pond predators. Designed to float around the perimeter of the pond, these interlocking protectors create a barrier at the pond edge where herons typically strike, without covering the entire pond surface. Unlike traditional pond cover nets, the Floating Pond Protectors leave the centre of the pond open and unobstructed, helping maintain the appearance of the pond while still providing an effective physical deterrent. The floating sections sit just below the water surface and can be adapted to suit a wide range of pond shapes and layouts. PondXpert Floating Pond Protectors Features Floating perimeter pond protection system Helps deter herons and other pond predators Designed to protect pond edges where predators commonly strike Interlocking modular design Suitable for many pond shapes and sizes Discreet black finish sits just below the water surface No unsightly frames or perimeter supports required Centre of pond remains open and visible Quick and simple installation Sections can be cut to allow pond plants through Supplied with joining clips The system consists of floating interlocking protector sections which connect together using the supplied clips to form a continuous floating barrier around the pond edge. The protectors are designed to be positioned two sections deep into the pond perimeter for effective coverage. Because only the pond edge requires protection, the Floating Pond Protectors offer a less intrusive alternative to full pond netting. The modular design also allows the system to be adapted around planting shelves, marginal plants and irregular pond shapes. The black floating sections are designed to remain relatively discreet in use and can easily be removed or adjusted when pond maintenance is required. PondXpert Floating Pond Protectors Technical Details Pack Quantity: 30 Protector Sections Joining Clips Included: 96 Recommended Installation: Two Sections Deep Approximate Perimeter Coverage: 5.8 Metres Individual Protector Dimensions: 31cm x 27cm Colour: Black What's Included 30 Floating Pond Protector sections 96 Joining clips Good to Know Protectors can be trimmed to fit around pond plants Suitable for irregular pond shapes Designed to float at the pond perimeter only Provides a more discreet alternative to traditional pond cover nets

item.g:title: Oase Skimmer 250 Eco - Lake Skimmer
item.g:description: The Oase Skimmer 250 Eco - Lake Skimmer, which is part of the Lake Management range, is a high performance floating skimmer with an integrated pump, which will clean pond and lake surfaces of up to 250 square metres. Oase has redesigned the motor for the Skimmer 250 Eco, resulting in quieter, more energy efficient pumps, saving 40% of the running costs, which should also help them last longer than their older models. The new motors have what Oase calls "Core 6 Technology", which means they have six windings instead of the traditional 4. These windings have also been curved, which produces smoother running, adding to their efficiency and also making them quieter. As a highly effective way of removing surface debris, the Skimmer 250 Eco will not only keep the surface clear but will also reduce the amount of debris which would otherwise sink to the bottom of a pond, causing water pollution and feeding algae growth. Unlike fixed skimmers, the Oase Skimmer 250 Eco is free floating, allowing it to constantly sit at the correct height to ensure maximum debris collection through its 520mm wide skimmer opening. The integrated pump (AquaMax) creates a flowrate of up to 17000 litres per hour, drawing water and debris into the 27 Litre capacity, high quality stainless steel collection basket with a 9mm square mesh. Oase Skimmer 250 Eco - Lake Skimmer Eco Technical Details Dimensions: 775 x 440 x 590mm. Power consumption: 140 watts (was 250 watts). Mouth opening 520mm wide. item.g:title: Oase Skimmer 250 Eco - Surface Skimmer
item.g:description: The Oase Skimmer 250 Eco - Surface Skimmer, which is part of the Lake Management range, is a high performance floating skimmer with an integrated pump, which will clean pond and lake surfaces of up to 250 square metres. Oase has redesigned the motor for the Skimmer 250 Eco, resulting in quieter, more energy efficient pumps, saving 40% of the running costs, which should also help them last longer than their older models. The new motors have what Oase calls "Core 6 Technology", which means they have six windings instead of the traditional 4. These windings have also been curved, which produces smoother running, adding to their efficiency and also making them quieter. As a highly effective way of removing surface debris, the Skimmer 250 Eco will not only keep the surface clear but will also reduce the amount of debris which would otherwise sink to the bottom of a pond, causing water pollution and feeding algae growth. Unlike fixed skimmers, the Oase Skimmer 250 Eco is free floating, allowing it to constantly sit at the correct height to ensure maximum debris collection through its 520mm wide skimmer opening. The integrated pump (AquaMax) creates a flowrate of up to 17000 litres per hour, drawing water and debris into the 27 Litre capacity, high quality stainless steel collection basket with a 9mm square mesh. item.g:title: PondXpert PondMaster Non Stop Vacuum
item.g:description: The PondXpert PondMaster NON-STOP Pond Vacuum is a powerful pond cleaning vacuum designed to remove sludge, algae, loose dirt, dead vegetation and leaf debris from the base of a pond. It features a built-in sludge pump in the base of the tank, allowing waste water and debris to be pumped out as it is collected. This non-stop operation helps avoid the regular stop/start emptying process found on some pond vacuums, making it a practical choice for more efficient pond maintenance. PondXpert PondMaster NON-STOP Pond Vacuum Features Built-in sludge pump for continuous waste discharge Removes loose dirt particles up to 10mm in size Suitable for sludge, algae, string algae, dead vegetation and leaf debris Adjustable suction nozzle from 4mm to 10mm Supplied with 4m suction hose and 2m discharge hose Includes additional crevice nozzle and flat nozzle with rubber lip The PondMaster NON-STOP Pond Vacuum draws debris through the adjustable suction nozzle and into the vacuum body using the supplied 4m suction hose. Waste is then pumped out through the discharge hose, helping to keep the cleaning process moving without repeatedly stopping to empty the tank. The vacuum is supplied with useful accessories for different cleaning tasks, including a crevice nozzle for tighter areas and a flat nozzle with rubber lip for cleaning pond bases. A fine net bag is included for catching small debris at the end of the discharge hose, while a coarse net bag inside the tank helps catch larger material such as leaves and blanket weed. Technical Specifications Maximum dirt particle size: Up to 10mm Adjustable suction nozzle: 4mm to 10mm Suction hose length: 4m Discharge hose length: 2m Guarantee: 2 years What’s Included 1 x PondXpert PondMaster NON-STOP Pond Vacuum 4m suction hose 2m discharge hose Adjustable suction nozzle Crevice nozzle Flat nozzle with rubber lip Fine net bag for small debris Coarse inlet net bag for larger debris Good to Know A 5m discharge hose extension is available separately. item.g:title: Bermuda Pond Aerator 20000 with LED
item.g:description: The Bermuda Pond Aerator 20000 with LED is a powerful floating pond aerator designed to improve oxygen levels, increase water circulation, and create an attractive fountain display in larger ponds and water gardens. With a high 20000 litre per hour flowrate, this pond aerator helps maximise gas exchange at the pond surface, supporting a healthier and more balanced pond environment. The powerful 115W pump creates a large cone-shaped fountain display measuring approximately 240cm in diameter and 60cm high, making it both a practical aeration unit and an eye-catching water feature. The pond aerator floats on the pond surface and is supplied with 2 x 9m thin nylon ropes to help secure it in position. This helps keep the fountain stable while still allowing it to sit neatly on the water. The unit measures approximately 400mm in diameter x 243mm deep and is suitable for operating temperatures from 5°C to 35°C. The built-in 6 x 1W bright white LED lights allow the fountain to remain visible into the evening, adding extra impact after dark. The pump is supplied with 10m of mains cable, while the LED lights are supplied with 10m of low voltage cable and an indoor plug style transformer. The LED transformer should be installed in a dry indoor or suitably protected location. The Bermuda Pond Aerator 20000 with LED has two running modes. Continuous Mode runs the pump at full power all the time for a steady fountain display. Gradient Mode gradually increases the fountain to maximum size and then reduces it again over approximately 30 seconds, creating a changing water display rather than a fixed spray pattern. Bermuda Pond Aerator 20000 with LED Features Combines pond aeration, water circulation, and a decorative fountain effect Powerful 20000 litre per hour flowrate for larger ponds and water gardens Large cone-shaped fountain display, approximately 240cm wide and 60cm high Helps improve surface movement and gas exchange in the pond Built-in 6 x 1W bright white LED lights for evening visibility 115W pump delivers strong and steady performance Floating surface design with anchoring ropes for stability Continuous Mode runs the pump at full power Gradient Mode gradually increases and decreases the fountain size Supplied with 10m mains cable for the pump Supplied with 10m low voltage cable for the LED lights Includes indoor plug style LED transformer Includes 2 x 9m thin nylon ropes for securing the fountain Suitable for operating temperatures from 5°C to 35°C Includes a 12 month guarantee Technical Specifications Maximum flowrate: 20000 litres per hour Pump power consumption: 115W Fountain display: approximately 240cm diameter x 60cm high Unit dimensions: 400mm diameter x 243mm deep Pump cable length: 10m mains powered LED lighting: 6 x 1W bright white LEDs LED cable length: 10m low voltage LED transformer: indoor plug style transformer Operating temperature: 5°C to 35°C Guarantee: 12 months Please note: The LED lights are supplied with an IP20 indoor plug style transformer. item.g:title: Evolution Aqua AirTech 70 / 75 Diaphragm Kit - 10mm
item.g:description: The Evolution Aqua AirTech 70 / 75 Diaphragm Kit is a replacement service kit for the AirTech 70 air pump. It is designed to replace worn diaphragms, helping the pump regain lost air output when the original diaphragms have reached the end of their working life. Evolution Aqua AirTech 70 / 75 Diaphragm Kit 10mm Features Replacement diaphragm kit for the Evolution Aqua AirTech 70 / 75 air pumps 10mm diaphragm kit Includes two diaphragms and two diaphragm frames Includes two nuts and two washers for securing the diaphragms Helps restore performance when diaphragms have worn Original frame securing screws must be reused Air pump diaphragms are moving parts that work continuously whenever the pump is running. Over time they can stretch, split or lose efficiency, which may result in reduced air output, weaker bubbling in the pond or a change in pump noise. This kit contains the main diaphragm parts needed to service an Evolution Aqua AirTech 70 pump. The supplied nuts and washers are used to secure the diaphragms onto the activating arms inside the air pump. The kit does not include the screws that hold the diaphragm frames in place. These screws are not available as a spare part, so the originals should be retained carefully and reused during fitting. Technical Specifications Suitable for: Evolution Aqua AirTech 70 / 75 Diaphragm size: 10mm Included diaphragms: 2 Included diaphragm frames: 2 Included nuts: 2 Included washers: 2 Frame securing screws: Not included

item.g:title: Dyofix SGP Shadow 50 Pond Dye - 300G
item.g:description: The Dyofix SGP Shadow 50 Natural Look Pond Dye is a pond water treatment designed to create a subtle, natural-looking twilight effect in garden ponds. It helps reduce the amount of sunlight penetrating the water, limiting the light available to algae and submerged aquatic weeds. Unlike strongly coloured pond dyes, SGP Shadow is intended to maintain a natural pond appearance while still helping to control light levels below the surface. The dye disperses through the water and works by filtering light, which helps disrupt photosynthesis and reduces the conditions that allow submerged weeds and algae to grow. Dyofix SGP Shadow 50 Natural Look Pond Dye Features 300g pond dye treatment for ponds up to 50,000 litres Creates a natural-looking twilight effect in pond water Helps reduce sunlight penetration below the water surface Limits light available to algae and submerged aquatic weeds Free from herbicides, pesticides and algaecides Will not harm fish, wildlife, insects or pets when used as directed Suitable for use in garden ponds throughout the year SGP Shadow is a useful option for pond owners who want to help manage algae and submerged weed growth without using herbicide, pesticide or algaecide-based products. By colouring the water and reducing light penetration, it helps make the pond environment less favourable for unwanted growth while retaining a more natural appearance. The first application should ideally be made in early spring, before algae and submerged weed growth becomes established. To help maintain the level of Dyofix in the pond water, the manufacturer recommends adding around 10% of the original dose monthly as a general guide. Technical Specifications Pack size: 300g Treats ponds up to 50,000 litres Product type: Natural look pond dye Application: Garden ponds Effect: Twilight-style natural pond colouration Use: Reduces light penetration to help limit algae and submerged weed growth Free from herbicides, pesticides and algaecides Good to Know Calculate the pond volume before use to ensure the correct dose is applied Mix the required amount with pond water in a watering can before applying around different areas of the pond Wear rubber or latex gloves when handling, as concentrated dye may stain skin and clothing Protect the product from frost during storage This product helps reduce light availability; it is not a chemical algaecide
item.g:product_type: Pond Products > Looking After Your Pond and Fish > Tests and Treatments > Other Useful Pond Treatments

item.g:title: Bermuda Flexible Pipe 3 Way Flow Adjuster
item.g:description: The Bermuda Flexible Pipe 3 Way Flow Adjuster is a Y connector designed to split the water flow from one pond pump into two separate outlets. It is useful when running two water features from a single pump, such as two waterfalls or a fountain and waterfall combination. The adjuster includes a choice of inlet fittings to suit different installation requirements, along with two adjustable outlet valves. item.g:title: MasterPlug Safety RCD Plug
item.g:description: The Masterplug Safety RCD Plug is a rewireable residual current device designed to provide added protection when using electrical appliances, garden equipment and light DIY power tools. It is particularly useful for products such as pond vacuums, lawn mowers, hedge trimmers and portable power tools where extra protection against electric shock is important. The RCD continuously monitors the electrical current flowing to the appliance. If it detects an earth leakage fault, such as current flowing through an unintended path, it quickly cuts the power to help reduce the risk of serious electric shock. Masterplug Safety RCD Plug Features Provides added protection against the risk of fatal electric shock Rewireable design for fitting directly to compatible mains-powered equipment Ideal for garden and light DIY use Suitable for lawn mowers, hedge trimmers and portable power tools Active non-latching design trips when power is interrupted Double pole contact break for additional safety This Masterplug RCD safety plug is an active, non-latching type. This means that if power to the device is turned off, or if there is a power cut, the RCD will trip and must be reset at the socket before the appliance can be used again. Before each use, the test and reset buttons should be used in accordance with the manufacturer’s instructions to check that the RCD is operating correctly. If the RCD repeatedly trips during use, the appliance or cable should be checked and expert advice should be sought. Technical Specifications Maximum current: 13 amps Maximum load: 3120W Rated trip current: 30mA Trip speed: 40ms typical at 150mA RCD type: Non-latching Contact break: Double pole RCD contact break Fuse: 13 amp fuse to BS1362 Standard: BS 7071:1992 Product dimensions: 119mm high x 50.4mm wide x 74.1mm deep Good to Know This is a rewireable plug, not a plug-in adaptor Installation should only be carried out by a competent person

item.g:title: Filter Wool 45cm Wide x 1m
item.g:description: This 45cm wide filter wool is a synthetic polymer filter media supplied by the metre from a roll. It is designed to help capture fine suspended debris that can sometimes pass through standard pond filter foams. Filter wool is especially useful as a final polishing layer in pond filters, helping to improve water clarity by trapping smaller particles before the water returns to the pond. Filter Wool 45cm Wide x 1m Features Helps catch fine debris that may pass through filter foam Useful as a polishing layer for clearer pond water Can be cut to the required size and shape Easy to install in many pond filter setups Suitable for use alongside plastic biomedia such as K1, Kplus or Hel-X This filter wool is commonly used after filter foam or biomedia to provide additional fine mechanical filtration. It is particularly useful where the main filter media is designed for biological filtration, or where newly cleaned foam is allowing smaller particles to pass through. The material can be trimmed to fit the available space inside the filter, making it a flexible option for many pond filtration systems. As with all fine filter media, it should be checked regularly and cleaned or replaced when it becomes blocked with debris. Technical Specifications Material type: Synthetic polymer filter wool Width: 45cm Supplied length: 1m increments Format: Cut from roll Use: Fine mechanical filtration and water polishing Good to Know Filter wool may block more quickly than coarse foam because it traps finer particles Best used as a final stage after coarser mechanical filtration Cut to size before placing inside the filter

item.g:title: Cloverleaf Acriflavine Water Answer 2X Concentrated - 250ml
item.g:description: Cloverleaf Acriflavine Water Answer 2X Concentrated is an anti-bacterial water treatment for ornamental ponds. It is designed for use where fish are affected by external bacterial problems associated with open wounds, ulcers, scale damage and fin rot. This 250ml bottle treats up to 4,000 gallons or 18,150 litres of pond water when used at the stated dose rate. The treatment contains acriflavine neutral. Cloverleaf Acriflavine Water Answer Features 2X concentrated acriflavine water treatment for ornamental ponds Anti-bacterial solution for external fish health issues For open wounds, ulcers, scale damage and fin rot Suitable for use with the Cloverleaf Smart Pro-Tect dosing system Cloverleaf Acriflavine Water Answer should be added to a bucket of pond water before being distributed evenly around the pond. Shake the bottle before use, calculate the pond volume carefully, and measure the correct amount of treatment using the supplied measuring cup. The dosage is 10ml per 160 gallons, or 726 litres, of pond water. The treatment cycle can be repeated every 10 days until the problem ceases, for up to 4 applications. Do not use other fish medications for 10 days after the last dose, and do not use below 10°C or above 30°C. item.g:title: Oase AquaMax Eco Titanium 51000 Dry Mounted Pump
item.g:description: The Oase AquaMax Eco Titanium 51000 dry mounted pond pump has been designed specifically with larger ponds in mind which do not have the need to lift water very high above the water level. The AquaMax Titanium produces a very high volume of water at low pressure and exceedingly low power consumption - 51000 litre per hour for only 320 watts. The Titanium has been built to be installed in a dry chamber as part of a gravity-fed filter system but can be used submerged in a pond or the last stage of a filter chamber. However, the 75mm (3” BSP) inlet and outlet are threaded and do not come with any fittings or a pre-filter, and so installation into a system or pond will need to be considered. Like the other Oase AquaMax Premium pumps, the AquaMax Eco Titanium 51000 pump also features the Environmental Function Control (EFC by OASE) which protects against dry running and blocking, as well as the Seasonal Flow Control switch which if used, will slow down the pump automatically when the water temperature drops to a certain level, reducing your power consumption. This can lead to a 30% energy savings. The Titanium pump is not actually made of Titanium but has a cast Stainless Steel housing. The impeller is capable of pumping particles up to 6mm in size, and the rotor shaft and bearings are of high quality SCI ceramics for a reliable and long lifespan. Included with the Titanium pump are 10m of mains cable and a 3 year guarantee, which can be extended to 5 years free of charge simply by sending the warranty card off to Oase. Oase AquaMax Eco Titanium 51000 Dry Mounted Pond Pump Exceedingly low power consumption - only 320 watts Maximum flow rate 51000 litres per hour Can be mounted in or out of the water 75mm (3” BSP) inlet and outlet size High quality SCI ceramic rotor shaft and bearings Cast stainless steel housing 6mm maximum particle pumping size 5 year guarantee These pumps are part of the OASE Control (previously called "Easy Garden Control (EGC)") range which allows remote monitoring and control via free access to the OASE Cloud. This allows you to communicate with your pond whilst away from home. See the "More Info" tab below for other OC (EGC) compatible products.

item.g:title: Noma - Heron 3 Light Starter Set – Green
item.g:description: The Heron 3 Light Starter Set in green is a low voltage garden lighting kit designed to provide soft downward illumination around paths, borders, planting schemes and garden features. Inspired by the tall, graceful shape of a heron, these stake lights offer a simple way to add practical and decorative lighting to outdoor spaces. This starter set includes three metal Heron stake lights, ground spikes, connecting cable and an indoor Easy-timer transformer plug, giving you the main components needed to begin a low voltage garden lighting layout. Heron 3 Light Starter Set – Green Features Set of 3 green metal Heron stake lights Soft downward glow for paths, borders and planted areas Low voltage lighting system with Easy-timer transformer plug Each light includes 50cm inlet and 50cm outlet leads Thread-together connectors allow lights to be spaced up to 1m apart Can be expanded with additional Heron add-on lights and accessories The Heron stake lights are 41cm tall with a 7.8cm diameter, making them suitable for placing among garden borders, tall grasses, pathways and planted areas. Their downward-facing light helps illuminate selected areas without overpowering the surrounding garden. Each light has a 50cm inlet lead and 50cm outlet lead with thread-together connectors. This allows the lights to be positioned up to 1m apart as supplied, with additional cable available separately if wider spacing is required. The included Easy-timer power supply allows the lights to run for 8 hours on and 16 hours off. Press the button on the plug at the time you want the lights to come on, and the timer will remember that time and switch the lights on at the same time each day. Technical Specifications Colour: Green Number of lights: 3 Light material: Metal LED power: 0.75W per light Light height: 41cm Light diameter: 7.8cm Connector lead length: 50cm inlet and 50cm outlet per light Maximum spacing as supplied: Up to 1m between lights Connecting cable: 10m low voltage cable Transformer: IP20 9W indoor Easy-timer transformer plug Power supply capacity: Up to 12 lights from one power source Timer function: 8 hours on / 16 hours off Warranty: 12 months What’s Included 3 x Heron green metal stake lights 3 x ground spikes 10m low voltage connecting cable IP20 9W indoor Easy-timer transformer plug Blanking cap for the final light outlet lead Good to Know The transformer plug is IP20 rated and is for indoor use. The transformer plug is too large for covered outdoor power sockets. One light is supplied with a blanking cap for the outlet lead and should be used as the end light. item.g:title: Noma Dusk and Dawn Sensor
item.g:description: The Noma Dusk and Dawn Sensor is an inline light sensor for use with Noma Tawny and Heron low voltage light sets. It automatically switches compatible garden lights on when light levels fall at dusk and switches them off again when daylight increases in the morning. This makes it a practical control accessory for garden lighting, especially during spring and autumn when sunset and sunrise times change noticeably. Noma Dusk and Dawn Sensor Features Inline dusk and dawn sensor for compatible Noma lighting sets Suitable for Noma Tawny and Heron light sets Automatically switches lights on when light levels fall at dusk Automatically switches lights off when daylight increases in the morning Helps avoid the need to regularly adjust timer settings as daylight hours change The Noma Dusk and Dawn Sensor helps make garden lighting easier to manage by responding to natural light levels. Rather than relying on a fixed time setting, the sensor controls the lights according to the surrounding daylight conditions. This is particularly useful during autumn and spring, when the time of sunset changes quickly. It allows compatible Tawny and Heron lighting sets to operate automatically as the evenings draw in or become lighter. Technical Specifications Product type: Inline dusk and dawn sensor Function: Automatic light-level control Compatible with: Noma Tawny and Heron light sets System type: Low voltage lighting accessory What’s Included 1 x Noma inline dusk and dawn sensor Good to Know This sensor is designed for compatible Noma Tawny and Heron light sets. It switches lights according to surrounding light levels rather than a fixed clock time.

item.g:title: Replacement Noma Easytimer Power Supply
item.g:description: The Replacement Noma Easytimer Power Supply is a replacement indoor transformer plug for compatible Noma low voltage garden lighting systems. It is designed to replace the Easytimer power supply supplied with selected Noma Tawny and Heron lighting starter sets. The Easytimer function allows compatible lights to run on an 8 hours on and 16 hours off cycle, helping to provide regular evening lighting without needing to switch the lights on manually each day. Replacement Noma Easytimer Power Supply Features Replacement Easytimer power supply for compatible Noma low voltage lighting Designed for use with selected Noma Tawny and Heron garden light sets 8 hours on / 16 hours off timer function Button-operated timer setting Indoor plug-style power supply Suitable for replacing a damaged or failed original Easytimer transformer The Easytimer is simple to set. Press the button at the time you want the lights to switch on, and hold it until the green indicator light confirms the timer has been set. The lights will then stay on for 8 hours and switch off for 16 hours, repeating the same cycle each day. To reset the timer, press and hold the button again until the green light goes out. The timer is then returned to off mode and can be reset when required. This replacement power supply is useful if the original transformer supplied with your Noma lighting set has become damaged or stopped working. It allows the existing compatible lights and cables to continue being used without replacing the full lighting kit. Technical Specifications Product type: Replacement Easytimer power supply Function: Timed power supply for compatible low voltage lighting Timer cycle: 8 hours on / 16 hours off Control type: Push-button timer setting Compatible with: Selected Noma Tawny and Heron low voltage light sets Use: Indoor plug-style power supply What’s Included 1 x Replacement Noma Easytimer Power Supply Good to Know This is a replacement power supply and does not include lights or extension cables. The power supply is for indoor use and should not be left exposed outdoors. Check that your existing Noma lighting set uses the same Easytimer connection before ordering.

item.g:title: Pepper Grass - Pilularia Globulifera
item.g:description: Pepper Grass (Pilularia Globulifera) is a type of creeping fern with slender, grass-like foliage that unwinds from its stem with tiny round spore cases that form at the base of the stems. This slow growing plant can reach up to a height of 10-15cm (4" - 6") and can be planted 0 - 15cm (6") below the surface. This native British species can assist with oxygenation of the water and provides good habitat for underwater wildlife. Plant in a medium container using aquatic soil covered with pea gravel. Common Name: Pepper Grass / Pillwort Flowering Time: Evergreen Planting Depth: 0 - 150mm (0 inch - 6 inch) Plant Height: Up to 150mm (6 inch) Light Preference: Full Sun to Part Shade Growth Rate: Slow All our plants are supplied in 9cm square planting pots and are ready to put in your pond, however as they grow they will definitely benefit from replanting into larger baskets with more soil. To see our full range of planting accessories click here

item.g:title: Wiska - EV101 Pre Filled IP68 Gel Electrical Cable Connector (6-8mm)
item.g:description: The Wiska EV101 Pre Filled IP68 Gel Connector is designed for joining electrical cables with an outer diameter of 6-8mm where a waterproof external connection is required. The connector is supplied pre-filled with sealing gel, which moulds around the cable and terminal connection when the housing is closed. Wiska EV101 Pre Filled IP68 Gel Connector Features Suitable for cables with an outer diameter of 6-8mm Pre-filled gel housing for quick waterproof cable joining IP68 rated when correctly installed Rated for use down to a maximum depth of 1m Supplied with a screw terminal block Gel is non-toxic, ready to use, and has no expiry date This gel connector provides a simple way to create a sealed waterproof cable joint for outdoor and external electrical installations. Once the cables have been wired into the supplied terminal block, the connection is placed into the centre of the gel-filled housing and the lid is closed. As the connector closes, the gel is compressed around the cable and terminal block, helping to form a watertight seal around the joint. The supplied screw terminal block can accept up to 3 cables, making the connector suitable for practical cable joining where a compact waterproof enclosure is required. Technical Specifications IP rating: IP68 when correctly installed (waterproof) Maximum rated depth: 1m Cable diameter: 6-8mm Terminal size: 0.75mm² to 2.5mm² Temperature range: -20°C to 90°C Dimensions: 72mm long x 28mm diameter What’s Included Pre-filled gel connector housing Screw terminal block Good to Know The connector must be installed correctly to achieve the stated IP68 rating.
